description.en: Community plugin index aggregated from multiple public DeepSeek Harness plugin indexes, refreshed daily.
description.zh: 由多个公开 DeepSeek Harness 插件索引合并去重而成的社区插件源，每日自动更新。

description.en: Persistent Codex, Grok Build and Claude Code sessions through ACP, with native model controls, permission approvals and optional A2A delegation.
description.zh: 通过 ACP 使用持久化的 Codex、Grok Build 和 Claude Code 会话，支持原生模型控制、权限审批及可选的 A2A 委派。

description.en: Adds mind maps and an Excalidraw canvas to the DSH sidebar, with local blueprint-file editing, Excalidraw file previews and standalone CLIs.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏提供思维导图和 Excalidraw 自由画布，支持本地思维导图文件编辑、Excalidraw 文件预览与独立 CLI。

description.en: Search and read local Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, Grok and DSH sessions from the 1session CLI or DSH Web history browser.
description.zh: 通过 1session 命令行或 DSH Web 历史浏览器搜索和读取 Claude Code、Codex、Antigravity、Grok 与 DSH 的本地编程会话。

description.en: Open plugin marketplace: live GitHub dsh-plugin topic search with per-repo package.json verification (dsh.bundle/dsh.client manifest badges and a verified-only…
description.zh: 开放式插件市场：GitHub dsh-plugin 话题实时搜索，逐仓库 package.json 验证（dsh.bundle/dsh.client 声明徽章与只看已验证过滤），npm 优先安装带同源防抢注校验，更新检测，并附五个可在无界面环境使用的 agent 工具。

description.en: Message-level rollback, single-message deletion, and replay-based restore for DSH sessions; operations are append-only surface replacements, with confirmation prompts and a running-session guard. Requires Node.js 23.5+.
description.zh: DSH 会话消息级回滚、单条删除与重放式恢复；操作以 append-only surface replace 实现，带确认提示和运行中会话保护。需 Node.js 23.5+。

description.en: Read-only lazy session viewer: lists sessions with stat only, then decompresses just the tail Zstandard frames to inspect recent events; includes search,…
description.zh: 只读会话惰性查看器：仅 stat 列出会话，再只解压尾部 Zstandard 帧查看最近事件；独立 /lazyview 面板支持搜索、统计和导出。需 Node.js 24+。

description.en: Cross-session full-text search over persisted DSH session logs: builds an incremental message-level index and returns sessionId, seq, and a short excerpt;…
description.zh: 跨会话全文搜索：对持久化 DSH 会话日志建立增量消息级索引，返回 sessionId、seq 与摘录；提供 agent 工具和独立面板。需 Node.js 23.5+。

description.en: Aggregated web search provider that fans one query out to 11 engines (Exa, Parallel, DuckDuckGo, SearXNG, Brave, Tavily, Serper, Mojeek, DeepSeek, Anthropic, OpenAI) concurrently, URL-dedupes and merges the results. Ships a settings card for toggling backends, storing API keys in the credential store, and tuning concurrency and timeouts.
description.zh: 聚合网络搜索插件：一次查询并发分发到 11 个引擎（Exa、Parallel、DuckDuckGo、SearXNG、Brave、Tavily、Serper、Mojeek、DeepSeek、Anthropic、OpenAI），URL 去重后合并结果。设置面板卡片可开关后端、将 API Key 存入凭证库，并调整并发与超时。

description.en: Long sessions get expensive, and the platform compacts the context on its own. This plugin adds an occupancy badge (hover to see how it is computed), writes a…
description.zh: 长会话越跑越贵，平台到点还会把上下文压掉。这个插件做三件事：在会话标题旁显示当前上下文占了多少，鼠标停上去能看到这个数是怎么来的；过 45% 时往工作目录的 HANDOVER.md 写一份交接草稿，记下改过哪些文件、花了多少钱、最近几轮在聊什么；到 60% 提醒你一次该收尾了。平台压缩发生时，它把压缩前的数字记一行，事…

description.en: Runs open-mcp-apps inside DSH: every MCP app gets its own sidebar container with a separate workspace, session, and App mode, an agent status strip under the…
description.zh: 把 open-mcp-apps 接进 DSH：每个 MCP app 都是侧边栏里自己的容器，带独立 workspace、会话与 App mode，应用下方是 agent 状态条，普通聊天里也能行内渲染 app。

description.en: Browse the awesome-dsh-plugin catalog from a dedicated page opened through the DSH left sidebar. Search, filter by category or installed state, and sort by…
description.zh: 从 DSH 左侧栏打开独立的插件市场页面，浏览 awesome-dsh-plugin 目录。支持按分类或安装状态筛选、按名称或简介搜索，以及按 Star、下载量、名称或收录时间排序；三个标签分别显示全部插件、已安装插件和可更新插件，并单独提示无法判断更新状态的数量。自动识别当前 Web 或桌面 profile，使用…

description.en: OpenCode Console (Zen) models for DeepSeek Harness: paste a Console API key under Settings → Plugins and the Console's chat models become selectable, with the…
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 OpenCode Console (Zen) 模型：在「设置 → 插件」填入 Console API Key 后即可选用 Console 的对话模型，模型目录自动同步，每个模型按官方文档路由到对应端点，免费 *-free 模型默认不列出（它们只能在 OpenCode…

description.en: A whip for DeepSeek V4 Pro: it watches the reasoning fingerprint of every thinking block and pulls the model back when it slips from focused "We will / I will"…
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek V4 Pro 的鞭子：实时监听每个思维块的指纹，当模型从专注的 We will / I will 模式滑向发散的 let me 模式时把它拉回来。

description.en: Image generation workbench and agent tool for DSH: one tool (ark9_generate_image) paints text-to-image and image-to-image via any OpenAI-compatible API.…
description.zh: DSH 生图工作台与 Agent 生图工具：一个工具（ark9_generate_image）走任意 OpenAI 兼容图片 API 文生图/图生图。渠道完全由用户自行添加——默认零预置，自带 baseURL、Key 与模型名即可（支持手动输入任意模型名）。Agent 发起的生图默认需用户审批：请求进入浮窗审批页，批准…

description.en: ★ 170 │ Recall and consolidate project memory with handoff ledgers, planning notes and context tracking.
description.zh: ★ 170 │ 整理和检索项目记忆，保存交接记录、计划笔记与上下文状态。

description.en: Pull a 3D lever next to the send button and turn the model's reasoning signals into a pixel-art gacha reveal.
description.zh: 在发送按钮旁拉动 3D 拉杆，把模型思维链的文本信号变成一场像素风抽卡演出。

description.en: Self-contained literature library for DSH with optional Zotero export: full-text PDF fetching (Unpaywall/arXiv/custom URL templates), loose Crossref-backed…
description.zh: DSH 内置文献库（可选导出到 Zotero）：通过 Unpaywall/arXiv/自定义 URL 模板获取全文 PDF，Crossref 候选式宽松搜索，APA/GB-T 7714/MLA/Chicago 引用生成，侧窗 PDF 阅读器（高亮与笔记），以及注入当前对话的 AI 问答/翻译。

description.en: Browses and manages user skills already on disk in DSH and supported agent home directories.
description.zh: 浏览和管理 DSH 及受支持 Agent 主目录中已有的用户技能。

description.en: Evidence-first conclusion gate that cross-checks first-hand claims against a durable per-session tool-activity index, blocks unverified guesses and tracks…
description.zh: 实证门——按会话将第一手结论与持久工具活动索引交叉核验、拦截未验证猜测并以台账统计拦截与转化，中英双语界面。

description.en: Workspace-scoped Semgrep SAST tool for DeepSeek Harness with a managed Windows x64 runtime, structured bounded findings, cancellation and timeout controls, and…
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的工作区内 Semgrep SAST 工具，提供托管 Windows x64 运行时、结构化有界结果、取消与超时控制，以及经用户批准的沙箱权限升级。npm 包名为 @aaub-software/dsh-semgrep-sast。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to the official Vercel MCP server over OAuth, with per-Agent on-demand tool loading, slimmed tool schemas, paged long results and 34…
description.zh: 通过 OAuth 把 DeepSeek Harness 连接到 Vercel 官方 MCP 服务，支持按 Agent 按需加载工具、精简工具 schema、长结果分页，并附带 34 个 Vercel 技能。

description.en: One-click temporary tasks for DeepSeek Harness — each task is a disposable timestamped workspace plus its own session, shown as a native sidebar workspace node.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的临时任务模式：一键创建一次性的时间戳工作区并开会话，直接成为侧边栏原生工作区节点。

description.en: Forge quality gates for DeepSeek Harness: task gates, read-before-edit, bash hazard interception and quality scoring, enforced by the local forge CLI through…
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Forge 质量门禁：任务门禁、改前必读、危险命令拦截与质量评分，经 DSH 类型化拦截点由本地 forge CLI 执行。需本机安装 forge CLI，缺失时插件 fail-open 并在会话开始时尽力提示；任务门禁还要求项目已执行 forge init。

description.en: AgentDuel is a code-battle game. This plugin lets you complete the entire game loop inside DSH: manage deathmatch characters and capture-the-flag teams, submit…
description.zh: AgentDuel 是一款代码对战游戏，通过这款插件，在 DSH 内部完成整个游戏过程，实现死斗角色与夺旗团队、提交 Agent 代码、发起战斗、观看回放，并通过 DSH 会话依据战果继续优化 Agent。

description.en: ★ 3,727 │ Save completed conversations as Markdown memories and provide retrieval and long-term memory consolidation.
description.zh: ★ 3,727 │ 将完成的对话保存为 Markdown 记忆，提供检索和长期记忆整理。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Choose a separate provider, model and reasoning effort for the experimental DSH authorization reviewer while preserving native policy and conversation routing. Requires the host Auto review component; no DSH version range is declared.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 为 DSH 实验性自动授权审查单独指定提供方、模型和推理档位，保留原生策略与主对话路由。依赖宿主 Auto review 组件，包内未声明适用的 DSH 版本。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Run single-turn or continuing questions in an independent subagent and display the results in the current conversation.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在独立子 Agent 中进行单轮或连续问答，并把结果展示在当前对话中。

description.en: Dockable DSH Web UI layout that organizes conversations as tabs across draggable split groups.
description.zh: 可停靠的 DSH Web UI 布局插件，将对话组织为标签页，并支持拖拽拆分对话分组。

description.en: Per-event sound notifications: turn completion, approval, question, plan-review, goal-blocked, and task-failure each get their own sound and volume,…
description.zh: 六类事件独立提示音：回合完成、审批、提问、计划评审、目标受阻、任务失败各有独立声音与音量，可在 Web 设置面板配置（内置合成音 / 静音 / 本地音频文件）。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Consult TypeSafe Jev before a turn to suggest whether a registered agent should handle the task.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在模型开始处理前，通过 TypeSafe Jev 建议是否交给已注册的 Agent 执行。

description.en: ★ 0 │ dsh plugin: an unattended approval gate. Subagent, scheduled and cron approval requests get a bounded answer window, then settle on a fail-closed default instead of hanging.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 为无人值守的子 Agent 和定时任务设置审批等待时限，超时后默认不放行。

description.en: ★ 1 │ dsh plugin: routes ask-user questions to every interaction surface bound to the asking session (TUI panel, Feishu card, web, ...), and the first answer wins.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 将会话提问同步到终端、飞书卡片或网页等界面，采用最先收到的回答。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Deliver bounded tasks to online agents using calendar or interval schedules.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 按日历或间隔规则，将范围明确的任务派发给在线 Agent。

description.en: ★ 14 │ Deterministic context-pruning compaction backend for dsh: zero-LLM summaries, /dcp command, works out of the box. Design references Opencode-DCP.
description.zh: ★ 14 │ 按规则裁剪和压缩上下文，无需模型生成摘要，可通过 /dcp 调用。

description.en: ★ 3 │ dsh plugin: drive an existing dsh session from Feishu/Lark, with round cards, interactive resume, ask-user cards and steer (outbound-only WebSocket bot).
description.zh: ★ 3 │ 从飞书操作已有 DSH 会话，通过卡片查看轮次、回答问题、恢复任务或补充指令。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Apply bounded retries to transient gateway failures such as EOF, TLS alerts and stream read errors.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 对 EOF、TLS 告警和流读取失败等临时网关错误进行限次重试。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Use environment proxies and an undici dispatcher to route model traffic through configured proxies.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 通过环境变量和 undici 为模型请求配置代理与分流。

description.en: ★ 0 │ dsh plugin: persistent whole-machine LLM usage ledger with a markdown /llm-stats report (GFM tables and emoji: tokens, cache hit, model/tool time, per-day bars).
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 记录本机各模型的用量、缓存命中和执行耗时，通过 /llm-stats 查看统计报告。

description.en: ★ 1 │ dsh plugin: token-efficient prompt-side shim for the official MCP client that folds mcp__* tool schemas out of every assembled prompt and exposes two constant meta-tools (starting with mcp_list).
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 按需检索和加载 MCP 工具，减少每次提示词中重复携带的工具定义。

description.en: ★ 2 │ dsh plugin: keeps llm-pi-ai provider routes' model lists in step with the pi.dev gateway, written through the official settings seam.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 同步 pi.dev 网关模型列表，通过 DSH 设置更新 llm-pi-ai 供应商配置。

description.en: ★ 1 │ dsh plugin: switches named model profiles (default model, think level, per-subagent models) interactively through the host ask-user flow, one implementation for both TUI and web surfaces.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 交互式切换模型配置，包括默认模型、思考强度和各子 Agent 模型，支持终端与网页界面。

description.en: ★ 9 │ dsh plugin: registers custom agents defined in ~/.dsh/agents/*.md as callable subagents via the use_agent tool, with continuable background dispatch and ask_agent follow-ups.
description.zh: ★ 9 │ 将本地 Markdown 文件定义的 Agent 注册为可调用子 Agent，支持后台任务续接和追问。

description.en: ★ 7 │ Quality-first topic memory for DSH. Each topic keeps its starting question, conclusion, impact, and dependencies, not the process, in a local, git-traced OKF bundle with budgeted, LLM-free injection.
description.zh: ★ 7 │ 按主题保存问题、结论、影响和依赖，用本地 Git 跟踪版本，并在预算范围内注入相关记忆。

description.en: ★ 14 │ A fully featured pi-style terminal UI for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): history look-back and fork-at-turn, guided preset switching, live subagent steering, model profiles and themes.
description.zh: ★ 14 │ 提供 pi 风格终端界面，支持历史回看、从指定轮次创建分支、预设切换和子 Agent 实时引导。

description.en: ★ 0 │ dsh plugin: encrypted backup, restore and migration of the dsh home config through a private GitHub repo.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 通过私有 GitHub 仓库加密备份、恢复和迁移 DSH 配置。

description.en: ★ 1 │ AnySearch web search provider plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh).
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 为 DSH 网页搜索接入 AnySearch。

description.en: ★ 2 │ Tavily-backed web search provider for DeepSeek Harness (dsh).
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 为 DSH 网页搜索接入 Tavily。

description.en: Evidence-bound negative-knowledge ledger: persists disproven paths (command_failed, file_missing) with their outcome and precondition evidence, then warns or…
description.zh: 证据约束的负面知识账本：记录被证伪的路径（command_failed / file_missing）及其结果与前置条件证据，重复尝试时警告或拦截，证据变化后自动解除。

description.en: A namespace management tool for toolsets that supports automatic discovery and integration, designed to help reduce token consumption. Also runs TypeScript and…
description.zh: 一个用于管理工具集的命名空间管理工具，支持自动发现与集成，用于节省token的消耗还会在受限 Node 运行时执行 TypeScript 与 JavaScript，按需通过命名空间调用工具。

description.en: ★ 9 │ Add timeline navigation, folders, prompts, export, Mermaid, quoted replies, appearance controls and usage displays.
description.zh: ★ 9 │ 提供时间线、文件夹、提示词、导出、Mermaid、引用回复、外观设置和用量显示。

description.en: Full workbench fork of dsh-better-sidebar: explorer, editor, terminal, Git, browser and split panes, plus a VSCode-like shell refactor with a full-width…
description.zh: dsh-better-sidebar 完整工作台 fork：资源管理器、编辑器、终端、Git、浏览器与分屏，外加仿 VSCode 外壳重构（全宽紧凑顶栏与活动栏）；npm 包名 @all3cn/dsh-better-sidebar-n23。

description.en: Runs one-time and RFC 5545 recurring Agent tasks in fresh DSH sessions, with visual schedule editing and session-linked history.
description.zh: 在全新的 DSH 会话中运行单次或 RFC 5545 周期 Agent 任务，支持可视化计划编辑和会话关联历史。

description.en: A shared kanban board that lets people and DSH agents manage workspace tasks through a Board tab and kanban tools.
description.zh: 一个由用户与 DSH Agent 共同维护的工作区看板，通过看板标签页和 kanban 工具管理任务。

description.en: A minimal worktree management solution with only one button and one dialog.
description.zh: 极简 worktree 管理方案，只有一个按钮和一个弹窗。

description.en: A2A protocol server for dsh agents, with JSON-RPC tasks, SSE streaming, cancellation, and an agent card.
description.zh: 为 dsh agent 提供 A2A 协议服务，支持 JSON-RPC 任务、SSE 流式输出、取消任务和 agent card。

description.en: Send dsh turn traces, LLM generations, tool spans, and subagent activity to Langfuse.
description.zh: 将 dsh 的会话轮次、LLM 调用、工具调用及子 agent 活动记录到 Langfuse。

description.en: Apply configurable allow, deny, and approval rules to dsh tool calls, including shell command patterns.
description.zh: 根据可配置的允许、拒绝和审批规则控制 dsh 工具调用，包括对 shell 命令的匹配。

description.en: Mirror dsh session events to MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite, or SQL Server while retaining local session files.
description.zh: 将 dsh 会话事件镜像到 MySQL、PostgreSQL、SQLite 或 SQL Server，同时保留本地会话文件。

description.en: Provider-aware account balance chip for the DSH sidebar, showing the active model provider balance for DeepSeek, OpenRouter, Moonshot/Kimi, Zhipu/GLM, and…
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏的账户余额胶囊，跟随当前模型的服务商显示余额，支持 DeepSeek、OpenRouter、Moonshot/Kimi、Zhipu/GLM 与 MiniMax，并显示 DeepSeek 高峰/空闲时段。

description.en: Adds a Delete action to archived Session rows that permanently removes the Session log directory, the log directories of its subagent Sessions, its Workspace…
description.zh: 在已归档会话的行菜单里加入「删除会话」：永久移除会话日志目录、它启动的子代理会话日志、工作区归属、归档标记、投影缓存记录与 spill 溢出目录；宿主仍持有的会话先登记，下次启动或点「完成待删除清理」时完成。另外会清扫被放弃的空白占位、遗留的孤儿子代理与失效的投影缓存记录，并让空白占位不再出现在 @ 引用列表里。

description.en: ★ 50 │ Connect DSH to the DSH Browser Control extension through a local WebSocket bridge, with browser tools and a settings switch. Requires the browser extension; renamed from @caob23/dsh-browser-control.
description.zh: ★ 50 │ 通过本地 WebSocket 桥连接 DSH Browser Control 浏览器扩展，提供网页操作工具与设置开关。需要配套扩展，原包名为 @caob23/dsh-browser-control。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Record model token usage and estimated costs, then query historical statistics from Settings.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 记录模型 Token 用量和费用估算，在设置页查询历史统计。

description.en: ★ 83 │ Accessibility-first macOS Computer Use capability for DeepSeek Harness with stale-observation protection, app leases, confirmations, screenshots, and Web diagnostics
description.zh: ★ 83 │ 通过辅助功能、截图与应用控制工具操作 macOS 桌面。

description.en: ★ 141 │ Turn-level conversation and workspace rewind for DeepSeek Harness, powered by a persistent Change Ledger
description.zh: ★ 141 │ 基于持久变更账本回退会话轮次和工作区文件。

description.en: ★ 918 │ Use image questions, OCR, grounding, UI reconstruction and pixel comparisons in DSH.
description.zh: ★ 918 │ 提供图片问答、文字识别、目标定位、界面还原和像素比较工具。

description.en: J-Space Cognition Suite SV1 native agent preset and standalone Cordis plugin: 13 modules, persistent controller and decoupled workspace.
description.zh: J-Space Cognition Suite SV1 原生智能体预设与 Cordis 插件：提供 13 大认知工程模块、持久化控制器与状态外化工作区。

description.en: Self-contained browser runtime: Playwright (chromium) + OpenCLI as plugin-local dependencies (global reuse fallback), exposes a `browser` service and 9 interactive browser tools.
description.zh: 自包含浏览器运行时：Playwright（chromium）+ OpenCLI 作为插件本地依赖（全局复用回退），提供 `browser` 服务与 9 个交互式浏览器工具。

description.en: Diagnose duplicate DSH loader entry IDs before startup, report version-locked repair status in a read-only settings card, and apply or revert audited loader…
description.zh: 在 DSH 启动前诊断重复的 loader entry ID，通过只读设置卡片报告版本锁定的修复状态，并使用外部 CLI 应用或撤销经过审计的 loader 修复。

description.en: ★ 671 │ Connect AnySearch web search, page fetching and advanced search tools to DSH.

description.en: ★ 158 │ DSH Web selection-annotation plugin: select assistant text, annotate (optional), and press Enter to send the annotation block with your message — the model replies to each annotation by number, with hoverable chips in the reply.
description.zh: ★ 158 │ 选择助手回复中的文字并添加批注，让模型按编号逐条回应。

description.zh: ★ 827 │ 在助手回复中呈现交互图表、表单、流程图等界面。

description.en: Per-package automatic updates for the DeepSeek Harness plugins you choose. On a schedule it asks npm for the latest version of installed plugins, updates only…
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 插件做按包白名单的自动更新：按计划去 npm 查已装插件的最新版本，只更新你勾选的包，本地 link／file 安装、锁定版本和出错的包一律跳过；默认不跨大版本、不装预发布。更新走 profile 里运行中的官方插件管理器，profile 写锁、pnpm 执行、bundle…

description.en: Write, check, and publish a Chinese Quarto Book: nine-step chapter writing, structure/link/figure checks, a consistent theme, and render acceptance. Loads only…
description.zh: 把一份 Quarto Book 写成可读、可查、可发布的中文技术书：九步章节写作、结构/链接/图表检查、统一主题与渲染验收。仅在 type: book 仓库加载；需 Quarto CLI 与 Python 3。

description.en: CapMap docs visualization with Obsidian-style semantic graph and capability panel.
description.zh: CapMap 文档体系可视化：Obsidian 风格语义图谱与能力面板。

description.en: Registers the DeepSeek Harness web server (dsh web) as an auto-start, self-healing background service — LaunchAgent / systemd / cron plus a 30s health-check…

description.en: Auditable token ledger for DeepSeek Harness: folds the durable session log into restart-safe totals, recomputes the same numbers from the raw logs and diffs…
description.zh: 可审计的 DSH token 账本：把持久化会话日志折算成重启安全的总量，可从原始日志重算并比对差异，并按工作区、会话、模型或厂商生成账单，可导出 CSV 或 JSON。

description.en: DeepSeek account balance in the dsh web sidebar footer with live config hot reload and an editable Settings → Plugins card.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 侧边栏底部展示 DeepSeek 账户余额，支持配置热重载与可编辑的设置 → 插件卡片。

description.en: DSH sidebar footer ordering: forces the sidebar.footer.action slot into a vertical stack and lets users configure the top-to-bottom order of its entries.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏页脚排序：将 sidebar.footer.action 槽位改为上下堆叠，并允许用户配置各条目自上而下的排列顺序。

description.en: C++ audit skill: detects the target project's actual C++ standard before making any recommendation, then reports findings across RAII and ownership, move…
description.zh: C++ 审查技能：先探测目标工程真实的 C++ 标准再给建议，随后按 RAII 与所有权、移动语义、异常安全、性能与内存、容器与算法、并发、模板与编译期、标准边界、类型安全、ABI 与接口设计逐条给出结论，每条含检查点、原因、反例→正例与适用标准。

description.en: Archived-session manager for DSH Web: workspace-grouped list, FTS5 full-text search over session content with per-session snippets, restore-and-open, and hard…

description.en: Shows the running agent step above the web composer as a Chinese sentence: its step number, the tools it is running, and how long it has been going. A finished…
description.zh: 在网页版输入框上方用一句中文显示当前正在执行的智能体步骤：步号、正在执行的工具、以及已运行多久。步骤结束后会保留该步用时，直到下一步开始，因此慢步骤事后也能查证。

description.zh: 自进化团队记忆，以纯 Markdown 存于 Git：原生 Cordis 插件注册 38 个裸名记忆工具，并按每次组装动态注入 prompt-signals 段；含 RPE 强化、衰减与睡眠巩固；与 Claude Code（MCP）、OpenClaw 宿主共享同一数据仓；已对 DSH 0.1.0-rc.6 实测。

description.en: ★ 172 │ Search anime sources, inspect details and access playback links inside a conversation.

description.en: Two-level model picker for the DeepSeek Harness composer: browse providers, then models, search across all providers or within one provider, select supported…

description.en: ★ 79 │ A persistent agent team for long-running collaboration in DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: ★ 79 │ 为长期任务保存 Agent 团队与协作状态。

description.en: Renders assistant replies with numbered citation chips and a sources panel for web-search results, inline pictures with their source captions, and KaTeX…

description.en: Computer use for Windows: screenshot, mouse, keyboard, clipboard and window tools with per-app access that goes through DSH approval; while the agent is in control the screen shows an orange glow and a status bar, and Esc pauses or resumes.
description.zh: Windows 电脑控制：截图、鼠标、键盘、剪贴板和窗口工具，按应用授权并经 DSH 审批；操控期间屏幕显示橙色光晕和提示条，按 Esc 暂停或继续。

description.en: Web search provider with switchable engines, several usable without an API key (Bing, DuckDuckGo, SearXNG and others) and a fallback order between them; adds…

description.en: Windows only: the agent edits documents inside the Word, Excel and PowerPoint (Microsoft Office or WPS Office) windows you have open, through the applications' automation interface, so changes appear live and you can edit alongside; it reads structure, applies batches of edits, renders pages to images to check layout, and saves or exports PDF.

description.en: Network proxy settings page for DeepSeek Harness: set a global HTTP(S) proxy with bypass hosts, or give each LLM provider its own proxy or a direct connection;…

description.zh: 用手机浏览器继续电脑上的会话：扫码并在电脑上确认设备后，在移动端界面里对话、处理审批、浏览工作区文件、管理设置；支持同一 Wi-Fi 直连或经 Cloudflare Quick Tunnel 连接。

description.en: ClinePass provider for DeepSeek Harness: 15 bundled subscription and free models, a settings page with per-model capacity overrides, subscription usage for the…

description.en: Per provider/model generation concurrency, with a settings card: a cap on how many sessions may stream at once, enforced at the stream and again at subagent…

description.en: Config-driven lifecycle hooks, including context injection: declare event, handler and outcome in YAML, where the handler is an in-harness tool (MCP included),…
description.zh: 以配置驱动的生命周期钩子，并支持上下文注入：在 YAML 中声明事件、处理器与结果——处理器可以是进程内工具（含 MCP）、shell 命令或 HTTP 端点，结果可以是模型可见的上下文、拒绝该次工具调用，或触发即忘。

description.en: Deep research as an agent mode: one reviewed loop that plans, researches in adaptive parallel rounds driven by the gaps the researchers themselves declare,…
description.zh: 把深度研究做成一种代理模式：一条经过审阅的固定循环——先规划，再按研究员自行声明的缺口进行自适应并行轮次，综合出带引用的报告，最后对其做对抗性审阅——而不是让模型每次现写脚本。轮次预算未能覆盖的问题会在报告中被逐一点名，而不是被悄悄丢弃。

description.en: Identity-gated Tailscale access to the Web GUI with dsh still bound to loopback: a 127.0.0.1 proxy published by `tailscale serve` admits a request only when…

description.en: A thinking level stored per provider and model, so reasoning effort outlives the session it was set in and also reaches subagents, which dsh never asks. The…

description.en: Rewrites the Chinese copy of a market-installed plugin into English using a model already configured in the harness — automatically when the plugin is…

description.en: Progressive tool disclosure: a deferred tool group costs one catalog line instead of its full schemas until the model loads it with tool_search, with one…

description.en: A guarded local fetch provider for the ctx.web seam — the backend dsh does not ship for its own web_fetch tool. Every redirect hop is re-resolved and checked…
description.zh: ctx.web 接口的本地受控抓取提供方——dsh 自带完整的 web_fetch 工具，却没有随附后端。每一跳重定向都会重新解析并对照非公网地址段校验，另有流式大小上限与内容类型白名单。

description.en: Points web_search at a self-hosted SearXNG instance instead of the native route: pages until maxResults is satisfied, and reports degraded coverage when…
description.zh: 把 web_search 指向自建的 SearXNG 实例而非原生搜索路由：自动翻页直到满足 maxResults，并在引擎失败时报告覆盖不全，避免把稀少的结果误读成网上本就没有内容。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Choose from six bundled themes and wallpapers, including VIP Golden Radiance, in the theme settings. The archive is about 37 MB; requires DSH >=0.2.1-rc.3 <0.3.0.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在主题设置中切换六款随包壁纸和配色，包含 VIP 金耀主题。归档约 37 MB；需 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.3 <0.3.0。

description.en: ★ 6,373 │ Manage agents, sessions and tools through an interactive terminal interface.
description.zh: ★ 6,373 │ 通过交互终端界面管理 Agent、会话和工具。

description.en: ★ 20 │ Hands your DeepSeek account balance to a whale-maid desktop pet floating on Windows. The host polls the balance and serves it over a 127.0.0.1 loopback route; pet_balance and pet_control tools let the agent read the balance or make the pet talk.
description.zh: ★ 20 │ 在 Windows 桌面显示鲸鱼女仆桌宠，通过本机接口查看 DeepSeek 余额，也可让 Agent 控制桌宠说话。

description.en: Route eligible shell commands through rtk to compress tool output and save tokens.
description.zh: 将符合条件的 shell 命令路由给 rtk，压缩工具输出并节省 token。

description.en: ★ 45 │ Combine a calendar, hierarchical tasks, AI planning, execution reviews and desktop reminders.
description.zh: ★ 45 │ 组合日历、分层任务、AI 拆解、执行复盘与桌面提醒。

description.en: Git Changes tab for the DSH web GUI: staging, diffing, AI-drafted commit messages, branch/merge/stash/worktree operations and sync, with live updates via…
description.zh: Git 更改标签页：暂存、对比、AI 起草提交信息、分支/合并/储藏/工作树操作与同步，通过 fs.watch 加 changeToken 轮询实现实时更新。

description.en: Replaces the headless startup to add --model provider/model, --resume <id|latest>, --continue and --session-info flags to dsh headless runs.
description.zh: 替换无界面启动流程，为 dsh headless 运行添加 --model provider/model、--resume <id|latest>、--continue 与 --session-info 标志。

description.en: A /remember command that writes facts into the AGENTS.md instruction hierarchy dsh already loads, plus a Memory tab showing which instructions the loader kept…
description.zh: /remember 命令将事实写入 dsh 已加载的 AGENTS.md 指令层级，并配有 Memory 标签页，显示加载器在字节预算内实际保留了哪些指令。

description.en: Captures every plan the agent presents through exit_plan_mode as markdown under <workspace>/.dsh/plans, opens a review window, and keeps a Plans history tab…
description.zh: 将智能体通过 exit_plan_mode 呈现的每个计划捕获为 <workspace>/.dsh/plans 下的 markdown，打开审阅窗口，并以 Plans 历史标签页记录每个计划的结果。

description.en: Skill provider that installs the whole @dennisrongo/skills catalog as one npm dependency, so skills install and update without cloning or linking directories.
description.zh: 技能提供者：将整个 @dennisrongo/skills 目录作为一个 npm 依赖安装，无需克隆仓库或链接目录即可完成技能的安装与更新。

description.en: Serves the obra/superpowers skill catalog to the harness and injects its using-superpowers bootstrap as a persistent, compaction-safe system-prompt section.
description.zh: 向 dsh 提供 obra/superpowers 技能目录，并将其 using-superpowers 引导作为持久、压缩安全的系统提示区块注入。

description.en: Twelve curated palettes, eight accent colours, a contrast slider and font/scale overrides for the DSH web UI, with an inlined first-paint script that prevents…
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面提供 12 套精选配色、8 种强调色、对比度滑块与字体/缩放覆盖，并内联首帧脚本防止主题闪烁。

description.en: Draggable weather bar in the shell overlay with forecast and geocoding from Open-Meteo; the position persists across sessions.
description.zh: shell 浮层中的可拖动天气条，预报与地理编码来自 Open-Meteo；位置跨会话持久保存。

description.en: Adds backup-then-delete and delete-only actions to the DSH session menu: the session directory, its projection cache and a metadata snapshot are copied to a…
description.zh: 给 DSH 会话「…」菜单加「备份删除」与「彻底删除」两个入口：先把会话目录、投影缓存和元数据快照复制到本地归档文件夹并逐文件校验，通过后再删除原件以释放磁盘空间；派生的子代理会话一并处理，每个备份文件夹都带 RESTORE.txt 恢复步骤。

description.en: ★ 7 │ Browse, preview, apply and revert color themes in DSH, including a palette matched to the default DSH colors. Sends limited usage events.
description.zh: ★ 7 │ 在 DSH 中浏览、预览、应用和还原配色主题，包含与 DSH 默认配色一致的方案。会发送有限的使用统计。

description.en: ★ 3 │ Install eight DFY plugins at once: wallpaper, appearance, archive management, media, image generation, interactive visuals, task guard and Codex connection, each with its own switch.
description.zh: ★ 3 │ 一次安装 DFY 的 8 个插件：壁纸、外观、归档管理、媒体内容、图像生成、交互可视化、任务守卫和 Codex 连接，可分别启停。

title.zh: 玄枢 · 中华传统智慧

description.en: ★ 61 │ A local-first consultation skill on traditional Chinese culture, with BaZi, Zi Wei, Liu Yao, feng shui and more computed by a local engine. For cultural reference, not prediction.
description.zh: ★ 61 │ 本地优先的中国传统文化咨询技能，八字、紫微、六爻、风水等由本地引擎计算，分层给出事实、文化解释和现实建议。仅供传统文化参考，不作预测。

description.en: Registers codex-web-search-mcp as native DSH MCP tools (mcp__codex-web-search__codex_web_search / codex_web_research / web_fetch) for model-independent Codex…
description.zh: 将 codex-web-search-mcp 注册为 DSH 原生 MCP 工具（codex_web_search / codex_web_research / web_fetch），提供与模型无关的 Codex / Grok 联网搜索与深度研究。

description.en: Complete reverse-skill pack (85 SKILL.md) as a DeepSeek Harness Cordis plugin: reverse engineering, authorized pentesting and security-research skill router.
description.zh: 完整 reverse-skill（85 个 SKILL.md）的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：逆向工程、授权渗透测试与安全研究的技能路由包。

description.en: Complete wuyun-liuqi (five-evolutions-six-qi / 五运六气) Traditional Chinese Medicine skill pack as a DeepSeek Harness Cordis plugin: annual and guest-qi…
description.zh: 完整 wuyun-liuqi（五运六气）中医运气学技能包，封装为 DeepSeek Harness 插件：年度与客气推算、临床辨证、病机推演。

description.en: AI image generation for the DSH Web GUI: text-to-image and image-to-image through a configurable OpenAI-compatible endpoint (gpt-image-2 / gpt-image-1 / dall-e-3), with an api_url/api_key settings card and a sidebar split-pane generation studio.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Web GUI 的 AI 生图插件：通过可配置的 OpenAI 兼容端点（gpt-image-2 / gpt-image-1 / dall-e-3）实现文生图与图生图，提供 api_url/api_key 设置卡片与侧边栏分栏生图工作台。

description.en: Open the extension side panel and it takes over the page you are browsing right now. On top of upstream it adds: hover, coordinate clicks, drag, batched action…
description.zh: 打开浏览器扩展侧边栏，就能原地接管你当前正在浏览的网页。在上游基础上补齐了：悬停、坐标点击、拖拽、批量动作链、整页截图、本地文件上传、图片地址列举，并可在多个已连接的浏览器之间切换。页面以带编号的结构化文本交给模型；动作默认需要你批准，敏感字段以掩码呈现。发布的是桥接插件，配套扩展在同一 Release 里。本项目是…

description.en: ★ 21 │ Official DingTalk connector for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: ★ 21 │ 通过钉钉连接 DSH 会话与消息。

description.en: ★ 32 │ Session-state notification plugin for the dsh web GUI: session completed/failed, question-asked, and permission-requested alerts with configurable built-in or custom sounds and browser notifications, plus a Notifications settings section
description.zh: ★ 32 │ 为会话完成、失败、提问和权限请求配置声音与浏览器通知。

description.en: Tracks DSH's file reads, image views, and code edits in WakaTime, including exact counts of lines added and deleted by AI. Keeps activity tracking running…
description.zh: 在 WakaTime 中记录 DSH 读取文件、查看图片和编辑代码的活动，并准确统计 AI 新增和删除的代码行数。DSH 回复期间持续记录活动，多个文件的记录批量上报，并在并行运行的 DSH 进程间统一控制各项目的上报频率。自动安装和更新 wakatime-cli。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Keep the flagship model in the conversation and let it dispatch scoped tasks to cheaper executor models you configure, then collect and review their reports. Pair with dsh-conductor-ui for the task board.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 让主力模型留在对话中，把范围明确的任务分派给你配置的低成本执行模型，再收集并审阅报告。任务看板需搭配 dsh-conductor-ui。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Web task board for Conductor in the right sidebar and a full page: executor and publisher roles, follow-ups, cancellation and per-session filtering. Requires @dippingorange/dsh-conductor.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ Conductor 的网页任务看板，提供右侧栏标签页和完整页面，支持执行者与发布者角色、追问、取消和按会话筛选。需先安装 @dippingorange/dsh-conductor。

description.en: ★ 31 │ Connect Qoder models with PAT credentials, regional account pools, check-ins, automatic rotation and credit display.
description.zh: ★ 31 │ 通过 PAT 接入 Qoder 模型，支持分区域账号池、签到、自动换号和积分显示。

description.en: Automatic approval and review for tool calls that need approval: keyword buckets match red lines without context, then a judge model classifies what was…
description.zh: 自动审批 / 自动审核需要审批的工具调用：先用关键词分桶做零上下文红线匹配，再交由审核模型判类别与风险等级， 按命中行与等级那一格决定自动允许、自动拒绝或转人工；判定没跑成固定转人工，自动拒绝会把原因回传给模型。

description.en: ★ 0 │ NetEase Cloud Music (music.163.com) player and AI DJ for DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar page with in-app playback, QR sign-in, and agent tools that curate the queue.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在侧栏播放网易云音乐，支持扫码登录和由 Agent 整理播放队列。

description.en: TRAE-style conversation rollback — per-turn checkpoints (10-turn sliding window) roll back touched files and truncate model context in place, keeping the same…
description.zh: TRAE 式「回退到本轮对话发起前」插件：按轮次建立检查点（10 轮滑动窗口），同时回滚工作区文件与原位截断模型上下文，保持同一 session id。回退只能由人发起：/rollback 命令或每轮的 Web 回退按钮（被中断的轮次也可用），弹窗逐条列出受影响文件及其动作（恢复/找回/删除/跳过）。

description.en: Replaces the model button with a Claude Desktop-style model and reasoning-effort switcher, with per-model effort memory, theme-aware styling, smooth slider…
description.zh: 将模型按钮替换为Claude Desktop 同款风格的模型与思考力度切换器，支持逐模型记忆力度、主题自适应，滑动手感、圆角轨道、悬停高亮，点阵动画，都是熟悉的味道。

description.en: The writable half of the right-sidebar document preview: edit and save any text file in place. Every save carries the version that was opened, so when the file…
description.zh: 右侧栏文档预览的可写一半：编辑并原地保存任意文本文件。每次保存都带上「打开时的那一版」，编辑期间磁盘上的文件被改过就停下来问，不静默覆盖；预览工具栏多出「编辑」按钮和两步确认的「删除」按钮。另有一个「文件编辑」侧栏工具，自带文件树：新建、改名 / 移动、复制 / 剪切 / 粘贴（含把系统剪贴板里的文件粘进工作区）、删除…

description.en: Lighten the load on your agent: one-click toggles for skills and MCP, so the context holds only what this turn actually needs. Skills and MCP servers you…
description.zh: 给你的 Agent 减负：Skill 与 MCP 一键启停，让上下文只装这一轮真正要用的能力。关掉的 skill / MCP 不再进入模型上下文，更干净，更省 token。

description.en: Drives a Chromium browser you are already running — Chrome, Edge, Brave, Vivaldi, Opera, Chromium, Arc or Thorium — over one long-lived CDP connection, so the…
description.zh: 通过一条常驻 CDP 连接驱动本机已在运行的 Chromium 内核浏览器——Chrome、Edge、Brave、Vivaldi、Opera、Chromium、Arc、Thorium，远程调试授权只需点一次，而不是每条命令都点。标签页、导航、执行 JS、DOM 快照、点击、输入、截图以及…

description.en: Shows a card in the sidebar footer with the DeepSeek account balance (read from the official /user/balance endpoint with the API key DSH already stores) and the unit prices of the active model — input, cache read and output — taken from a built-in snapshot of the official price table. A dot marks the current billing window and a countdown shows the time left until it flips: peak is Mon–Fri 9:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00 Beijing Time, excluding Chinese public holidays, and everything else is off-peak. Prices and the dot appear only for official DeepSeek models; for any other model the card shows the balance alone. The card refreshes every 30 seconds, on click, and when the model changes, and follows the app theme and the DSH language.
description.zh: 在侧边栏底部显示一张卡片：DeepSeek 账号余额（用 DSH 已保存的 API Key 调官方 /user/balance 接口获取），以及当前模型的档单价——输入、缓存读取、输出——取自内置的官方价格表快照。一个圆点标出当前计费时段，旁边是距离切换的倒计时：高峰为北京时间周一至周五 9:00–12:00、14:00–18:00（不含中国法定节假日），其余为空闲时段。档单价与圆点只对 DeepSeek 官方模型显示，其他模型只显示余额。卡片每 30 秒刷新一次，点击或切换模型时立即刷新，并跟随应用主题与 DSH 语言。

description.en: Two-way sync of DSH sessions, workspace mappings, settings and patches between machines through your own private GitHub repo (API keys stay machine-local).
description.zh: 通过你自己的 GitHub 私有仓库,在多台电脑间双向同步 DSH 会话、工作区对应关系、设置与托管补丁(API 密钥留在本机)。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Create one-time web forms for entering secrets into the DSH credential store or a file, with expiring links and cancellation.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 生成一次性网页表单，将用户输入的密钥写入 DSH 凭据库或文件，支持链接过期与取消。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Manage skills from a DSH Web sidebar page: view, edit, rename, import, export and enable or disable user skills; bundled and plugin-provided skills have limited actions.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在 DSH Web 侧栏查看、编辑、重命名、导入导出和启停用户技能；随包附带或插件提供的技能仅开放相应查看与导出操作。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Register speech transcription providers for IM voice messages, using a configured model, an OpenAI-compatible API or a local command. Requires a transcription service or executable.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 为 IM 语音消息提供转文字服务，可复用已配置模型、连接 OpenAI 兼容接口或调用本地命令。需配置转写服务或可执行程序。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Search and retrieve pages through configurable providers; provider API keys may be required and usage may incur charges.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 使用可配置的供应商搜索和读取网页；可能需要 API 密钥并产生费用。

description.en: ★ 14 │ Use DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 as an ACP agent in Paseo, with streaming, persistent sessions, model selection and approval controls. Requires Paseo.
description.zh: ★ 14 │ 把 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 作为 ACP Agent 接入 Paseo，支持流式输出、会话持久化、模型选择和审批控制。需要 Paseo。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Schedule one-off, interval, daily, weekly, cron or webhook tasks in DSH, delivering messages to new or existing sessions with run history.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 在 DSH 中创建一次性、间隔、每天、每周、Cron 或 Webhook 任务，向新建或已有会话投递消息，并查看运行记录。

description.en: ★ 5 │ Create a Git worktree for each DSH task, review diffs and run Git or pull request actions from the web UI. Requires Git and pnpm.
description.zh: ★ 5 │ 在 DSH 网页端为每个任务创建 Git 工作树，查看差异并执行 Git 和 PR 操作。需要 Git 与 pnpm。

description.en: Use your computer's DSH Web UI from a phone with Gitee or GitHub OAuth sign-in. Requires your own OAuth app, a fixed-domain tunnel and the package's postinstall script.
description.zh: 通过 Gitee 或 GitHub OAuth 登录，在手机上使用电脑端 DSH Web。需自备 OAuth 应用和固定域名隧道，安装时需允许运行 postinstall 脚本。

description.en: Agentic roleplay for DSH with structured worlds, autonomous characters, persistent sessions, world authoring, speech, and image generation. Requires…
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供具有结构化世界、自主角色、持久会话、世界创作、语音与图像生成功能的智能体角色扮演系统。需要安装并启用 Firefox2100/dsh-agentic-roleplay#state。

description.en: ★ 0 │ The state service of DSH Agentic Roleplay: one SQLite database per session, used by other plugins. Most users should install the complete @dsh-agentic-roleplay/all instead.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ DSH Agentic Roleplay 的状态服务，每个会话一个 SQLite 数据库，供其他插件调用。一般用户建议安装完整的 @dsh-agentic-roleplay/all。

description.en: Anthropic provider using the native Messages API for language models in DSH. Requires Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime to be installed and enabled.
description.zh: 使用原生 Messages API 为 DSH 提供语言模型能力的 Anthropic 提供商。需要安装并启用 Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Provide native Cohere v2 language models, embeddings and reranking, including streamed tool calls and model discovery. Requires the @dsh-ai-providers/runtime bundle to be installed and activated, with separately configured connections and credentials.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 提供原生 Cohere v2 语言模型、嵌入与重排序，支持流式工具调用和模型发现。需要先安装并启用 @dsh-ai-providers/runtime 组合包，并另行配置连接与凭据。

description.en: Alibaba Cloud DashScope provider for Qwen language models, embeddings, reranking, speech, and image generation through native APIs in DSH. Requires…
description.zh: 通过阿里云 DashScope 原生 API 为 DSH 提供通义千问语言模型、嵌入、重排、语音和图像生成能力。需要安装并启用 Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Provide Jina embeddings and reranking with reusable connections and DSH-managed credentials. Requires the @dsh-ai-providers/runtime bundle to be installed and activated; consumer plugins call the services.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 通过复用连接和 DSH 凭据提供 Jina 嵌入与重排序。需要先安装并启用 @dsh-ai-providers/runtime 组合包，由使用这些服务的插件调用。

description.en: LocalAI provider for language models, embeddings, reranking, speech, and image generation with LocalAI-specific controls in DSH. Requires…
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供语言模型、嵌入、重排序、语音和图像生成能力及 LocalAI 专用控制项的 LocalAI 提供商。需要安装并启用 Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime。

description.en: Ollama provider for language models and embeddings, with model discovery, loading, and unloading in DSH. Requires Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime to be…
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供语言模型、嵌入以及模型发现、加载和卸载功能的 Ollama 提供商。需要安装并启用 Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime。

description.en: OpenAI provider for language models, embeddings, text-to-speech, speech-to-text, and image generation in DSH. Requires Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime to…
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供语言模型、嵌入、文本转语音、语音转文本和图像生成能力的 OpenAI 提供商。需要安装并启用 Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Activate the shared AI provider registry and settings for language models, embeddings, reranking, speech and images. Install and activate this bundle before the Jina or Cohere provider; vendor packages and credentials are configured separately.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 启用语言模型、嵌入、重排序、语音与图像共用的 AI 提供方注册表和设置界面。使用 Jina 或 Cohere 插件前需先安装并启用本组合包，厂商插件与凭据另行配置。

description.en: TypeSafe AI Jev decision provider for typed probabilistic choices and scores in DSH. Requires Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime to be installed and enabled.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 TypeSafe AI Jev 决策能力，用于带类型的概率选择和评分。需要安装并启用 Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime。

description.en: Plugin-tree terminal UI for DeepSeek Harness — streaming markdown transcript, tool cards, fuzzy slash commands, and live theming, with every component a…
description.zh: 插件树式终端界面：流式 markdown 会话流、工具卡片、模糊命令补全与主题热切换，每个界面组件都是可热替换的 Cordis 插件。

description.en: Git service plus right-sidebar UI — a Changes tab (stage/unstage, per-file diffs, commit/amend, push and rebase-then-push sync, confirmed discard), a paged…
description.zh: Git 服务 + 右侧边栏 UI：Changes 页（暂存/取消暂存、逐文件 diff、提交/修补、推送与 rebase 同步、二次确认的丢弃）、分页 canvas 提交图谱页、Worktrees 页（列出/进入/新建工作树）、输入框旁分支选择器，以及可选的 LLM 提交信息生成。

description.en: Lets one session read, write and run bash across several folders, not just the primary root — additional roots are registered from a sidebar Folders panel or…

description.en: ★ 4 │ Rewrite the composer draft in the DeepSeek Harness desktop app with work, code and design modes, and restore the original text with one click.
description.zh: ★ 4 │ 在 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版的输入栏改写提示词，提供日常办公、代码开发和设计创意三种模式，支持一键还原原文。

description.en: ★ 38 │ Track token and cache usage, account balances and billing, with exportable records.
description.zh: ★ 38 │ 追踪 Token 与缓存用量、账户余额和费用，并导出记录。

description.en: Read-only Git and SVN code review using the current DSH agent model, with change previews, explicit context and approval-gated model requests.
description.zh: 复用当前 DSH Agent 模型只读审查 Git 与 SVN 变更，支持变更预览、显式上下文及经审批的模型请求。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Read-only Git and SVN change preview for DSH.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 面向 DSH 的只读 Git 与 SVN 变更预览。

description.en: The session page has an extra "Git" page; on the left is a preview of the non-staged/staged changes, and on the right is a diff preview with a row-level action…
description.zh: 会话页里多出一个 Git 页；左侧是未暂存 / 已暂存的改动，右侧是带行级操作条（暂存 / 丢弃）的 diff 预览。

description.en: Lets the agent see the compiled page: renders any page to an image, resolves a PDF point or a text anchor to the exact source line through SyncTeX (and says…
description.zh: 让 Agent 真正看见编译后的页面：把任意一页渲染成图片，用 SyncTeX 把页面坐标或文字锚点解析成源码 file:line（并指出某条横线是宏包画的而不是正文画的——这正是朴素定位最容易出错的地方），把这一页与上一次构建做像素对比，逐页审计本次修改新引入的空洞，并检查图表编号是否仍然顺序正确。

description.en: Keyless web search with one web_tools entry and eight actions for multi-query search, date windows, packages, papers, repositories, platforms, page reading, cited research, cache search and engine health; fuses eight engines and ships a stdio MCP server for other agents.
description.zh: 免密钥网页搜索：一个 web_tools 入口、八个 action，覆盖多查询、日期窗口、包、论文、仓库、平台、正文读取、引用研究、缓存检索与引擎健康；融合八个引擎，并提供给其他 Agent 使用的 stdio MCP server。

description.en: ★ 3 │ Run board or list tasks through DSH sessions and sync their status in host-side storage.
description.zh: ★ 3 │ 通过 DSH 会话执行看板或清单中的任务，把状态回写到宿主端共享存储。

description.en: ★ 5 │ Fish's all-in-one DSH plugin bundle, inserting plugin rows for 13 plugins in one click. Eleven are subpackages in this repo, such as approval-guide and git-graph-fish, and two are external add-ons.
description.zh: ★ 5 │ 一键添加 Fish 插件合集中的 13 个插件，其中包含本仓库组件和外部配套插件。

description.en: Adds a "用量" section to the DSH Settings page that shows your MiniMax Token Plan usage (5h and weekly windows with reset countdowns), per-model breakdown, and…
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置页「用量」section 展示 MiniMax Token Plan 的 5 小时 / 周窗口用量（带重置倒计时）、单模型明细与视频赠送额度；通过 trusted plugin 调 `/v1/token_plan/remains` 拿 key，未配置 key 时整段 section 自动隐藏。MIT。

description.en: Continuous voice conversations for DSH with hands-free listening, push-to-talk, speech recognition, TTS replies, and background Agent delegation.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供持续语音对话，支持免提监听、按住说话、语音识别、TTS 语音回复和后台 Agent 任务委派。

description.en: Workspace-isolated durable memory for DSH, with searchable, auditable, correctable, and removable workspace memories plus controlled global memory.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供工作区隔离的持久化记忆，让每个工作区拥有可检索、可审计、可纠错和可删除的独立记忆，并支持受控的全局记忆。

description.en: Multi-backend web_search provider (Exa + Firecrawl) for the built-in web_search tool, with automatic failover, per-backend 429 cooldowns, and key-free…
description.zh: 面向内置 web_search 工具的多后端搜索提供方（Exa + Firecrawl）：自动故障切换、按后端 429 冷却、无密钥匿名可用。

description.en: Hierarchical Claude Code-style memory: user + project scopes (project memories committed to git for the team), MEMORY.md index auto-injected at session start, context-window guards, pure files.
description.zh: 分层 Claude Code 式记忆：用户级+项目级双作用域（项目记忆随 git 团队共享），MEMORY.md 索引会话启动自动注入，上下文护栏，纯文件零依赖。

description.en: Generate images and videos, edit images, remove backgrounds, upscale images, upload reference media, and check Fotor credits.
description.zh: 通过 Fotor 生成图片和视频、编辑图片、移除背景、放大图片、上传参考素材及查询积分。

description.en: AI Quota & Usage Monitor for DSH: real-time balance and reset countdown tracking for Codex, Cursor, Google Antigravity, and OpenCode-Go.
description.zh: DSH 的 AI 额度与用量监控：实时追踪 Codex、Cursor、Google Antigravity 与 OpenCode-Go 剩余额度与重置倒计时。

description.en: Imports the MCP servers Codex and Claude Code already declare as dsh mcp-client tools, links the skills of 22 known agent skill directories into ~/.dsh/skills…
description.zh: 把 Codex 与 Claude Code 已声明的 MCP 服务器接入 dsh 的 mcp-client，把 22 个已知 Agent 技能目录的技能以符号链接（不复制文件）导入 ~/.dsh/skills，并提供设置页：列出本次实际挂载的服务器与技能、逐项启停技能、重名时改选来源。

description.en: Auto-resumes interrupted DSH turns: sends a queued 「继续」 after turn/end with error, interrupted or max-tokens reasons, with a grace period, cooldown,…
description.zh: 回合中断自动续跑：turn/end 因 error / interrupted / max-tokens 结束时自动发送「继续」，支持宽限期、冷却、指数退避、连续次数上限、启动扫描、设置卡片，以及输入框工具行的会话级停止/恢复按钮；不切换模型/provider。

description.en: Prompt library above the DSH composer — a 📚 button expands a searchable panel to insert saved prompts into the draft with one click (appends, never…
description.zh: 输入框上方的提示词库：📚 按钮展开可搜索面板，点条目一键填入草稿（追加不覆盖）；数据以 JSON 文件保存在 Host 侧。

description.en: Persistent image or MP4 wallpaper for the DSH Web profile: a wallpaper card under Settings -> General selects a local image or MP4 (up to 300 MB), tunes…
description.zh: DSH Web 持久化背景图/视频插件：在 设置 -> 通用 中提供壁纸卡片，可选本地图片或 MP4（最大 300 MB），调节表层透明度与模糊；检测到 ffmpeg/ffprobe 时在本机把视频压缩为 H.264；媒体保存到 ~/.dsh/wallpapers；并将 Web 服务固定到 9191…

description.en: Reverse tunnel for the DSH Web GUI: exposes a `dsh --profile web` deployment at a public frp URL and switches the directory picker to the in-app browser, so a…
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 反向隧道：通过 frp 把 `dsh --profile web` 发布到公网地址，目录选择器改用应用内浏览器，手机或远程机器可直接打开并管理工作区。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Permanently deletes a DeepSeek Harness conversation and all its local data: session log, derived caches, workspace index entries, spill files, and unreferenced attachments.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 永久删除会话及其本地数据，包括日志、缓存、工作区索引记录和不再引用的附件。

description.en: Local token usage and cost dashboard for DeepSeek Harness: four-segment token breakdown (miss/cache-hit/cache-write/output), cache savings estimate against the…
description.zh: DSH 本地 Token 用量与成本统计仪表盘：四段 Token 构成（未命中/缓存命中/缓存写入/输出）、按未命中与命中的价差估算缓存省钱、会话下钻（上下文增长曲线与异常激增标记）、全局筛选可分享 URL、月度预算环形进度与月底外推、日/月聚合快路径查询（O(天数)）+ 增量扫描。

description.en: Adds a Delete Session row to every sidebar session '...' menu (the official harness has archive/pin/rename/fork only, no durable delete). One-click Force…
description.zh: 给侧边栏每个会话的"…"菜单加上"删除会话"（官方只有归档/置顶/重命名/分叉，无持久 删除）。一键「强制删除」：逐出宿主内存态会话、停止后台工作后，彻底清除会话日志、 投影缓存与注册表记账，已连接的桌面 Web 端即时清行、不留幽灵。会话生成的工作区文件 保留，对话记录永久删除；第三方云端镜像（如经 Agents…

description.en: ★ 549 │ Store conversation knowledge in Markdown cognitive graphs with recall and reflection tools.
description.zh: ★ 549 │ 将会话知识保存到 Markdown 认知图，提供召回与反思工具。

description.en: ★ 262 │ Fylar Office Editor integration for the DeepSeek Harness Web profile, powered by Fylar Office SDK
description.zh: ★ 262 │ 在 DSH 网页中接入 Fylar Office SDK 文档编辑器。

description.en: Adds a Plan/Build mode toggle to the composer, switched with the Tab key or a toolbar button, and remembers a separate model for each mode from the native…
description.zh: 在输入框中提供 Plan/Build 模式切换：按 Tab 键或点击工具栏按钮即可切换，并按模式分别记住右侧原生模型选择器中所选的模型。

description.en: AI-agent-driven automated testing platform for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): drives the harness agent through long-lived multi-round sessions to write and run…
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）的 AI 智能体驱动自动化测试平台：以长期多轮会话驱动 agent 编写并执行 Markdown 用例、产出 bug 报告、修复代码并复验，配套按项目串行的统一队列、开发看板与内置压测。

description.en: ★ 10 │ Restart or upgrade DSH, inspect runtime health, and manage backups and Linux permissions from a web panel.
description.zh: ★ 10 │ 在网页面板中重启或升级 DSH、查看运行状态，并管理备份和 Linux 权限。

description.en: ★ 29 │ Agent-Native document handling for DSH — addressable blocks let an agent read and edit one section instead of the whole file. Ships the geml MCP server and the authoring and code-graph skills.

★ 32 │ 提取和检索 PDF 内容，通过内置阅读器配合会话阅读论文。
description.en: ★ 32 │ Transcribe and search PDFs, then read papers with a built-in viewer and conversation tools.
Host-neutral durable DAG workflows for Agents with CLI, MCP, on-demand Skills, triggers, replay, and a visual Canvas.
description.zh: 面向 Agent 的 Host-neutral 持久化 DAG 工作流，提供 CLI、MCP、按需 Skill、Trigger、重放和可视化 Canvas。

description.en: Bing-backed web search provider for the built-in web_search tool: prefers Bing's RSS feed with the public cn.bing.com HTML page as fallback, no API key,…
description.zh: 为内置 web_search 工具提供 Bing 搜索源：优先解析 Bing 的 RSS 输出，以 cn.bing.com 公开 HTML 结果页作为兜底，无需 API Key，国内可直连，搜索不再消耗模型自带的搜索额度。端点、结果数量与结果语言可配置；适配 DSH 0.2.x（0.1.7+ 亦可用）。

description.en: Connect a sub2api gateway to DeepSeek Harness: OpenAI-compatible multi-provider routes (OpenAI / Claude / Grok / Gemini) behind one base URL, with per-key…
description.zh: 将 sub2api 网关接入 DeepSeek Harness：用一个 base URL 统一管理 OpenAI / Claude / Grok / Gemini 等多供应商路由，支持按 key 发现模型、用量查询与全局视觉/图像生成工具。

description.en: Preset engineering workflows for DeepSeek Harness: a dev_task tool that gates stage transitions, artifacts, verification, review and commit scope, plus a web workbench for installing project or user skills and rules.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供预设工程流程：dev_task 工具把阶段流转、产物、验证、审核与提交范围做成硬门禁，并带一个安装项目级与个人级技能和规则的工作台。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Append a passage from a browser-local book below the real reasoning or tool output when you expand selected native chat regions. Imports EPUB/TXT/MD and remembers book progress without writing novel text to the conversation. Declares only DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 and Node >=22; depends on chat DOM. EPUB is text-only and excludes DRM.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 主动展开选中的原生聊天区域时，在真实思考或工具输出下追加本地小说，支持 EPUB/TXT/MD 导入和各书进度；小说不写入会话数据。仅声明兼容 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2、Node >=22，依赖聊天 DOM；EPUB 只取文字，不支持 DRM。

description.en: Fail-closed runtime tool-call loop guard for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供故障关闭式运行时工具调用循环防护。

description.en: ClineBot and ClinePass integration for DeepSeek Harness: dedicated settings page, live quota dashboard, in-UI key saving, curated and custom model selection, and a /cline command.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 ClineBot/ClinePass 集成：专属设置页、实时配额仪表板、界面内密钥保存、精选与自定义模型选择，以及 /cline 命令。

description.en: AST-based context compression, test log filtering, and token budget guard for DeepSeek Harness: strips redundant syntax, prunes noisy log lines, and enforces a token ceiling so the context window never overflows.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 AST 上下文压缩、测试日志过滤与 Token 预算守卫：剔除冗余语法、精简日志噪声，并强制执行 Token 上限以防止上下文窗口溢出。

description.en: Scheduled cron tasks, background automation and agent execution for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供定时任务、后台自动化与 Agent 执行。

description.en: Gitea and Forgejo integration for DeepSeek Harness with issue, pull-request and worktree tools plus a Git status chip.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 集成 Gitea 与 Forgejo，提供 issue、拉取请求和 worktree 工具及 Git 状态芯片。

description.en: Goal mode and autonomous execution plugin for DeepSeek Harness: a sticky top banner keeps the current goal visible across turns while the agent works toward it…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的目标模式与自主执行插件：顶部吸附横幅在每轮对话中保持当前目标可见，同时 Agent 自主推进完成目标。

description.en: Adds an x_search tool for X/Twitter search to DeepSeek Harness, authenticated through a separate SuperGrok OAuth account so it does not consume the session…
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加用于 X/Twitter 搜索的 x_search 工具，通过独立的 SuperGrok OAuth 账号鉴权，不占用会话所用提供方的配额。

description.en: ★ 12 │ Add a generate_image tool backed by FAL, any OpenAI-compatible image API or a ChatGPT/Grok subscription, with results shown inline and optional approval and budget limits.
description.zh: ★ 12 │ 提供 generate_image 工具，可接 FAL、OpenAI 兼容的图像接口或 ChatGPT/Grok 订阅，图片直接显示在对话中，可设置审批和预算上限。

description.en: Collects and redacts DSH runtime diagnostics before filing structured issues in GitHub or Gitea.
description.zh: 收集并脱敏 DSH 运行诊断信息，然后向 GitHub 或 Gitea 提交结构化问题报告。

description.en: Visual Kanban board for DeepSeek Harness with Gitea-backed tasks, workflow columns and a dedicated agent session per task.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可视化看板，支持 Gitea 任务、工作流列和每任务独立 Agent 会话。

description.en: Shows API-key and subscription quota limits in the DSH provider interface and settings.
description.zh: 在 DSH 界面与设置中显示 API Key 和订阅账户的额度限制。

description.en: Keeps a pool of API keys per provider with auto-created clone routes, switches to the next key on quota or rate-limit errors, probes cooled keys for recovery, and exposes the pools, cooldown and switch codes in a Settings section.
description.zh: 为每个提供方维护 API Key 池并自动创建克隆路由，在配额或限流错误时切换到下一个 Key，主动探测冷却中的 Key 以便恢复，并在设置中提供 Key 池、冷却时间与切换状态码的编辑界面。

description.en: LAN and reverse-proxy access to the DeepSeek Harness web UI: returns the settings service on pages that are not localhost, fills in the web APIs a browser withholds over plain HTTP, and can open a listener of its own.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页 UI 提供局域网与反向代理访问：在非 localhost 页面返回设置服务，补齐浏览器在纯 HTTP 下限制的 Web API，并可自行开启监听端口。

description.en: Renders HTML, React (JSX/TSX), Vue, SVG, Mermaid and Markdown written by the agent in an isolated iframe sandbox with SSE hot-reload, and adds a DOM click…
description.zh: 在隔离的 iframe 沙箱中实时渲染 Agent 生成的 HTML、React (JSX/TSX)、Vue、SVG、Mermaid 和 Markdown，支持 SSE 热重载，并提供 DOM 点击检查器、并排视觉对比、响应式设备矩阵和一键 Vite ZIP 导出。

description.en: Telegram bridge for DeepSeek Harness: bidirectional sessions, conversation steering, home-channel routing, and TTS voice notes sent as Telegram audio messages.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Telegram 桥接：双向会话、对话引导、主频道路由，以及以 Telegram 语音消息发送的 TTS 语音笔记。

description.en: Mixture-of-Agents plugin for DeepSeek Harness: a /moa slash command fans a prompt out to multiple models in parallel, merges their responses in a file workspace, and integrates with Live Canvas for visual output.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的混合智能体（MoA）插件：/moa 斜杠命令将提示词并发分发给多个模型，在文件工作区合并响应，并与 Live Canvas 集成以呈现可视化输出。

description.en: Synchronizes the model catalog of API-key providers from the provider itself instead of maintaining the model list by hand.
description.zh: 自动从服务商同步 API Key 提供方的模型列表，无需手动维护。

description.en: SSH/SFTP remote workspaces with conflict-aware mirror sync, port forwarding, and a native Web UI.
description.zh: 支持冲突感知镜像同步、端口转发和原生 Web UI 的 SSH/SFTP 远程工作区。

description.en: Adds Russian as a native option in Settings - General - Language for DeepSeek Harness, covering both the core UI and companion plugins. Localized Markdown export, in-message translation, live typography, slash-command aliases and an Alt+L layout fix, plus a settings card, all applied through a runtime locale snapshot rather than by modifying core files.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的「设置 - 通用 - 语言」加入俄语，覆盖核心界面与生态插件的词条。提供会话 Markdown 导出、消息内嵌翻译、实时排版、斜杠命令别名与 Alt+L 布局更正，以及一张设置卡片，全部通过运行时 locale 快照实现，不修改核心文件。

description.en: Session management for the DSH sidebar: pin conversations, search their contents, read archived transcripts and hide noise.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏会话管理：固定对话、搜索内容、读取归档记录并隐藏噪音。

description.en: Background security auditor for DeepSeek Harness: scans agent outputs for secret leakage, checks command safety before execution, and surfaces findings in a…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的后台安全审计器：扫描 Agent 输出中的秘密泄漏，在执行前检查命令安全性，并将发现记录到持久化审计日志中。

description.en: Smart checkpoints, workspace safety guards and instant rollback for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供智能检查点、工作区安全防护和即时回滚。

description.en: Speaks agent replies in the DeepSeek Harness web UI through a provider fallback chain (OpenAI, ElevenLabs, Google, Azure, Groq, Deepgram, OpenRouter, Edge, Piper, eSpeak), so a failing or rate-limited provider falls through to the next instead of going silent.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页 UI 中朗读智能体回复，采用服务商回退链（OpenAI、ElevenLabs、Google、Azure、Groq、Deepgram、OpenRouter、Edge、Piper、eSpeak），某个服务商失败或被限流时自动切换到下一个，而不是直接静音。

description.en: Normalizes malformed token-usage samples so broken session histories remain loadable.
description.zh: 规范化异常的 Token 用量样本，使损坏的会话历史仍可加载。

description.en: Routes images to a vision model of your choice - auto-rewrite, explicit tools, or hybrid - so a text-only chat model does not fail a turn that contains a…

description.en: Stop a running background job from the session-header job list, with a confirmation dialog that restates the full command.

description.en: Agent persona: gives DSH one global persona (name, language, persona prompt) that every new session carries at the front of its system prompt, plus a long-term…
description.zh: Agent人格：给 DSH 一份全局人格（名称、语言、人格提示词），每个新会话的系统提示都带着它，外加一份长期记忆，聊天里点一下就能把选中的对话提炼进去；自带三个内置预设，装好默认启用大肥鱼人格；侧栏会话行还能直接删除会话。

description.en: Built-in browser: gives the agent a real headed Chromium it can open, click, type and scroll in, keeping page state across calls.
description.zh: 内置浏览器：给 Agent 一个真实的有头 Chromium，可打开网页并点击、输入、滚动，页面状态在多次调用之间保持。

description.en: Edit and regenerate: adds an edit action to user message bubbles, regenerating from that message with images and files carried over and the original model…
description.zh: 编辑重发：在用户消息气泡上多一个「编辑」，改完从那条消息重新生成，图片与文件随行重传，模型继承原会话。

description.en: Prompt enhancement: click the star button in the composer to have the current model rewrite the draft more clearly, with one click back to the original; the…
description.zh: 增强提示词：点击发送框的星形按钮，用当前模型把草稿改写得更清晰，可一键切回原文；模板可编辑。

description.en: Agent skills: browse, toggle and edit skills in the management page, and let the agent write new ones itself.
description.zh: Agent技能：在管理页里浏览、开关、编辑技能，也能让 Agent 自己写新技能。

description.en: Refractive liquid-glass skin: custom wallpapers, several tunable refracting glass surfaces, wallpapers that rotate by time of day, four theme colours, a…
description.zh: 可折射的液态玻璃皮肤 UI：可自定义壁纸、多个可调折射液态玻璃面、随时段轮换的壁纸、四档主题色、选中项带水滴状高亮飞镜、右下可自定义每个控件参数。

description.en: ★ 2 │ Manage global or project skills and MCP servers, and inspect the tools exposed by each server.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 管理全局或项目级技能与 MCP 服务器，并查看服务器提供的工具。

description.en: Customer-machine access plugin for deepseek-harness-gateway: opens a single outbound WebSocket to the gateway and relays the machine local dsh web UI over that…
description.zh: 客户机接入插件：以单条出站 WebSocket 连接网关，把本机 dsh web 界面经隧道转发给门户，配对接入码 + HMAC 认证；无需入站端口、端口映射或公网 IP。

description.en: Ports the obra/superpowers methodology as 14 native DSH skills covering planning, TDD, debugging, and code review.
description.zh: 将 obra/superpowers 方法论移植为 14 个原生 DSH 技能，覆盖规划、TDD、调试与代码评审。

description.en: Opens the official DeepSeek web app (chat.deepseek.com) inside DeepSeek Harness: one sidebar entry renders the real page in the center column through the…
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内打开 chat.deepseek.com 官方网页版：点侧边栏入口，真实页面通过桌面端的原生浏览器访客渲染在中栏，并且重启后保持登录。模型选择、深度思考、智能搜索、历史记录、附件上传仍是官方那一套；宿主没有该访客桥接时降级为打开窗口。

description.en: Pre-execution guard: a `tools.guard` predicate decides allow, ask or refuse per permission preset for dangerous shell commands (git hook bypass, catastrophic…
description.zh: 执行前拦截：`tools.guard` 谓词按当前权限档位，对危险 shell 命令（跳过 git 钩子、灾难性 `rm`、下载即执行、重写 git 历史）与「写凭据路径」「没读过目标文件的首次编辑」逐条给出放行 / 询问 / 拒绝，并把成因与可行替代写法交回模型。

description.en: Two buttons beside the chat input: one rewrites the draft with the current directory in view, the other inserts a role template from 85 curated entries…
description.zh: 对话输入框旁的两个按钮：一个结合当前目录改写草稿，另一个插入角色模板——默认 85 条精选模板由随包携带的 `agents/` 角色库生成，设置卡可用自己的 `.md` 角色文件扩充。

description.en: Turns guard denials, gate failures and human thumb-downs into project lessons, and injects only the rules a human has armed into each new session of that…
description.zh: 把拦截拒绝、门禁失败与人工差评沉淀为项目教训，只把人工确认过的规则注入该项目之后的新会话；它不注册模型工具，通过设置卡评审规则。

description.en: ★ 0 │ dsh workspace code review plugin: wraps open-code-review (ocr CLI) as 5 model tools, plus a settings card that applies a provider and model from the host provider list to the OCR config.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 将 open-code-review 命令行接入 DSH 代码审查，并在设置中选择审查所用的供应商和模型。

description.en: Turn-end quality gate: when the turn edited code or config it walks each file up to its project root, runs that root one check from a fixed whitelist (`pnpm…
description.zh: 回合收口质量门禁：本回合改过代码或配置时，把改过的文件逐个上溯到项目根，从固定白名单里为该根跑一条检查（`pnpm check` / `cargo check` / `ruff check .` / `tsc --noEmit`）；只有真跑过且失败才带着输出开新轮修复，而不是让回合直接收尾。

description.en: Wraps the Scrapling Python library in up to nineteen model tools, registered by probed capability: real-browser rendering for JavaScript-only pages, CSS/XPath…
description.zh: 把 Scrapling Python 库包成最多十九个模型工具，按探测到的能力注册：为纯 JavaScript 页面上真实浏览器渲染、用 CSS/XPath 取出结构化数据而不是 Markdown、选择器自愈、可复用的登录态会话、XHR 抓取、页面截图、受部署门禁的浏览器动作，以及在官方作业后端上跑的限定域爬虫（con…

description.en: Automatic recovery when a turn ends badly: resume after a transient failure, continue after output truncation, re-run after an unfinished todo list, plus a…
description.zh: 回合异常收尾时的自动补救：瞬时失败后续跑、输出截断后继续、待办未完成时重跑，另有一层请求级 429 兜底，以及带「改后重发 / 手动重试 / 停止并重问」的客户端停靠栏。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Semantic workspace search plugin for DSH (zg): zg_search, zg_index, and zg_status, plus a local embedding settings card, systemPrompt routing rules, and a guard safety net.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 用 Zvec 对工作区建立语义索引并搜索，提供本地向量模型配置和调用规则。

description.en: Connect a DSH Agent to Minecraft Java servers with Mineflayer, a live game view alongside native reasoning and tools, configurable personas, server-scoped…
description.zh: 让 DSH Agent 通过 Mineflayer 进入 Minecraft Java 服务器，在实时游戏画面旁查看原生推理与工具，配置人格、按服务器隔离的笔记及可选本地生存知识检索；复用宿主模型，安装本身不连接游戏或启动推理。

description.en: ★ 7 │ Connect a ChatGPT account, choose a proxy, and view usage and reset credits.
description.zh: ★ 7 │ 连接 ChatGPT 账户，选择代理，并查看用量、剩余额度及重置时间。

description.en: ★ 7 │ Codex-style streaming, thinking blocks, tool activity, and deliverable previews.
description.zh: ★ 7 │ 提供 Codex 风格的流式回复、思考内容、工具活动和产物预览。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Set image input and reasoning levels for third-party provider models.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 为第三方模型设置图片输入能力和推理强度。

description.en: 11 shareable workflow skills (handoff, triage, to-spec, to-tickets, wayfinder, teach, wait-what, dsh-mode-routing, ask-matt, overnight-execution,…
description.zh: 11 个可分享的工作流 skills（handoff、triage、to-spec、to-tickets、wayfinder、teach、wait-what、dsh-mode-routing、ask-matt、overnight-execution、full-throttle），打包为可安装 bundle。

description.en: DSH bundle that registers 13 native codegraph_* tools wrapping the codegraph CLI, so agents bootstrap, maintain, and query a pre-indexed code knowledge graph…
description.zh: DSH 插件，注册 13 个原生 codegraph_* 工具包装 codegraph CLI，让代理初始化、维护并查询预索引的代码知识图谱（符号查询、区域探索、节点轨迹、callers/callees、影响分析、受影响测试），无需 grep 文件。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Rewrite the composer draft through an auxiliary model, or request a command result without changing the draft.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 通过辅助模型改写输入框草稿，也可用命令查看结果而不修改草稿。

description.en: ★ 5 │ DeepSeek Harness bundle: the read_document tool reads Word, PowerPoint, Excel, OpenDocument, RTF, EPUB, CSV, and PDF files as Markdown for the model
description.zh: ★ 5 │ 将 Word、PPT、Excel、OpenDocument、RTF、EPUB、CSV 和 PDF 转为模型可读的 Markdown。

description.en: Right-click any file reference in the chat to open it, open it with an associated application, reveal it in the file manager, copy its path or contents, and…
description.zh: 右键聊天里的任意文件引用，即可打开、用系统关联应用打开、在文件管理器中定位、复制路径或文件内容、另存为。

description.en: Manage MCP servers and skills in DeepSeek Harness, and control which tools enter the next prompt.
description.zh: 管理 MCP 服务器与 Skill，并控制下一轮 prompt 带入哪些工具。

description.en: Bridges the LiuHe MCP code toolkit (44 tools) into dsh web: repo_map, symbol search, edit_batch with tolerant matching, transactional edits with undo journal,…
description.zh: 将 LiuHe MCP 代码工具集（44 个工具）桥接进 dsh web：repo_map、符号搜索、带容错匹配的 edit_batch、带撤销日志的事务性编辑，以及确定性质量门禁——由崩溃隔离的 Rust tree-sitter 解析守护进程和 SQLite 索引支撑。

description.en: Plugin trust pipeline for DeepSeek Harness: deterministic static scan with verdicts, opt-in runtime guard with honeypot lures, agent audit-protocol skill, and…
description.zh: DSH 插件信任流水线：确定性静态扫描判定、可选运行时守卫与蜜罐诱饵、agent 审查协议技能与浏览器盾牌状态灯，只报警不执法。

description.en: ★ 23 │ Command Code Go provider adapter for dsh: scan the Go-plan model catalog dynamically and serve /alpha/generate through the harness LLM seam
description.zh: ★ 23 │ 接入 Command Code Go 套餐，自动读取可用模型并在 DSH 中调用。

description.en: ★ 40 │ OpenCode Zen free models provider for dsh
description.zh: ★ 40 │ 为 DSH 接入 OpenCode Zen 免费模型通道。

description.en: Integrates coding agent CLIs, persistent terminals and remote workspaces into the native DeepSeek Harness interface.
description.zh: 将十几种编程助手 CLI、持久终端与远程工作区接入 DSH 原生界面。

description.en: Local development service console for DSH: lists every listening service on the machine and lets users inspect, safely stop, or restart services that were…
description.zh: DSH 本地开发服务控制台：列出本机所有监听服务，并让用户查看、以安全方式停止或重启开发过程中启动的服务。

description.en: ★ 43 │ Browse, search and preview workspace files, then insert references by clicking or dragging.
description.zh: ★ 43 │ 在侧栏浏览、搜索和预览文件，点击或拖拽插入引用。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Withdraw turns from the visible conversation and model context while preserving logs and quarantining affected file changes.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 撤回指定轮次，使其退出界面与模型上下文；保留日志，并隔离相关文件改动。

description.en: Improve the current chat draft before sending with a confirm-before-apply comparison.
description.zh: 在发送前优化当前聊天输入，采用前先对比原文与优化结果。

description.en: A governed swarm of six specialist DSH agents — orchestrator, planner, knowledge-base bridge, developer and two reviewers — turns a requirement into a strict…
description.zh: 一个受管的智能体蜂群（swarm）：六种专职 DSH 智能体——编排、规划、知识库桥接、开发，以及方案评审与代码评审——把需求转化为严格阶段流水线；每阶段交付必须先以结构化证据自证，下一阶段才放行；评审只读、代码仅评审通过后合并，追加式事件日志支持全程回放与审计，实时看板同步展示。其设计灵感源自 Hermes…

description.en: Zen Mode view tab and foreground time tracker for DeepSeek Harness: while the agent works, a calm conversation view shows running/done status, your latest user…
description.zh: 禅模式视图 + 前台盯屏时间统计插件：智能体后台运行时提供极简 Zen 标签页（进行中/结束状态文案、用户消息、动态提示、Markdown 渲染最终回复、单行轮次统计），统计前台盯屏时长并给出每日/每周禅值，支持一键隐藏中间过程（工具调用/推理行）、任务开始完成时自动进出禅、Alt+Z 快捷键与 Zen…

description.en: Run Blender headless from DeepSeek Harness: execute bpy scripts, render scenes and export glTF assets, with modeling cookbook, 5.x pitfall list and…
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里以 headless 方式跑 Blender：执行 bpy 脚本、渲染场景、导出 glTF 资产，并附带建模技法库、5.x 踩坑清单与资产管线手册（技能包），让 agent 在交付前自检几何。

description.en: Production pack for ComfyUI inside DeepSeek Harness: submit API-format workflows to a local or remote server, batch-generate and fetch outputs, and diagnose…
description.zh: ComfyUI 在 DeepSeek Harness 里的生产包：向本地或远程服务提交 API 格式工作流、批量出图并取回产物，附实测参数区间与崩图排查决策树（黑图、主体重复、彩边、显存不足）。

description.en: Three-layer memory for DeepSeek Harness — a small always-on core block plus on-demand topic files (profile, preferences, decisions, lessons), with…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的三层记忆：常驻小索引加按需读取的主题文件（画像、偏好、决策、教训），写入带来源标注、冲突取代留痕，让偏好与项目约束跨会话不漂移。本地优先：无向量库、无服务端、零出站。

description.en: Rotates images and videos from a media folder as the DSH UI background, with panel controls for the rotation interval and UI opacity.
description.zh: 把媒体目录中的图片与视频自动轮换为 DSH 界面背景，面板可调轮播间隔与界面透明度。

description.en: DSH environment diagnosis, graded repair with one-click rollback, and a runtime self-healing service.
description.zh: DSH 环境诊断、分级修复与一键回滚，附带运行时自愈服务。

description.en: One-click upgrade to Deepseek Harness, with version number displayed in the sidebar.
description.zh: 一键升级Deepseek Harness, 支持侧边栏显示版本号.

description.en: ★ 1 │ Incrementally mirror individual DSH session logs, preview fuzzy-match restores and optionally clean expired backups. Defaults to ~/.dsh/sessions and E:\DshChatBackup; configure a usable backup destination. Automatic cleanup is off by default.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 逐会话增量镜像 DSH 日志，支持模糊匹配恢复预览和可选的过期备份清理。默认读取 ~/.dsh/sessions，备份到 E:\DshChatBackup，使用前请配置可用目录；自动清理默认关闭。

description.en: Adds a Delete session item to the sidebar session-row menu; the confirmation mode is configurable (click again, confirm in a dialog, or delete immediately) and…
description.zh: 在侧边栏会话行菜单中加入「删除会话」项，确认方式可配置（再次点击、对话框确认或直接删除），正在执行任务的会话会被拒绝删除。

description.en: ★ 0 │ DeepSeek Harness Web plugin that runs a user-defined command after the web profile has started successfully.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在 DSH 网页服务成功启动后，执行用户设定的命令。

description.en: Semantic-layer analytics tool that uses curated table, column and metric metadata with Qdrant and Elasticsearch recall to generate, validate and execute MySQL…
description.zh: 基于人工维护的表、字段和指标语义元数据，结合 Qdrant 与 Elasticsearch 召回，通过析问服务生成、校验并执行 MySQL 分析查询。

description.en: Heartbeat loop for DeepSeek Harness: every 20 minutes (by default) the agent wakes on its own to keep a local profile of your interests and preferences, search the web for things you care about, and keep what it finds. When it has something worth sharing, it sends a short package of notes to the sessions you link it to. A set of rules in code - quiet hours, busy windows, a daily limit, a cooldown - decides whether it may speak at all, and the agent in that session decides whether to actually say anything. Windows only.
description.zh: 心跳循环：默认每 20 分钟自己醒一次——维护一份关于你兴趣与偏好的本地画像，按你设的兴趣范围上网搜新东西并存下来。攒到值得分享的内容，就向你绑定的会话送一份简短的素材包。能不能开口由代码里的规则决定（静默时段、忙时窗口、每日上限、冷却），说不说由那个会话里的 agent 自己判断。仅支持 Windows。

description.en: Deterministic engineering orchestration runtime for DeepSeek Harness: the orbit_controller tool and OrbitService run Commander, Executor and Smart Watchdog…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的确定性工程编排运行时：orbit_controller 工具与 OrbitService 以 Commander / Executor / Smart Watchdog 子代理执行 PLAN、EXECUTE、EVALUATE、有界修正与运行时恢复，持久状态保存在…

description.en: Keenable web search and page fetch for the built-in web_search and web_fetch tools, working with any model and no API key.
description.zh: 为内置 web_search 与 web_fetch 工具提供 Keenable 网页搜索与网页读取，适用于任意模型，无需 API Key。

description.zh: 钢琴键风格会话内导航条：一根键锚定一条用户消息，悬停显示消息预览气泡与阶梯展开，点击平滑跳转。

description.en: ★ 50 │ Cross-session long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness (memory palace · AGI Architecture Exploration on dsh-market): dual-scope SQLite memory graph, hybrid retrieval, provenance audit, and a knowledge flywheel.
description.zh: ★ 50 │ 用 SQLite 记忆图、混合检索和来源记录保存跨会话知识。

description.en: RainbowSpeak — a flowing rainbow marquee border around the chat composer card, driven by a conic-gradient ring. Live settings for speed, width, seven color…
description.zh: 虹语（RainbowSpeak）——沿聊天输入框边界持续流动的彩虹跑马灯，由锥形渐变环带驱动。支持流速、宽度、七种配色、方向、边与呼吸效果的实时设置，并具备会话状态感知：运行中加速、需关注变琥珀、出错红脉冲、庆祝闪动。

description.en: ★ 94 │ Usage billing dashboard for DeepSeek Harness: sidebar cost metrics plus a full dashboard modal, priced from a current multi-provider catalog with real usage aggregated from session logs.
description.zh: ★ 94 │ 从会话日志汇总实际用量，显示多供应商价格与侧栏费用指标。

description.zh: 保险精算师（insurance-actuary）——真跑精算测算：寿险/财险准备金评估（偿二代二期 BEL+RM）、利润测试（NBV/VNB/IRR）、内含价值(EV)、产品定价与损失三角准备金，而非仅讲解。

description.en: Insurance company financial & operating analyst — solvency, financials, investment, distribution channels and peer comparison with real calculations.
description.zh: 保险公司财务经营分析专家，真跑偿付能力、财务报表、投资、渠道与同业对标测算。

description.en: Insurance company operations analyst — runs real solvency, profitability, embedded value (EV), investment risk and regulatory compliance calculations, not just…
description.zh: 保险公司经营分析专家（盈安），真跑偿付能力、盈利能力、内含价值(EV)、投资风险与监管合规五维测算。

description.zh: 保险产品对比与建议书专家（险析君），条款拆解、性价比测算、保障规划，生成可自核 PDF 建议书。

description.en: Title-bar balance badge for DeepSeek Harness: account balance, today's cost, session tokens, and peak/off-peak pricing awareness (Beijing-time weekday windows)…
description.zh: 标题栏余额徽章：余额、今日花费、本会话 tokens 一目了然，官方按峰谷时段计价展示，TokenBom 等自定义服务商按平价展示。

description.en: Codex-style model selector for the composer listing every provider/model in the profile, with four reasoning-effort levels and per-session persistence;…
description.zh: 输入框内的 Codex 风格模型选择器：列出 profile 全部 provider/model，四档推理力度，选择按会话记忆；原生选择器的禁用补丁随包内置。

description.en: Floating toolbar on text selection in conversations: add the quote to the composer, start a new discussion from it, or copy it; quotes collapse into a card…
