description.zh: 在配额、速率限制或身份验证失败后轮换已配置的 LLM API 密钥。

description.en: Wraps colbymchenry/codegraph into agent tools - status, search, callers/callees, impact, explore, and more.
description.zh: 将 colbymchenry/codegraph 封装到代理工具中 - status、search、callers/callees、impact、explore 等等。

description.en: Tone or voice alerts for DSH approvals, questions, completions, errors and stalls; reads out what is waiting and repeats until handled; no network requests.
description.zh: DSH 提醒音：审批、提问、完成、错误、卡住各有音色；选「语音」会念出工具名、原因或问题原文；未处理会重复提醒，全程不联网。

description.en: ★ 0 │ The /cron command for DeepSeek Harness: runs a prompt on a cron expression or plain-English schedule, parsed in code, with the model as a last resort.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 通过 /cron 按 cron 表达式或自然语言安排定时任务，优先由代码解析，必要时使用模型。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Google Vertex AI provider for DeepSeek Harness: service-account auth for Google-hosted Claude and Gemini models.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 通过服务账号接入 Google Vertex AI，使用其托管的 Claude 和 Gemini 模型。

description.en: Registers a configurable prompt variable so an agent preset whose persona uses complete: true can still receive an injected text block; the plugin ships no…
description.zh: 注册一个可配置的 prompt 变量，让使用 complete: true 人格的 agent 预设也能收到一段注入文本；插件本身不含内容，文本由配置提供。

description.en: Generates UI wireframes and high-fidelity mockups in DeepSeek Harness with selectable DashScope and Volcengine image providers.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中使用可切换的阿里云百炼与火山方舟图像服务生成 UI 线框图和高保真设计稿。

description.en: Syncs the groups, keys and models of one sub2api instance into dsh-llm-pi-ai provider routes, with panel-driven login (password / OAuth) and one provider route…
description.zh: 将一个 sub2api 实例的分组、密钥与模型同步为 dsh-llm-pi-ai 的 provider 路由，支持面板登录（密码 / OAuth），一条中转密钥对应一条 provider 路由。

description.en: DSH bundle that vendors the full mattpocock/skills tree, preserves upstream invocation policies, and applies an exact-match DSH semantic overlay checked during…
description.zh: 将完整 mattpocock/skills 技能树打包为 DSH 插件，保留上游调用策略，并在自动同步上游时校验和应用精确匹配的 DSH 语义适配层。

description.en: Sidebar account-balance quick view for DeepSeek Harness: balance, bonus credit, current model and the official peak/off-peak pricing period, with…
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏账户余额快捷查看：显示余额、赠送额度、当前模型和官方高峰 / 空闲计费时段，按余额分四档显示质感，余额过低时提醒。

description.en: ★ 445 │ Register Command Code models and a provider configuration card in DSH.
description.zh: ★ 445 │ 在 DSH 中注册 Command Code 模型与供应商配置卡片。

description.en: Rich Markdown notebook for the composer region: a tool-row toggle plus a CodeMirror editor card with Codex-style list editing, submitted through the…
description.zh: 为输入区提供富 Markdown 笔记本：工具行开关加 CodeMirror 编辑卡片，支持 Codex 风格列表编辑，经会话服务提交。

description.en: Two-way voice for the DSH web app: dictate with the unified composer, hear replies with speaker buttons and auto-read, on any device. Needs DSH 0.1.7+, Node…
description.zh: DSH Web 的双向语音：用统一输入框听写、用朗读按钮与自动朗读听回复，任意设备可用。需 DSH 0.1.7+、Node 22+、Python 3（含 numpy 与 requests）、TTS 模型与麦克风。

description.en: Dual-engine screen capture for DSH: inside the SSiD desktop shell, a global hotkey or tray opens a fullscreen box-select overlay (all monitors, per-display…
description.zh: DSH 双引擎截图：思灵桌面壳内，全局快捷键/托盘打开全屏框选浮层（多显示器、逐屏像素级抓帧），选区定格后工具条就地画红框，一次确认送进输入框；纯 DSH（浏览器）下由输入框相机按钮经 getDisplayMedia 捕获屏幕，复用同一套单阶段框选+标注遮罩。均走官方附件通道。

description.en: Scroll-painting message rail for DeepSeek Harness: a slim right-edge rail with one indicator per user message, scroll-spy follows the reading position, hover…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 画卷式消息导航栏：会话面板右侧一条竖排导轨，每条用户消息一个指示点，scroll-spy 跟随阅读位置，hover 展开画卷查看完整消息预览，点击跳转任意历史消息；与 better-sidebar 面板动画同步避让。

description.en: Injects one fixed system-prompt section so the agent thinks and replies in Chinese, regardless of the user's language.
description.zh: 注入一条固定 system-prompt 段落，让 Agent 无论用户使用什么语言都始终用中文思考和回复。

description.en: Draft polish for the DSH composer: one-click AI polish of the input draft (sparkles button next to send), with optional conversation context and a configurable…
description.zh: DSH 输入框草稿润色：发送键左侧一键调用 LLM 润色草稿，可携带会话上下文，模型渠道可配置。

description.en: Solo murder-mystery (jubensha) in a session tab: the AI hosts the game and plays every other seat, each knowing only its own role book, while the player's seat…
description.zh: 一个人的剧本杀：AI 当主持人，AI 填满其余的椅子（各自只知道自己的角色本），留一个位子给你 —— 带阶段条、按座位归集的时间线与搜证页，而真相到复盘才解封。

description.en: Cross-session plaintext memory: deterministic BM25 keyword recall (no embeddings), memory_save/list/search/confirm/forget tools behind a human-confirm gate,…
description.zh: 跨会话明文记忆：确定性 BM25 关键词召回（无向量嵌入），memory_save/list/search/confirm/forget 五个工具 + 人工确认闸门，global/project 两层 JSON 存储（project 随 git 分享）。

description.en: Conversation node appearance for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: configurable per-category and per-tool colors (left accent bar + tinted background), plus a…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 会话节点外观插件：按节点类别/工具名可配置着色（左侧色条 + 淡色底），附带"显示思考过程"开关；纯前端渲染增强，改动即时生效并持久化到 DSH 用户设置文件。

description.en: Plugin center for DeepSeek Harness: installed-plugin metadata, a community market with stars and versions, one-click install and update, and a What's New…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件中心：已安装插件信息、带星标与版本号的社区市场、一键安装与更新，以及启动时的更新日志弹窗。

description.en: Skill and MCP management center for DeepSeek Harness: browse and toggle user/project skills, add/edit/remove MCP servers hot without restart, with live…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 技能与 MCP 管理中心：浏览并启停用户/项目技能，热增删改 MCP 服务器（免重启），侧边栏实时展示各服务器状态。

description.en: Read-only Gitea and Forgejo tools over the REST API both projects share: instance info, repository listing, issue and pull request search and read, PR diffs…
description.zh: 面向自建 Gitea / Forgejo 的只读工具，走两者共用的 REST API：实例信息、仓库列表、议题与 PR 搜索和读取、PR diff 与变更文件，以及 Actions 运行、任务与任务日志。工具元数据支持英文、繁体中文、简体中文与日文。

description.en: Multi-agent meeting negotiation over the LAN: each person runs their own assistant, and assistants find each other via mDNS and negotiate meetings, weekend…
description.zh: 局域网多智能体会议协商：每人一个助理，助理通过 mDNS 互相发现，用 A2A 报文协商排会、周末团建和奶茶投票。对外只给忙闲不说原因，占用本人保护的时段前先问本人。DSH 侧栏自带手机样式页面和 13 人示例公司。无鉴权，仅限可信局域网。

description.en: Let Agents directly control independent local DSH instances with zero intrusion—no plugins or components required on the target. Isolated environments enable…
description.zh: 为 Agent 提供直接操控本机完整 DSH 实例的能力：目标 DSH 无需安装任何插件或额外组件，零侵入，环境隔离便于用户直接让agent为另一环境进行修改配置到自主测试,也能让不同模型、不同人格的 Agent 互相聊天、角色扮演或层层套娃，探索趣味玩法，可通过对话由 Agent…

description.en: Decentralized, offline-first graph memory and task graph for DSH, with signed facts, multi-device sync, and the shared Mebular Console embedded in a sidebar…
description.zh: 去中心化、离线优先的 DSH 图式记忆与任务图：签名事实、多设备同步，并在侧边栏复用 Mebular 共享控制台。需本机已运行 Mebular 守护进程（Mebular 桌面 App，或 @mebular/core 的 mebular serve）；本插件只把它的记忆工具与控制台面板接入 DSH。

description.en: Provides snapshot-based research and question answering for individual A-share and US stocks.
description.zh: 基于数据快照提供 A 股与美股的单股研究和问答。

description.en: Tavily-backed web search provider for the built-in web_search tool, with a settings card for the API key, result count, and recency window.
description.zh: 基于 Tavily 的网页搜索提供方：替换内置 web_search 的后端，并提供 API Key、结果数量与时间窗口的设置卡片。

description.en: Reads assistant replies aloud via free Edge TTS or your own RVC voice models: read-aloud buttons + auto-read, adaptive chunked progressive playback (gapless long reads), one-click voice-pack installs from a registry, and a portable RVC runtime.
description.zh: 用免费 Edge TTS 或你自己的 RVC 音色朗读 AI 回复：消息朗读与自动朗读、长文自适应分块渐进播放（无缝衔接）、音色包仓库一键安装、便携 RVC 运行时。

description.en: Memory Lake as a persistent memory layer for dsh: memory_search, memory_remember, and memory_forget tools over the memorylake CLI, a session status line, and…
description.zh: 将 Memory Lake 作为 dsh 的持久记忆层：基于 memorylake CLI 的 memory_search、memory_remember、memory_forget 三个工具，会话状态行，以及引导安装/诊断 skills，与 Claude Code、Codex 插件共享同一…

description.en: Port of ponytail: an always-on lazy-senior-developer coding persona with intensity levels, persistence of the default level, and review, audit, debt, gain and…
description.zh: ponytail 移植：常驻的「懒惰资深开发者」编码人设，带强度档位与 review、audit、debt、gain、help 技能，适用于 DeepSeek Harness。

description.en: DSH Desktop enhancement: one-click update checker, DeepSeek balance & API key viewer, and import other AI tools.
description.zh: DSH Desktop 桌面增强：一键检查更新、DeepSeek 余额与 API Key、导入其他 AI 工具。

description.en: Adds a summonable domain-expert roster that runs as subagents while the parent session keeps the task and final answer.
description.zh: 增加可召唤的领域专家名单，专家以子代理运行，主会话保留任务和最终答复。

description.en: ★ 267 │ Archive, restore, favorite and remove sessions, and diagnose damaged session logs.
description.zh: ★ 267 │ 归档、恢复、收藏和删除会话，并诊断损坏的会话日志。

description.en: ★ 36 │ Schedule one-off or recurring coding tasks that run in their own DSH sessions with a chosen workspace, model, skills and permissions, and review each run afterwards.
description.zh: ★ 36 │ 按计划在独立的 DSH 会话中执行一次性或周期性编码任务，可设置工作目录、模型、技能和权限，并回看每次运行的结果。

description.en: ★ 48 │ Answers from the current context in an independent bubble, without running tools.
description.zh: ★ 48 │ 根据当前上下文在独立气泡中回答旁支问题，不调用工具。

description.en: Adds /review, /review-status, and /review-cancel to spawn an independent native subagent that inspects a chosen Git scope (base branch, uncommitted changes, a commit, or custom instructions) and returns a findings report in the current conversation, with English or Chinese output from the host locale.
description.zh: 提供 /review、/review-status 和 /review-cancel，用独立原生子 Agent 审查所选 Git 范围（基准分支、未提交更改、某次提交或自定义要求），并把发现报告返回当前会话；报告语言跟随宿主 locale，支持中英文。

description.en: An in-page pet for DSH Web with multi-session task notifications and controls to open tasks, stop turns, and respond to supported approval and question requests.
description.zh: DSH Web 页内宠物，提供多会话任务提醒，可打开任务、停止当前轮次，并处理受支持的审批和问答请求。

description.en: ★ 250 │ A Codex-style sidebar for DSH Web with a workspace session tree, global search and turn navigation, in light and dark themes. Do not enable it together with ds-bot.
description.zh: ★ 250 │ 为 DSH Web 提供 Codex 风格的侧栏、工作区会话树、全局搜索和轮次导航，支持浅色和深色主题。不要与 ds-bot 同时启用。

description.en: Connects WeChat, WeCom, DingTalk, Feishu, Lark, QQ, and Telegram to a local DeepSeek Harness agent, with each IM chat as a separate workspace channel.
description.zh: 把微信、企业微信、钉钉、飞书、Lark、QQ、Telegram 接到本机 DeepSeek Harness，每个 IM 聊天对应一条独立工作区频道。

description.en: ★ 50 │ Bring PUA to DSH: push the agent to change approach and verify results instead of giving up or declaring done too early, with persona styles, acceptance loops and status cards. Results depend on the model.
description.zh: ★ 50 │ 把 PUA 带到 DSH：在 Agent 反复失败、过早放弃或草率宣告完成时，引导它换方法、拿证据，提供多种风格、验收循环和状态卡片。效果取决于所用模型。

description.en: Adds a /simplify command that asks the agent to simplify code within a selected Git change scope, including staged changes, commits, and untracked files.
description.zh: 提供 /simplify 命令，让 Agent 在选定的 Git 变更范围内简化代码，支持暂存变更、提交及未跟踪文件。

description.en: ★ 419 │ Manage local and project skills with repository installs, update previews, backups, and restoration.
description.zh: ★ 419 │ 管理本机与项目技能，支持仓库安装、更新预览及备份恢复。

description.en: A Windows desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness — launch, stop and monitor the DSH service and summon the GUI with a whale.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的鲸鱼娘桌面宠物，一键启动/停止/监测服务，双击唤起 GUI。

description.en: Sends desktop notifications and custom HTTP pushes when tasks finish or need your attention.
description.zh: 在任务结束或需要处理时发送桌面通知和自定义 HTTP 推送。

description.en: Adds a Continue button to resume tasks interrupted by a process exit or restart.
description.zh: 为进程退出或重启导致中断的任务提供继续按钮。

description.en: Adds 20 locales (Traditional Chinese HK/TW, Japanese, Korean, French, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, Russian, Ukrainian, Polish, Dutch, Turkish, Arabic,…
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 界面新增 20 种语言（繁体中文香港/台湾、日语、韩语、法语、德语、西班牙语、葡萄牙语、意大利语、俄语、乌克兰语、波兰语、荷兰语、土耳其语、阿拉伯语、印地语、印尼语、越南语、泰语、瑞典语），逐条精译并带运行时兜底，另加自动翻译，把市场与第三方文本翻译成你的语言。

description.en: Replay sessions on a playable timeline with per-step token usage, audit sensitive operations, estimate cost, view fork lineage, compare sessions, and export…
description.zh: 在可播放的时间线上回放会话并显示逐步 token 用量，审计敏感操作，估算成本，查看 fork 血缘，对比会话，并可导出独立 HTML 回放。

description.en: An AI-native multimodal canvas for DSH: preview images, video, audio, 3D models, PDFs, documents, and code; connect ideas and collaborate with agents in a…
description.zh: AI 原生多模态画布，支持图片、视频、音频、3D 模型、PDF、文档与代码等文件展示与预览；通过节点连线组织素材，与 Agent 共享上下文、协作编辑，内容持久保存在本机。

description.en: Desktop-grade companion: browser native notifications for user questions and approval interactions, screen capture model tool, multi-agent tiling grid view,…
description.zh: 桌面级增强套件：原生提问/审批交互通知、屏幕截图工具、多智能体平铺网格视图与轻量级 Tauri 桌面外壳。

description.en: ★ 4,764 │ Better Sidebar for DSH: file tree, editor, changes, tasks and side chat in one column, kept separate per conversation, plus a service other plugins use to register sidebar items.
description.zh: ★ 4,764 │ 在同一侧栏查看文件、编辑器、变更、任务和旁聊，各会话分别保存状态，也可供其他插件扩展。

description.en: ★ 201 │ Cross-session memory: auto-distill each session into a local SQLite store, inject on demand, consolidate while idle (autoDream).
description.zh: ★ 201 │ 将会话内容提炼并保存到本机 SQLite，按需调取，空闲时自动整理记忆。

description.en: ★ 34 │ Custom Claude provider support for DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.2
description.zh: ★ 34 │ 为 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 接入自定义 Claude 供应商。

description.en: Dual-host coordination for DeepSeek Harness (大肥鱼 bot): hand a task off in local chat, run bounded jobs in a cloud worker, then review results and approve…
description.zh: DSH 双端协作（大肥鱼 bot）：在本地对话中自然语言交办，云端独立 worker 执行有界任务，在工作台查看成果并逐步审批后续动作。含六页保护性配置导览、按任务选模型、审批账本与受控交付。

description.en: Tavily search, extract, map and crawl tools with multi-key rotation, failover on HTTP 401/429/432/433, and a load-balance mode that caps in-flight requests per…
description.zh: Tavily 搜索、提取、站点地图与爬取工具：多 Key 轮换，HTTP 401/429/432/433 故障转移，并提供按账号限制并发请求的负载均衡模式；插件配置页含密钥与用量卡片。内置 web_search 永不替换。

description.en: ★ 25 │ Harness-neutral reliability infrastructure for AI coding agents: reversible destructive actions, pre-emission redaction, recovery evidence, and a shared Decision Protocol with optional native adapters.
description.zh: ★ 25 │ 为编程 Agent 提供可撤销的高风险操作、输出脱敏、恢复记录和共享决策协议。

description.en: ★ 10 │ Generate images, video, music and speech through multiple providers, with transcription and visual analysis tools.
description.zh: ★ 10 │ 接入多家供应商生成图片、视频、音乐和语音，并提供转写与视觉分析工具。

description.en: Let DeepSeek Harness see and operate any program on Windows. The model looks at the real screen and drives the mouse, keyboard and windows itself. It is fast: several steps run in a single round trip, and a window can be focused before input lands, so the click hits the right one. It can do anything you would do on a desktop, including but not limited to CAD drawing, circuit simulation, and sending messages.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 看见并操作 Windows 上的任何程序。模型直接看真实屏幕，自己驱动鼠标、键盘和窗口。特点是快：好几步动作在一次往返里跑完，输入前还能先把目标窗口聚焦，点击就落在正确的窗口上。你在桌面上能做的事它都能做，包括但不限于画 CAD、电路图仿真、发消息。

description.en: ★ 4 │ Browse, search, and install SkillHub skills inside DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: ★ 4 │ 在 DeepSeek Harness 内浏览、搜索并安装 SkillHub 技能。

description.en: File-defined command hooks across the session, prompt, tool, permission, Stop and PostCompact seams, with an approval-only GUI: no unapproved command runs, and…
description.zh: 文件声明的命令钩子，覆盖会话、提问、工具、审批、Stop 与压缩后等事件，配套只读审批界面：未经批准的命令不执行，批准绑定精确定义、实际执行目录与 watchFiles 固定内容。命令以 DSH 系统用户身份运行且无独立沙箱，因此信任记录是显式的。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Manage MCP server configuration, startup, reconnection and tool switches, and import JSON configurations.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 管理 MCP 服务器配置、启停、重连和工具开关，并导入 JSON 配置。

description.en: Safe detached DSH restart: /restart and /dsh-restart slash commands with native candidate styling plus a dsh_restart agent tool; a detached worker restarts DSH…
description.zh: 安全的分离式 DSH 重启：/restart 与 /dsh-restart 斜杠命令（原生候选样式）加 dsh_restart Agent 工具；分离的 worker 在 3 秒后重启 DSH 且会话不冻结，Windows/macOS 走基于官方 appExit 服务的原生 Node helper。

description.en: Offline diagnostic for DSH: 19 checks across env, profile, and session state, with a settings "Doctor" panel and a read-only JSON API.
description.zh: 离线诊断工具：环境/Profile/会话共 19 项检查，带设置「诊断」面板与只读 JSON API。

description.en: Adds two buttons to the sidebar footer: one reloads the interface and client plugins only, the other restarts the desktop app together with its Host. A restart…
description.zh: 在侧栏底部添加两个按钮：一个只重新加载界面与客户端插件，另一个连同 Host 重启整个桌面应用；插件安装期间拒绝重启。重启仅支持 Windows，其他平台返回 409；刷新全平台可用。

description.en: Lists the skills in the shared skills directory with their source and version, installs and updates them from a GitHub repo, removes them to a recycle bin kept…

description.zh: 在手机浏览器里用 DSH。点会话顶栏的手机按钮（或插件设置卡）打开手机访问、扫二维码，手机就打开电脑上 DSH 进程提供的官方网页界面，会话相同、实时同步，人不在电脑前也能跟进正在跑的任务、回消息、点批准。DSH 里内置一个网关（端口 18765）转发网页界面，并替手机处理桌面端登录。一个二维码在 Wi-Fi…

description.en: Plays local video and audio inside the conversation. Media files the model writes during a turn - screen recordings, transcodes, voiceovers - get a player…
description.zh: 在对话流里直接播放本地视频和音频。模型这一轮写出的媒体文件（录屏、转码、配音），只要路径出现在它跑的命令、命令输出或回复里，回合收尾时播放器就自动出现在回复正下方，不用调工具；别的文件用 play_video 工具播放。视频是带悬停预览的小卡片，音频是可拖进度的细条，走 HTTP Range…

description.en: SQLX database tools: list saved datasources, show or test a connection, execute SQL and open a local result page, with the sqlx CLI installed on first use.
description.zh: OtterMind SQLX 数据库工具：列出已保存的数据源、查看或测试连接、执行 SQL、打开本地结果页，缺少 sqlx CLI 时首次调用自动安装。

description.en: Scheduled send: fire a drafted message into the bound conversation as a normal user bubble at a set time. Runs host-side, so the browser can stay closed;…
description.zh: 定时发送：到点将拟好的消息以正常用户气泡发送到绑定的会话。调度在服务端执行，关闭浏览器不影响发送；会话隔离、重启自动补发。

description.en: Native Harness workbench and local gateway for Dot to read saved projects and conversations, dispatch native tasks, inspect progress, continue or cancel tasks,…
description.zh: 通过原生 Harness 工作台和本机网关，让 Dot 读取已保存项目与会话、派发原生任务、查看进度、继续或取消任务，并管理连接授权。

description.en: Native workbench to select project sources, distill and test capability candidates, configure scoped Slack access, and review approvals and persistent tasks.
description.zh: 原生分身工作台：选择项目资料、蒸馏并试跑能力候选、配置有范围的 Slack 访问，查看审批与持久任务。

description.en: Session-scoped delivery receipts for local artifacts: compare current file hashes with a recorded baseline, keep agent claims separate from explicit user…
description.zh: 为本地成果生成会话级交付回执：对比当前文件哈希与记录基线，将 Agent 自述与用户明确验收分开，标记已变化或无法核验的文件，并通过工具、斜杠命令和会话面板导出 Markdown 回执。

description.en: Session-scoped research evidence ledger with sources, linked claims, open questions, and explicit user review; provides a tool, slash command, and conversation…
description.zh: 会话级研究证据账本，整理来源、关联论点、待解问题与用户明确复核；提供工具、斜杠命令和会话面板，可按论点选择导出 Markdown，默认省略摘录、复核备注与本地路径；不抓取来源或判断内容真伪。

description.en: Owner workbench for independently connected family WeChat assistants, per-member project and tool permissions, scheduled services and delivery status; API…
description.zh: 通过 Owner 工作台管理家人各自连接的微信助手、按人授予项目和工具权限、安排服务并查看投递状态；接口接受不代表手机实收。

description.en: Turns a user goal into a plugin plan using community catalogs and author documentation, then continues through installation and task execution in one workbench…
description.zh: 从用户目标匹配社区插件并阅读作者资料，形成插件方案，在同一工作台衔接安装和任务执行，保存历史与反馈。

description.en: Personal project assistant for bounded project context and memory, explicit task handoffs through an existing WeChat bridge, reminders, and source-linked…
description.zh: 个人项目助手：管理有界项目上下文和记忆，通过既有微信桥接明确交办任务、安排提醒并查看带来源的摘要。微信通路需另装 pan17/dsh-wechat 桥接并由本人扫码绑定。

description.en: Zero-dependency screen capture for DSH: Lightweight — zero deps, zero binaries; Stage & shoot — one-click full screen, window layout, hover-snap capture of…
description.zh: DSH 轻量截图插件：轻——零依赖零二进制；摆——一键全屏、窗口排版、悬停吸附截取被遮挡窗口；自助——Agent 可自助截屏，传路径不传图，路径通用，接上 modlens（选装）一步读出结构化内容。

description.en: Claude-style skin with a warm-black canvas, clay accent, and serif UI that follows the native light and dark themes.
description.zh: Claude 风格皮肤：暖黑画布、陶橙点缀、衬线 UI，跟随原生亮/暗主题。

description.en: One-button prompt optimizer: rewrites the composer draft via a configurable strategy, with an editable template, few-shot examples, pinned models and reasoning…
description.zh: 一键提示词优化：按可配置策略改写输入框草稿，提供可编辑模板、Few-shot 示例、指定模型与推理强度。

description.en: Fork of @michengai/dsh-pua that removes the upstream global kill-switch so the composer entry is always visible while the feature stays off by default and can…
description.zh: 基于 @michengai/dsh-pua 的修订版：解除上游「全局总闸」，让入口恒常显示、功能默认关闭并可按会话开关；入口改为下拉菜单（打开 / 关闭 / 选项），选项面板更紧凑。

description.en: Select text in a reply and quote it into the composer as an atomic reference chip: delete the whole chip in one keystroke, click it to scroll back and…
description.zh: 在回复里选中文字，把引用作为原子 chip 写进输入框：一次按键整体删除、点击回跳并高亮被引用的轮次、发送时展开成带边界的引用块，让模型能分清引用与用户输入。另可把片段送进侧边对话，或复制到剪贴板。

description.en: LLVM static-analysis plugin that builds whole-program bitcode for C/C++ projects and runs kernel-analyzer (KAMain) reachability analysis on it, providing…
description.zh: LLVM 静态分析插件，可为 C/C++ 项目构建整程序 LLVM bitcode，并在其上运行 kernel-analyzer（KAMain）可达性分析，向智能体提供 kanalyzer_* 工具，并向其他插件提供 ctx.kanalyzer 服务。

description.en: Directed fuzzing driven by an LLM agent: from a target repository and a bug (CVE description, patch, crash trace, or file:line), it runs a PLAN, IMPLEMENT,…
description.zh: 由 LLM 智能体驱动的定向模糊测试：给定目标仓库和一个缺陷（CVE 描述、补丁、崩溃调用栈或 file:line），它运行 PLAN、IMPLEMENT、EXECUTE、REFLECT 循环，由模型编写 Python 输入生成器，直到某个输入触发该 campaign 基于 stderr 模式匹配的 oracle，或…

description.en: Official-grade GitHub CI integration: a composite action.yml, a polling PR review bot with idempotent inline comments and a status-check gate, plus PR/issues tools with every write gated by human approval.
description.zh: 官方级 GitHub CI 集成：composite action.yml、轮询 PR 评审机器人（幂等行内评论 + status-check 门禁）以及 PR/issue 工具，所有写入走人工审批门。

description.en: Zero-dependency static and sandbox smoke detector for DSH plugins: package-structure gates, cordis contract scans, keyless headless smoke, and ecosystem-listing checks.
description.zh: 零依赖的 DSH 插件静态检查与沙箱冒烟检测器：包结构门禁、cordis 契约扫描、无密钥无头冒烟，以及生态收录校验。

description.en: Shared toolkit for authoring DeepSeek Harness plugins, published as @perrylink/dsh-plugin-kit: a pluggable provider registry seam, fail-closed approval and…
description.zh: 编写 DeepSeek Harness 插件的共享工具包，发布为 @perrylink/dsh-plugin-kit：可插拔的 Provider 注册表接缝、失败即拒绝的审批与会话事件门、共享的脱敏/计价/裁决模块，以及新插件骨架。

description.en: TickTick (Dida365) task bridge: a session-header task panel and curated agent tools over the official TickTick MCP endpoint.
description.zh: TickTick（滴答清单）任务桥：会话页头部任务面板与精选代理工具，走官方 TickTick MCP 端点。

description.en: Composer cost chip: prices the current session DeepSeek API spend message-by-message with the official pricing table (incl. the 2026-08-17 peak/off-peak…
description.zh: 输入框右侧会话成本芯片：按官方价表（含 2026-08-17 峰谷价）逐消息计价当前会话的 DeepSeek API 花费，悬停查看计价明细、今日(DSH) 消耗与账户余额；仅 DeepSeek 模型计价，其他模型不计价不显示。

description.en: Desktop BigFish companion for DSH: real-time balance, out-of-browser desktop Q&A, 7 custom animations, 53 meme lines.
description.zh: 桌面大肥鱼增强版桌宠：点击实时显示 DeepSeek 余额，浏览器外桌面问答，7 套专属动作，53 条玩梗。

description.en: Upload local images and files to your image host through PicGo's existing configuration (PicGo Cloud, GitHub, S3, COS, Qiniu, or any installed uploader…
description.zh: 通过 PicGo 已有配置（PicGo Cloud、GitHub、S3、腾讯云 COS、七牛，或任意已安装的上传插件）把本地图片和文件上传到图床，提供 `picgo_upload` 工具与 `/picgo` 命令。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Pando desktop pet for the DSH UI, a replica of the confirmo.love companion with a local sprite directory and community sprites. Drag to move and right-click to switch sprites.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 添加 Pando 桌宠，支持本地及社区精灵图，拖动位置、右键切换角色。

description.en: ★ 3 │ Tavily web search for DSH (keyless or keyed, official DeepSeek when off), plus the Tavily MCP: search, extract, crawl, map and research.
description.zh: ★ 3 │ 接入 Tavily 网页搜索和 MCP 的提取、抓取、站点映射与研究工具；关闭后使用 DeepSeek 默认搜索。

description.en: AI image and video generation for the DSH Web GUI: text-to-image and image-to-image over per-channel model catalogs with per-family request shaping (gpt-image,…
description.zh: 面向 DSH Web GUI 的 AI 生图与生视频插件：文生图/图生图按渠道配置模型目录，并按模型族适配请求协议（gpt-image、Grok Imagine、Nano Banana、Seedream、GLM-Image、Qwen-Image、MiniMax image-01、DALL-E…

description.en: Inline image chips for the DeepSeek Harness composer — paste an image and it lands in the text as a numbered chip (image-1.png) with hover preview. Images…
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 输入框里粘贴图片，即在文字中插入 image-1.png 编号胶囊；图片仍走官方附件管线随消息发出。鼠标悬浮名字弹出缩略图预览卡，dock 与已发送气泡的缩略图带序号角标，发送前还会自检「文字里的名字」与「本条消息的图片」是否对得上。

description.en: ★ 0 │ View local AI usage and optionally submit anonymous data to a rolling seven-day ranking.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 查看本地 AI 用量，并可选择匿名参与近七日用量排行。

description.en: LLM-assisted auto approval with countdown fallback for the Auto permission preset: static rules, risk tiers, breaker and file audit.
description.zh: 为 DSH Auto 权限档提供 LLM 辅助自动审批：静态规则、LLM 复审、风险分档、人工倒计时兜底、熔断与文件级审计。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Six features in one bundle, including a transparent, always-on-top desktop pet from codex-pets.net and a global wallpaper from wallhaven.cc or a local image.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 提供桌宠、壁纸等六项功能，可使用 codex-pets.net 角色、wallhaven.cc 壁纸或本地图片。

description.en: Russian for the dsh web GUI: the whole interface plus the menus of 520 third-party plugins — 584 sections, 67,666 strings.
description.zh: 为 dsh Web 界面提供俄语：整个界面，加上 520 个第三方插件的菜单——584 个分区、67 666 条文案。

description.en: Plugin diagnostics for the dsh web GUI: finds plugins that failed to load, bundle rows that never started and broken file links, then reports the findings.…
description.zh: dsh Web 界面的插件诊断：找出加载失败的插件、未启动的 bundle 行与失效的 file 链接，并报告扫描结果。只读：不修复、不写日志、不提供撤销。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Settings page for the DSH web GUI's MCP servers: a JSON editor over a profile-config namespace that mounts live mcp-client instances from the saved servers.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 通过 JSON 编辑器配置 MCP 服务器，保存后按配置建立连接。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Make sidebar navigation, projects and sessions share a scroll area. Replaces the sidebar presentation; use one sidebar replacement at a time. Requires DSH 0.2.1-rc.3 and Node >=24.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 让侧栏菜单、项目和会话共用滚动区。会替换侧栏展示组件，请同时只启用一个侧栏替换插件；需 DSH 0.2.1-rc.3、Node >=24。

description.en: Configurable per-turn budgets for supported file mutations, limiting distinct files, mutation calls, and UTF-8 payload bytes before tool execution.
description.zh: 为受支持的文件修改设置可配置的逐回合额度，在工具执行前限制不同文件数、修改调用数与 UTF-8 载荷字节数。

description.en: Make development more fun. A subtle layer of motion for DeepSeek Harness, with customizable effects and reduced-motion support.
description.zh: 让开发，有趣一点。为 DeepSeek Harness 添一层恰到好处的动效，支持效果调整并跟随系统「减少动态效果」。

description.en: ★ 3 │ DeepSeek Harness billing plugin: shows account balance and this session's billed spend, with a session-header badge.
description.zh: ★ 3 │ 显示账户余额和当前会话的实际计费金额，在会话标题旁提供费用标记。

description.en: DSH right-sidebar plugin that compares two git commits, builds a manual-test checklist from the impact scope, and supports fail notes, screenshots, task…
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏插件：对比两个 git 提交，根据影响面生成手测清单，支持失败备注、截图、任务附件，以及向云效 / GitHub / GitLab / Webhook 提交缺陷。

description.en: Reference search for DeepSeek Harness: refkit_search looks up image, video, audio and text references across 24 open sources and tags each result with its…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的参考素材检索插件：refkit_search 在 24 个开放来源中检索图片、视频、音频和文本参考素材，为每条结果标注规范化的许可证和针对用途的可用性判定；refkit_rights 针对另一种用途复核单条许可证。来源 key 与检索参数在设置页配置。24 个来源中 11 个需要…

description.en: ★ 10 │ DSH memory panel: browse, search, edit, and delete memories in Settings, and manually start or stop the local vector service.
description.zh: ★ 10 │ 在设置中浏览、搜索、编辑和删除记忆，并手动启停本地向量服务。

description.en: A separate narrow-screen web surface for DeepSeek Harness rather than the desktop GUI scaled down: it serves its own session list and chat stream behind a…
description.zh: 为 DSH 单独做的窄屏移动端 Web 服务，不是把桌面 GUI 缩放塞进手机：自带会话列表与聊天流，随机访问令牌保护，可走局域网、cloudflared / localtunnel / localhost.run 隧道或自有服务器 SSH 反向转发。手机上流式看助手文本、思考、工具调用与结果，能发提示词、停止当前回合…

description.en: ★ 2 │ Inspect visible skills and their sources, read SKILL.md, manage invocation permissions, and create or soft-delete skills.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 查看当前会话可用技能与来源，阅读说明、管理权限，并创建或移入回收区。

description.en: ★ 2 │ DeepSeek Harness browser provider: reads a page as an indexed action space, then runs one guarded operation at a time.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 把网页内容整理成带编号的可操作目标，再逐步执行带权限检查的浏览器操作。

description.en: Publishes the DSH Web GUI to LAN or internet with dsh kept on loopback. Every source must sign in for an HMAC session cookie unless passwordless LAN is opted…
description.zh: 把 DSH Web GUI 发布到局域网/公网，dsh 仍只绑定回环。除显式开启局域网免密外，所有来源均须登录换取 HMAC 会话 Cookie。提供自签名或自定义 TLS、用于明文 HTTP 代理的 secureCookies 覆盖项，以及让局域网纯 HTTP 来源正常打开工作区的 UUID shim。

description.en: Windows bash tool for DeepSeek Harness: replaces the preset pwsh with Git for Windows or MSYS2 (UCRT64/MINGW64/CLANG64/...) bash while keeping the official…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Windows bash 工具：用 Git for Windows 或 MSYS2（UCRT64/MINGW64/CLANG64…）的 bash 替换预设里的 pwsh，保留官方终端契约（workdir、后台任务与超时转后台、结果标记、终端卡片），并提供一个可自动发现、校验…

description.en: Work on any machine in your ssh config as if it were local: persistent connections, native file editing, search, exec and terminals, with nothing installed on…
description.zh: 像操作本地一样使用 ssh config 中的任意远程机器：持久连接、原生文件编辑、搜索、命令执行与终端，远端无需安装任何东西。

description.en: Local-first code knowledge graph for coding agents: 10 MCP tools for layered context compression, DAG planning, incremental AST indexing, a cross-session skill flywheel, diagnostics, and graph artifact import/export.
description.zh: 面向编程 Agent 的本地代码知识图谱：提供 10 个 MCP 工具，覆盖分层上下文压缩、DAG 规划、增量 AST 建图、跨会话技能飞轮、诊断与图谱产物导入导出。

description.en: Project-level usage hub for DSH: per-project token, time and cost, with half-hour swimlanes, 26-week activity heatmaps and provider balance alerts; unpriceable…
description.zh: DSH 项目级全局用量中心：按项目统计 Token、工时与费用，支持半小时节奏泳道、26 周全局热力图与多 Provider 余额预警；无法确认计价的部分会标注而非估算。

description.en: Full-featured Mem0 integration for DSH: auto-recall, consolidation, 7 tools, influence scores, provenance, and a trace viewer.
description.zh: 通过 Mem0 自动召回和整理记忆，提供来源追溯、影响评分和记录查看。

description.en: Agent2Agent protocol v1.0 for DSH: run a standard A2A server to let other agents call this instance, connect to remote A2A agents as clients, and manage both…
description.zh: 为 DSH 实现 Agent2Agent 协议 v1.0：以标准 A2A server 接收其他 Agent 的调用，以 A2A client 连接远程 Agent，并在可视化设置页统一管理连接。

description.en: Search titles and saved text across ordinary DeepSeek Harness (DSH) conversations in all workspaces, optionally including archived chats, with Ctrl+F / Cmd+F…
description.zh: 搜索 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）各工作区普通对话的标题和已保存正文，可包含归档；也可按 Ctrl+F / Cmd+F 查找当前对话。

description.en: Gives the agent four session tools: start a new session, send a message into another one, list sessions with their state, and wait for another session's turn…
description.zh: 给 AI 四个会话工具：新建会话、给别的会话发消息、列出会话及其状态，以及等另一个会话这一轮跑完并把它的回答取回来。

description.en: Renders workspace Markdown files in a standalone full-screen reader with GFM, KaTeX, Mermaid, outline navigation, live file reload, and browser printing/PDF…
description.zh: 在独立全屏阅读器中渲染工作区 Markdown 文件，支持 GFM、KaTeX、Mermaid、目录导航、文件更新同步以及浏览器打印和 PDF 导出。

description.en: Project .pack.json/.pack.zip into .agent-pack/modpacks/ and expose skills via a workspace allow-list.
description.zh: 把 .pack.json/.pack.zip 投影到 .agent-pack/modpacks/，按工作区白名单暴露 skill。

description.en: Multi-agent orchestration layer for DeepSeek Harness — autopilot/ralph/team execution modes, 19 role cards, 40 bilingual skills, and a bundled MCP state…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的多智能体编排层——autopilot/ralph/team 三种执行模式、19 张角色卡、40 个双语技能与内置 MCP 状态服务，移植自 oh-my-claudecode。

description.en: In-harness plugin market for the dsh web GUI: browse the awesome-dsh-plugin.com catalog and install/uninstall plugins into a profile from Settings → Plugins →…
description.zh: dsh Web GUI 内的社区插件市场：浏览 awesome-dsh-plugin.com 目录，从 设置 → 插件 → 插件市场 安装/卸载插件到 profile。

description.en: A plugin for managing MCP servers in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在DeepSeek Harness内管理MCP服务的插件。

description.en: Message and attachment editing with save-only updates, forked regeneration, and a version timeline for DSH desktop.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 桌面端的消息与附件编辑，支持原地保存、分支重生成和版本时间线。

description.en: Lets DSH drive the Chrome tab you are already browsing, no vision needed: the page reaches the model as structured text with a numbered element list, and…
description.zh: 让 DSH 直接操控你当前正在浏览的 Chrome 标签页，无需视觉能力：页面以带编号元素清单的结构化文本交给模型；点击、输入、按键、滚动、标签页操作与导航都会在扩展侧边栏等你确认，密码与支付卡字段保持掩码。15 个 browser_* 工具覆盖 snapshot、文本读取、标签页列举/打开/跟随、点击、输入、按键、滚…

description.en: Token usage dashboard for the whole harness: billed tokens from every session are rolled up per session and turn (uncached input, cache read, cache write and…
description.zh: 整个 Harness 的 Token 用量看板：把全部会话的计费 token（未缓存输入、缓存读取、缓存写入、输出）按会话与轮次汇总，并给出高峰/低谷的人民币预估费用；侧边栏「Token 用量」入口（在设置上方）打开 /token-stats 看板，Web 端新标签页、桌面端应用内弹窗。标签页可见时每 60…

description.zh: 管理 DSH 默认模型、Provider 与模型可见性，并支持可选的 OpenAI Responses 联网搜索。

description.en: Cross-agent monitoring board for local AI agent sessions (cursor-ide, claude, codex, copilot, kimi and dsh itself) with session timelines, and message…

description.en: ★ 324 │ Manage project tasks in a local SQLite board with agent assignments, execution tracking and human review.
description.zh: ★ 324 │ 用本地 SQLite 看板管理项目任务，支持 Agent 领取、执行跟踪和人工验收。

description.zh: ★ 9 │ 把普通目录变成 AI 工作区，自带记忆、规范、工具和边界，换模型或重启后都能接着做。需要 Node 20 以上。

description.en: Use a directory on an SSH host as a DSH workspace — hosts management, directory browser, five agent tools.
description.zh: 通过SSH方式，将远程主机的文件夹当成DSH的工作区，可以在本地DSH控制远程主机工作目录，不需要手动同步、不需要挂载驱动、不需要装任何第三方文件系统

description.en: Compact Codex coding mode for DSH: light prompt guardrails against GPT over-explaining, with an editable prompt and native Codex-style tools.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中提供精简的 Codex 编码模式：使用精简的 codex 提示词与原生 Codex 风格工具，并用少量提示词约束抑制 GPT 的过度解释；提示词可自行编辑调整。

description.en: Beyond the built-in @: line ranges (@src/a.ts:12-40), skills, plugins and any git repo — with the token cost of each reference shown before you send.
description.zh: 在 DSH 内置 @ 引用之上扩展：精确到行的行区间（@src/a.ts:12-40）、Skill、插件与任意 git 仓库，并在发送前显示每条引用的 token 成本。

description.en: Enhances native DSH subagents and teams with persistent subagents, improved subagent messaging, and per-member model selection for teams. Adds no extra tools…

description.en: DSH web-GUI pet runtime that renders any Codex spritesheet-atlas pet (v1/v2) as a draggable overlay: drag/wave/jump, v2 mouse-tracking eyes that follow the…
description.zh: DSH 网页 GUI 实时桌宠：可把任何 Codex 桌宠图集（webp/png/gif，v1/v2 自动识别）转换为 DSH 中可拖拽的悬浮桌宠。支持拖拽/挥手/跳跃，v2 桌宠的眼睛实时追踪活动鼠标，随 agent 状态切换姿势；进度气泡反映工作状态；「设置 → 桌宠」图形界面可导入、切换与调整桌宠；内置一只原创示…

description.en: An OpenCode Go model source for DSH: it reads the opencode-go catalog from Models.dev and serves it on a separate opencode-go-live route, leaving the built-in…
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 OpenCode Go 模型来源：从 Models.dev 读取 opencode-go 目录，在独立的 opencode-go-live 路由上提供，内置 opencode-go 路由保持原样。目录快照缓存在 DSH home 下，刷新失败时沿用上一次成功的目录；插件自带 Models…

description.en: ★ 3 │ View desktop usage, provider quotas and custom queries, with optional WorkBuddy credits and an extended model selector.
description.zh: ★ 3 │ 查看桌面用量、供应商配额与自定义查询，可选 WorkBuddy 积分和扩展模型选择器。

description.en: ★ 2,978 │ Switch installed skins and edit each skin's options from Settings.
description.zh: ★ 2,978 │ 在设置页切换已安装的皮肤，并调整各皮肤自带的选项。

description.en: ★ 2,978 │ Apply a navy whale-maid theme and character sidebar to the web interface.
description.zh: ★ 2,978 │ 为网页界面添加深蓝鲸鱼女仆主题与角色侧栏。

description.en: ★ 2,978 │ Apply a black-whale theme with square corners, straight-line icons and light and dark palettes.
description.zh: ★ 2,978 │ 提供黑鲸主题、直角界面、线条图标及明暗配色。

description.en: Routes agent requests to configurable default, planner, and subagent models, automatically using the planner role in plan mode, with per-role reasoning effort…
description.zh: 按 default、planner 和 subagent 角色将代理请求路由到可配置模型，在计划模式下自动使用 planner，并提供逐角色推理强度与 Web UI 配置。

description.en: Plugin marketplace in Settings that targets any local profile, not just the running one: install, update and remove across web, headless and other profiles,…
description.zh: 设置页里的插件市场，可操作本机任意 profile 而不只是当前运行的那个：在 web、headless 及其他 profile 上安装、更新、卸载，带安装脚本风险提示，已装视图同时覆盖目录之外的 profile 依赖，改动当前 profile 时自动重启 DSH。

Docker tools for agents: ps/images/logs/inspect/exec/manage/health with JSON output, env-configurable CLI path, approval-gated exec and zero runtime…
description.zh: Docker 工具：ps/images/logs/inspect/exec/manage/health 七工具，JSON 输出、DSH_DOCKER_PATH 环境变量、exec 审批门、零运行时依赖。

description.en: Experience memory and reflection for DSH agents: automatically extracts candidate lessons after tasks and recalls user-reviewed lessons in relevant later…
description.zh: DSH 智能体经验记忆与反思插件：任务后自动整理候选经验，经用户审阅采纳后在相关任务中自动召回。支持来源追溯、按项目检索、冲突处理、使用反馈和到期复核；整理与召回可分别开关，写入 AGENTS.md 需预览并手动应用。面板内置 4 步首次使用引导，看一次后不再出现。

description.en: Snapshot-bound multi-agent Git review with independent verification, majority voting, resolution tracking and an AI review gate.
description.zh: 绑定代码快照的多智能体 Git 审阅，支持独立复核、多数投票、问题处置追踪和 AI 审阅门禁。

description.en: All-in-one combo patch for STARDUSTLC's 18 DSH plugins: one command injects shared default configs across office, media, DevOps and notification presets; each component installs directly via a one-line add command (flat design, no git subdependencies).
description.zh: STARDUSTLC 插件全家桶·组合补丁：与 18 个组件插件配套，一条命令统一注入默认配置（办公流/媒体工坊/DevOps/通知/预设）；组件经一行 add 命令直装（扁平化设计，无 git 子依赖）。

description.en: Agent preset bundle for wish and task management: create wishes or tasks from conversation, opportunity-day check-ins, micro-actions, plus a memory store and…
description.zh: 愿望与任务管理的 Agent Preset 组合包：在对话中创建愿望/任务、机会日打卡、微行动，并附带记忆存储与 Web 端进度图表。

description.en: Provides shared plan, context pickup, and progress update Skills through StateDock Remote MCP without executing tasks or scheduling agents; targets Harness…
description.zh: 通过 StateDock Remote MCP 提供共享计划、上下文恢复与进度更新 Skills，不执行任务或调度 Agent；适配 Harness 0.2.0-rc.2。

description.en: Per-turn USD cost badge in the Web UI: session total in the header and per-turn cost in each message footer, with a hover breakdown.
description.zh: Web UI 美元成本徽标：头部显示会话总成本、每条回复结尾显示该轮成本，悬停看分项。

description.en: Multi-folder workspace: a durable global linked-folders list plus per-session on-the-fly linking (link_folder/unlink_folder), managed from the Web sidebar with…
description.zh: 多文件夹工作区：全局链接文件夹列表 + 会话内临时挂载（link_folder/unlink_folder），侧边栏管理并支持系统选目录。

description.en: Multi-platform research and deep search pipeline: harvest_scout for parallel discovery across GitHub, Web, Twitter, Reddit, Xiaohongshu, Bilibili, and YouTube,…
description.zh: 多平台调研与深度搜索流水线：harvest_scout 并行发现（覆盖 GitHub、Web、推特、Reddit、小红书、B站、YouTube 等通道），harvest_deep_research 自动化长篇综合研报生成，外加穿透抓取、跨源交叉验证与五维来源可信度审计。

description.en: Transport-level authentication gate for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with server-side sessions, HttpOnly cookies, IP-based login throttling, and an scrypt…

description.zh: 按工作区管理原生归档，支持搜索、取消归档、单项和固定范围批量永久删除。

description.zh: FormatForge：把 30+ 种文件格式（PDF、DOCX、PPTX、XLSX、EML、EPUB、TOML、压缩包）锻造成 AI 可读文本——网页拖拽入箱自动转换，提供 ff_translate/ff_formats/ff_result 工具与 CLI；扫描件回退本地 OCR 或交给会话模型增强。

description.en: Bidirectional Hermes ↔ DSH bridge: import Hermes sessions into DSH, consult Hermes, and receive Hermes-dispatched tasks as a single Cordis plugin.
description.zh: Hermes 与 DSH 的双向桥接插件：将 Hermes 会话导入 DSH、咨询 Hermes，并以单一 Cordis 插件接收 Hermes 下发的任务。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Capture conversation excerpts or new notes, organize them with tags and search, and manage trash and backups.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 摘录会话或新建笔记，用标签整理和搜索，并管理回收站与备份。
让 DSH Agent 通过 Cheat Engine 进行动态内存调试：扫描、指针分析、断点与游戏内存修改。
description.en: DSH plugin bridging agents to Cheat Engine for dynamic memory debugging: scanning, pointer analysis, breakpoints, and game memory hacking.
SSH workspace and operations for DeepSeek Harness: bind a server directory as a workspace whose fs/subprocess calls route to the remote host via cordis seam…
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 SSH 工作区与运维：把服务器目录绑定为工作区，fs/命令经 cordis seam 替换透明路由到远端主机，并带 Web 终端、文件传输、隧道、集群执行与主机管理。

description.en: Exports the agent loop to GreptimeDB as OpenTelemetry traces, metrics and logs, with seven Grafana dashboards covering token usage, cost, session outcomes and…
description.zh: 把 agent loop 以 OpenTelemetry traces、metrics、logs 导出到 GreptimeDB，附七个 Grafana dashboard，覆盖 token 用量、成本、会话结果和每轮耗时。

description.en: ChatGPT account sign-in for DeepSeek Harness through a Codex browser OAuth flow with no API key and no workspace selection: subscribes the login to pi-ai's Codex provider, lets you set the global default Codex model and reasoning effort for new sessions, refreshes the model list from the signed-in account's own catalog endpoint, and shows the five-hour and weekly usage windows in the composer.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 ChatGPT 账号登录：走 Codex 浏览器 OAuth，无需 API Key、无需选择工作空间；把登录结果接到 pi-ai 的 Codex provider，可设置新会话默认的 Codex 模型与思考强度，并按账号自己的目录接口刷新模型列表，在输入区展示 5 小时与每周用量窗口。

description.en: Multi-source web search and fetch failover for DeepSeek Harness sessions: takes over the session searchProvider and fetchProvider seams and tries configured…
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话提供多来源网页搜索与抓取故障转移：接管会话的 searchProvider 与 fetchProvider 接缝，按可配置顺序尝试已配置来源——TinyFish、Tavily 与官方搜索，官方固定参与兜底、位置可调但不可移除。每平台可配多个 key…

description.en: ★ 70 │ fnOS-specific integrations for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: ★ 70 │ 为 DSH 提供 fnOS 专用集成。

description.en: ★ 70 │ Hosts a loopback OpenAI-compatible bridge that exposes every model configured in DSH to Midscene browser automation. Midscene can drive pages in natural language without holding any credential itself.
description.zh: ★ 70 │ 在本机建立兼容 OpenAI 的桥接服务，让 Midscene 使用 DSH 模型进行浏览器自动化，凭据由桥接端处理。

description.en: Component checklist for the shared Semi Design package used by tnnevol DSH plugins, opened from a `Semi UI` button in a conversation header: 35 components plus…
description.zh: tnnevol 系列 DSH 插件共用的 Semi Design 组件检查页，从会话头部的 `Semi UI` 按钮进入：35 个组件加一个多账号案例页，按七个侧边分组组织，涵盖输入、表单、选择器、树、表格、卡片、浮层与反馈，逐个实渲并配一句话说明与页内目录，可切换浅色、深色与跟随系统预览。npm 安装：`dsh…

description.en: Database connections and SQL for DeepSeek Harness: register data sources, browse and comment schemas, run AST-checked SQL with a per-source read-only toggle,…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的数据库连接与 SQL 插件：注册数据源，浏览并注释表结构，通过 AST 校验执行 SQL（每个数据源可单独切换只读），并渲染柱状图、折线图和饼图，可在对话或设置页中使用。

description.en: ★ 23 │ Terminal front door for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): an out-of-tree TUI mode bundle over dsh-base
description.zh: ★ 23 │ 为 DSH 配置提供独立的终端界面组合包。

description.en: Zero-config Exa web search provider for the ctx.web seam: anonymous MCP fallback without an API key, plus keyed REST search.
description.zh: ctx.web 接缝的零配置 Exa 网页搜索提供方：无 API key 时走匿名 MCP 兜底，配 key 时走 REST 搜索。

description.en: Local SQLite long-term memory with CJK-aware search, BM25 and character n-gram cosine reranking, deduplication, and lifecycle management.
description.zh: 基于本地 SQLite 的长期记忆，支持 CJK 分词检索、BM25 与字符 n-gram 余弦重排、去重和生命周期管理。

description.en: Hot-switches in-process DSH fetch traffic among direct, manual HTTP(S)/SOCKS5 proxy, and ambient system-proxy modes, with no-proxy rules and optional…
description.zh: 在直连、手动 HTTP(S)/SOCKS5 代理和环境/系统代理模式间热切换 DSH 进程内 fetch 流量，支持免代理规则，并可为之后启动的子进程导出代理环境变量。

description.en: Deterministic AST code graph and architecture intelligence tool for call hierarchies, blast radius, circular dependencies, domain slices, and full-stack API…
description.zh: 确定性 AST 代码图谱与架构治理分析工具：调用链消歧、重构爆炸半径、循环依赖审计、领域切片与全栈 API 契约追踪。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Read and write WPS 365 cloud documents through the local CLI, with conflict checks before writes; requires an enterprise account.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 通过本机 CLI 读写 WPS 365 云文档，写入前检查并发冲突，需要企业版账号。

description.en: ★ 91,911 │ Turn plans and codebases into interactive architecture diagrams through a bundled skill.
description.zh: ★ 91,911 │ 用内置技能把方案与代码库整理为可交互的架构图。

description.en: Display-layer text replacement for DSH chat messages: rewrite how any configured text appears on screen without touching the real conversation, with per-rule…
description.zh: 显示层文本替换：自定义消息中任意文本的界面显示而不改动真实对话，支持逐条整词匹配、长词优先与代码块保护。

description.en: NewAgentUniverseByDeepSeek nodes inside DSH: five read-only tools covering provenance (both upstream releases this build names), a data directory's restored…
description.zh: 把 NewAgentUniverseByDeepSeek 节点接入 DSH：五个只读工具，覆盖版本与上游出处、数据目录恢复状态与账本审计、一致性向量、精确十进制换算，以及节点可达性探测。刻意不暴露启动/停止守护进程、存款、发总线消息这类在本项目里受审计的特权操作。

description.en: ★ 2 │ Run one project across your own Windows and macOS machines from a single DeepSeek account, with replicate, split, broadcast and pipeline modes.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 用同一个 DeepSeek 账号在你自己的 Windows 和 macOS 机器上运行同一个项目，支持复制、拆分、广播和流水线四种协同方式。

description.en: ★ 20 │ Adjust model reasoning effort with a configurable slider in the web interface.
description.zh: ★ 20 │ 通过网页界面的可配置滑块调整模型推理强度。

description.en: A plugin manager tab in Settings → Plugins: Chinese names and plain-language descriptions for every installed plugin, one-click enable/disable, in-UI notes…
description.zh: 设置 → 插件里的插件管理页：已装插件中文名与白话描述、一键启停、界面内改备注，支持搜索与筛选。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Shows provider API balance and subscription quotas as an always-visible dsh Web sidebar card, or the original composer pill, for the provider behind the model used in this conversation.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在侧栏卡片或输入框旁显示当前模型供应商的 API 余额与订阅额度。

description.en: Open dsh web from your phone or another computer through a UUMit account, without running your own server or installing another program: a built-in tunnel…
description.zh: 用 UUMit 账号在手机或其他电脑上打开这台电脑的 dsh web，不用自建服务器、不装其他程序：插件内置通道客户端连接 UUMit 托管的通道，侧栏里的面板负责配对和选择谁能用（仅自己、通过邀请链接或手机号授权的人、所有人），可随时撤销。需 dsh web 且 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2。

description.en: ★ 24 │ Query A-share prices, financials, announcements and news, then organize analysis and charts.
description.zh: ★ 24 │ 查询 A 股行情、财务数据、公告和新闻，并整理分析与图表。

description.en: Hindsight, agent memory that learns: long-term project memory with auto recall and retain, knowledge pages, deep reflection, and per-repo memory banks.
description.zh: Hindsight：会学习的 Agent 长期记忆系统，自动召回/保存、知识页、深度反思与按仓库隔离的记忆银行。

description.en: Brings the models available in the logged-in WorkBuddy desktop app into the model picker, reusing the app login and credits; the domestic and international…
description.zh: 把已登录的 WorkBuddy 桌面 App 里可用的模型接进模型选择器，复用 App 的登录与积分；国内版与国际版各成一组。corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect（仓库已删除）的续作；注册相同的 workbuddy / workbuddy-ai provider id，不能与其它…

description.en: Floating pill for DeepSeek Harness that shows OpenCode Go usage for the 5-hour, weekly and monthly windows as three rings, optionally alongside the DeepSeek…
description.zh: DSH 悬浮窗插件：三环显示 OpenCode Go 的 5 小时 / 本周 / 本月用量，可选同时显示 DeepSeek 账户余额；悬停浮层列出各窗口与重置倒计时，极简模式把三环嵌套显示；设置页可调刷新间隔、进度口径、显示项与浮窗位置。

description.en: An Obsidian-style knowledge base: ingest sources, let the LLM build and maintain an interlinked wiki, and ask questions grounded in it.
description.zh: 一个 Obsidian 风格的知识库：摄取资料，让 LLM 构建并维护互联 wiki，并基于它提问。

description.en: A pinned-sessions group in the sidebar, above the workspace list: every pinned session across all workspaces in one collapsible, searchable list, with…
description.zh: 侧栏「工作区」上方的一个置顶分组：跨工作区汇总所有置顶会话，可折叠、可就地搜索，点行打开、悬停出现取消置顶按钮。

description.en: Web search, page fetch and one-call research through DeepSeek's official Search and Fetch API; needs a DeepSeek API key.
description.zh: 通过 DeepSeek 官方 Search/Fetch 接口做网页搜索、单页抓取与一键调研；需要一个 DeepSeek API key。

description.en: VibeDev Ecosystem: discover, install, and manage plugins made by VibeDev, verify stable release updates in real time, and browse the DSH community marketplace.
description.zh: 发现、安装和管理 VibeDev 插件，检查版本更新，并浏览 DSH 社区市场。

description.en: Right-sidebar media preview for inline video, audio and HTML, plus a folder gallery where selected media can be added to the video workspace canvas. Works in DSH's sidebar and in dsh-better-sidebar.
description.zh: 在右侧栏预览视频、音频和 HTML，浏览文件夹媒体并选入影视工作台；HTML 默认允许脚本。

description.en: Self-evolving project-level Agent for DeepSeek Harness: 16 SDD workflow skills (clarification, PRD, issue, coding, locating, acceptance, review) plus project…
description.zh: 会进化的项目级 Agent：以 SDD 规格驱动掌舵全流程，内置 16 个技能覆盖澄清、PRD、issue、编码、定位、验收、审查；会记忆、会沉淀，越用越懂你的项目。

description.en: Routes eligible bash commands through rtk (Rust Token Killer) so tool output is compressed before it reaches the model, by asking the installed rtk to rewrite…
description.zh: 把符合条件的 bash 命令交给 rtk（Rust Token Killer）执行，让工具输出在进入模型之前就被压缩：插件调用本机 rtk 重写命令并采纳其结果；rtk 未安装时，执行器行为与原生完全一致。

description.en: ★ 8 │ OpenCode on DeepSeek Harness: session affinity, Zen/Go gateway origin headers, free-tier tool fallback, and live Go quota display.
description.zh: ★ 8 │ 接入 OpenCode Zen/Go，保持会话与网关的对应关系，提供免费档工具调用回退和 Go 额度显示。

description.en: ★ 1 │ TinyFish-backed search and fetch providers for the DeepSeek Harness web capability seam (ctx.web), offering $0 SERP and page extraction, direct or via Monid.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 为 DSH 网页搜索和正文提取接入 TinyFish，支持直连或通过 Monid 调用。

description.en: ★ 17 │ Send DSH model requests through Sabi's local proxy, which picks the configured upstream model. Written against DSH 0.1.6-alpha.2.
description.zh: ★ 17 │ 把 DSH 的模型请求交给 Sabi 本地代理，由它按配置选择上游模型。基于 DSH 0.1.6-alpha.2 开发。

description.en: Recurring loops: `/loop` command + loop tool + activity status bar.
description.zh: 定时循环：`/loop` 命令 + loop 工具 + 活动状态条。

description.en: Conversation node navigation bar for quick jumps between user messages.
description.zh: 对话节点导航条，右缘节点串快速跳转 user 消息。

description.en: Ecosystem infrastructure: a thin browser console for managing official repository plugins (zero patches) plus a make-dsh-plugin skill for guided plugin…
description.zh: 插件生态基建：浏览器面板管理官方 repository 插件（0 patch）+ make-dsh-plugin 插件开发引导技能。

description.en: Adds a Managed Agents settings tab and MCP tools to dispatch long-running agent tasks to Ark cloud Managed Agents.
description.zh: 新增 Managed Agents 设置页，并通过 MCP 工具向方舟云端 Managed Agents 派发长任务、取回轨迹与产物。

description.en: Registers Ark Agent Plan, Coding Plan and postpaid model routes in the native DSH model picker.
description.zh: 在 DSH 原生模型选择器中注册方舟 Agent Plan、Coding Plan 与后付费模型路由。

description.en: A conversational voice frontend Agent for dsh: speak naturally over ByteDance Duplex, delegate requests to background tasks, and hear their asynchronous…
description.zh: dsh 的对话式语音前端 Agent：通过 ByteDance Duplex 自然对话，把语音请求委派给后台任务，并用语音回报异步结果。

description.en: Context trimmer: lists the current session's context entries with role, preview and ≈token estimate (cl100k), highlights over-threshold items, and removes…
description.zh: 上下文剃刀：把当前会话上下文逐条列出（角色/预览/≈token 估算），超阈值标红，勾选后不经 LLM 精确裁剪，删了什么一目了然。

description.en: White noise player: lays a layer of background sound (rain, streams, campfire, café) while AI codes, for flow and focus. Supports multiple playback modes…
description.zh: 白噪音播放器：AI 编程时铺一层背景音（雨声、溪流、篝火、咖啡馆……），帮助进入心流状态、集中精力、高效思考。支持顺序/随机/单曲循环/间歇等多种播放模式。支持 AI 自动从 Wikimedia Commons 下载 CC0/PD/CC BY 背景音乐到对应场景文件夹。

description.en: Auto-resume for interrupted agent sessions: an ordered rule table routes by failure type (rate limit, quota, auth, context overflow, crashed orphan) to…
description.zh: 自动续跑：agent 会话中断后自动续上，规则表按失败类型（限流/额度/鉴权/上下文超限/崩溃孤儿）路由——自动退避重试、换模型继续、压缩上下文后继续或止损通知，规则可视化编辑，全程活动日志。

description.en: Usage dashboard: offline-scans session logs to chart daily/weekly/monthly tokens, estimated costs, model/tool/skill/command leaderboards, output speed, working…
description.zh: 使用量仪表盘：离线扫描会话日志，统计每日/每周/每月 token、估算费用、模型/工具/技能/命令榜、输出速度、工作时段与质量指标；gridstack+ECharts 卡片可拖拽编排，支持自定义公式与 AI 编排（提示词往返导入）。

description.en: Session favorites: bookmark any conversation into a browser-style favorites panel — one-click star from session rows, folders for organization, notes, custom…
description.zh: 会话收藏夹：把任意会话收藏进浏览器收藏夹式的管理面板——左侧会话行一键收藏/星标，主面板支持文件夹分门别类、备注、自定义显示名、一键继续会话、Fork 新会话、会话基本统计，外加一张清晰展示会话派生关系的 fork 关系图。

description.en: FDE toolbox bundle: installing this one plugin pulls in a curated set of common dsh plugins (git server, WebDAV mount, knowledge base, scheduled tasks,…
description.zh: FDE 工具箱全家桶：安装一个插件带上一批常用 dsh 插件（代码仓库 / 挂载盘 / 知识库 / 定时任务 / 自动续跑 / 界面微调 / 自动复盘 / 文件管理 / 智能标题 / 任务看板 / 插件市场 / 上下文 / IM 接入 / 侧栏增强），面板看状态、一键补装。

description.en: Session workspace file manager: adds a "Files" tab to the conversation area to browse the current session workspace directory tree and manage it in place…
description.zh: 会话工作区文件管理：在对话区加「文件」tab，浏览当前会话工作区的目录树并就地管理（上传/下载/新建文件夹/改名/删除/搜索），文件可 @ 进对话框给 agent 处理。

description.en: Fireworks celebration engine: floats fireworks above the chat window while the agent codes — welcome show, per-turn salutes, tool sparks, milestone…
description.zh: 烟花庆祝引擎：agent 编程时漂浮在对话窗口上空放烟花——开场迎宾、回合礼花、工具星花、里程碑大礼、收工终场、失败哑炮，每类事件一张烟花属性卡组，组内多变种随机抽取，token 用量决定烟花的大小、高度与绚烂程度。

description.en: Execution flow chart: renders the current session's execution as a vertical node flow (turns, user, assistant, tools, approvals, retries, compaction), appended…
description.zh: 执行流程图：把当前会话的执行过程画成一条纵向节点流（回合/用户/助手/工具/审批/重试/压缩），SSE 实时追加——会话执行到哪，图就画到哪，自动跟随滚动。

description.en: Gaokao countdown blackboard: counts down the days to the gaokao on a desktop blackboard widget that collapses into a slim bar on double-click, and quizzes…
description.zh: 梦回高三：桌面小黑板高考倒计时（双击收成竖条），AI 干活时随机抽背知识点卡；Markdown 开放知识卡框架——按学科/分类放 md 即自动加载，支持关联跳转/收藏/重点学科/导入自己的知识库。

description.en: Git server: embeds ts-gogs (a TypeScript reimplementation of Gogs) and serves a full Git service on its own port — HTTP clone/push, web UI, issues/PRs/wiki —…
description.zh: Git 服务器：内嵌 ts-gogs（Gogs 的 TypeScript 平替），独立端口跑完整 Git 服务（HTTP clone/push、网页端、issue/PR/wiki），可复用 user-management 的用户名密码，设置页一键启停。

description.en: Team knowledge base for offline knowledge sharing (FDE box scenario): browse, full-text search and refinement entry points; raw material is queued…
description.zh: 团队知识库：离线知识共享（FDE 盒子场景），浏览/全文检索/加工入口；raw 入料自动入队、bot 会话串行蒸馏成文（Karpathy LLM Wiki 模式：raw 不可变 / 两步加工 / log 流水 / 月度 lint）。

description.en: Kite-flying engine: while the agent codes, an animated kite drifts and sways in the wind on screen, tethered to the bottom edge of the window — the busier the…
description.zh: 放风筝引擎：agent 编程时屏幕上放一只动画风筝——token 越多事件越密风筝飞得越高，随风漂移摆动，一根线牵在窗口底边；潍坊系框架卡组（沙燕/金鱼/蝴蝶/八卦/龙头等，硬翅软翅板式立体），形状×图案×配色全是可替换数据配置，支持把用户上传的图片糊上风筝面，贴图随风筝侧正斜的姿态实时仿射变换。

description.en: Matrix digital rain: drapes the chat window in the classic green character rain — cascading columns with incandescent white heads and green tails, streaming…
description.zh: 黑客帝国数字雨：对话窗口铺上经典的绿色字符雨背景——雨柱倾泻而下、白炽雨头绿身拖尾，agent 正在生成的 token 原文实时掺进雨里；透明度/速度/密度/字号/配色全部可调，雨势跟随 agent 活跃度起伏。

description.en: Process management: brings ntd-style processes (multi-stage, multi-step agent workflow templates) into the dsh web UI — browse, edit, validate, import/export…
description.zh: 工艺管理：把 ntd 的「工艺」（多阶段·多环节 agent 工作流模板）接进 dsh web——浏览/编辑/校验/导入导出/AI 生成工艺，内置库只读、我的库可写，文件改动实时同步；agent 可通过 process_* 工具读工艺库、按工艺分阶段推进。

description.en: Customizes the native settings window: preset or custom window sizes, fullscreen, background transparency, and theme, solid-color, or image backgrounds, with a…

description.en: Partitioned long-term memory for agents, with folders as memory zones, a one-line index first, and a forgetting curve.

description.en: DeepSeek balance and token usage panel for DSH, with official platform billing, a daily usage calendar, and local session-log estimates for all providers using…

description.en: Imports chat.deepseek.com web conversations into DeepSeek Harness as resumable sessions, from a settings-page UI.
description.zh: 从设置页把 chat.deepseek.com 网页端对话导入为 DeepSeek Harness 会话，导入后可在其中继续对话。

description.en: Text viewer and editor for the dock workbench: undo/redo, Ctrl+S save, unsaved-change confirmation and binary detection, registered as the default file viewer.
description.zh: dock 系列文本查看与编辑器：支持撤销重做、Ctrl+S 保存、未保存确认和二进制检测，作为 dock-files 的默认文本查看器。

description.en: File explorer for the dock workbench: tree browsing of the session workspace with create/rename/copy-paste/delete, drag-and-drop import and paste of local…

description.zh: DSH 快捷控制面板的 dock-base 工作台适配器。面板本体（开关注册表、皮肤系统、i18n、告警面、host 路由）由 `dsh-flash` 核心单独提供；本包只负责把它挂进 dock-base：侧栏/浮动面板、活动栏 ⚡、编辑器视图与 dock-flash:openQuickControl 命令。需安装…

description.en: Git history visualization for the dock workbench: swimlane commit graph, branch and tag management, stage/commit/push and remote operations.
description.zh: dock 系列 Git 历史可视化插件：泳道式提交图、分支/标签管理、暂存/提交/推送与远端操作。

description.en: Image viewer for the dock workbench: PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, BMP, SVG, ICO and AVIF, with SVG rendered as image data only.
description.zh: dock 系列图片查看器：支持 PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP/BMP/SVG/ICO/AVIF 格式，SVG 仅以安全方式渲染。

description.en: Markdown viewer for the dock workbench: GFM rendering with DOMPurify sanitization, document outline and relative-path image/link resolution, with one-click…
description.zh: dock 系列 Markdown 查看器：GFM 渲染 + DOMPurify 消毒、文档大纲、相对路径图片/链接解析，可一键切换编辑。

description.en: Read-only XLSX, XLS, ODS, CSV and TSV viewer for dock-files with worksheet tabs, sorting, filters, search and cell links.
description.zh: dock-files 的只读表格查看器，支持 XLSX、XLS、ODS、CSV、TSV 格式以及工作表切换、排序、筛选、搜索和单元格链接。

description.en: A fork of Microsoft's official .NET/C# skills for AI coding agents, additionally packaged as a DeepSeek Harness plugin — covering development, testing,…
description.zh: 微软官方 .NET/C# AI 编码智能体技能的 fork，额外打包为 DeepSeek Harness 插件——覆盖开发、测试、诊断、迁移与 AI 集成。

description.en: ★ 4,665 │ Create long-lived bots with memory, direct messages and group chats for multi-bot collaboration.
description.zh: ★ 4,665 │ 创建带记忆的长期 Bot，通过私聊和群聊交流，并让多个 Bot 分工协作。

description.en: ★ 1,076 │ Continue DSH sessions from another computer, the web or Android over an end-to-end encrypted connection, with experimental support for Codex, Cursor and Antigravity workspaces.
description.zh: ★ 1,076 │ 通过端到端加密连接，在另一台电脑、网页或 Android 上继续使用 DSH 会话，另有 Codex、Cursor 和 Antigravity 工作区的实验支持。

description.en: ExHentai.org-inspired UI for DeepSeek Harness. DS Hentai / DeepSeek Hentai. Charcoal background, light-gray text, gray borders. The session list reads like a…
description.zh: ExHentai 皮肤 for DeepSeek Harness。DS Hentai / DeepSeek Hentai，深炭底、浅灰文字、灰色边框；会话列表像画廊索引，发送框像搜索栏。预览Demo：https://dshentai-demo.arkady14.site/

description.en: Mirrors DeepSeek Harness task state (failed, waiting for your answer, finished) into the macOS Atoll Dynamic Island as one status light with three counts.

description.en: Full-screen 550C boot intro for DSH: a 4-second simple cut and a 16-second rewrite sequence, skippable by click or Esc, with four phosphor palettes. The host half injects the opening frame while the document is still parsing, so the built-in loading card never shows; the desktop caption strip turns transparent, so those window buttons float on the animation.
description.zh: 给 DSH 加一段 550C 全屏开机片头：简易档 4 秒、完整档 16 秒覆写流程，点击或按 Esc 跳过，四套磷光配色。首帧由宿主半边在文档解析阶段注入，DSH 自带的 Loading 卡片不会露脸；桌面窗口右上角那条原生按钮条带在片头期间透明化，按钮像浮在动画上。

description.en: Opens academic sites through institutional proxy rules and optionally renames eligible new PDFs using matched article metadata, with Simplified Chinese,…
description.zh: 按机构代理规则打开学术网站，可依据匹配的论文元数据重命名符合条件的新 PDF，并提供简体中文、繁体中文及美式英语设置界面。

description.en: Customize the username (phone number or email) and avatar shown at the bottom-left account row — for personalization, or to keep screenshots from exposing…
description.zh: 自定义左下角账号处的用户名（手机号/邮箱）和头像，从而提升个性化或避免截图泄露隐私。编辑入口位于点击此处的菜单内。

description.en: Local themed achievements, badges and character collections for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在本地记录 DeepSeek Harness 主题成就、勋章与角色收藏。

description.en: Loopback-only ACP door for DeepSeek Harness: connect VS Code and other local clients to a running kernel over the local loopback address, sharing its models,…
description.zh: 为正在运行的 DeepSeek Harness 内核提供仅监听本机回环地址的 ACP 接入点，供 VS Code 等本机客户端连接，共用模型、工具、记忆和会话，并支持历史查看、权限切换及调用 DSH 插件已注册的能力。

description.en: Enhanced ACP server for DeepSeek Harness: block & reasoning streaming, usage telemetry, model/effort switching, permission presets, session resume/archive,…
description.zh: 增强版 ACP 服务器：块级与推理流式、用量遥测、模型/推理强度切换、权限预设、会话恢复/归档、每会话 MCP servers、Zed 文件/终端转发。

description.en: Action Hub for DSH: a standard Agent Skill library whose SKILL.md files can run as model-visible Skills or user-only Commands, with groups, project scopes,…
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的标准 Agent Skill 库：同一份 SKILL.md 可作为模型可见的 Skill 或仅由用户调用的 Command，支持分组、项目范围、导入导出和原生 Alt+A 面板。

description.en: Deterministic project actions shared by people and agents: one actions.json, a right-sidebar run panel, and agent tools.
description.zh: 人与 Agent 共用的确定性项目任务：一份 actions.json，右侧栏运行面板与 Agent 工具双入口。

description.en: Sidebar activity bell: a red badge counts sessions that finished, and clicking it swaps the sidebar list from workspace grouping to a day-grouped…
description.zh: 侧边栏活动铃铛：会话跑完后铃铛显示红色角标，点一下把工作区列表换成按天分组的最近活动列表，尚未打开过的完成项带绿点。

description.en: Activity overview pane for the DSH web UI: running, awaiting-response and recent sessions with child agents, progress, model and reasoning level in one sidebar…
description.zh: DSH Web 活动会话总览窗格：将运行中、等待响应与近期活跃的会话集中到一个侧边窗格，含子代理层级、进度、模型与推理级别。

description.en: QQ Official Bot adapter for C2C single chat, interactive action boards, workspace session management, and real-time Web UI sync.
description.zh: QQ 官方单聊机器人适配器：支持交互操作板、工作区会话管理与 Web UI 实时双向同屏。

description.en: Pixel-art reasoning-effort slider for DSH Web with continuous 0–100 dragging, 16ms throttled writes, snap-to-level commits, and a WebGL ember fire that ignites…
description.zh: 炭灰余烬风格的 DSH Web 像素推理强度滑块：以近黑木炭、暗红裂纹和橙红高温核心呈现 4px 像素化 WebGL 火焰，拖动时逐档点燃；支持 0–100 无极拖动、16ms 节流写入与松手吸附。

description.en: Android Studio-style ADB logcat viewer with live filtering and level colors.
description.zh: Android Studio 风格 ADB logcat 查看器，支持实时过滤与等级配色。

description.en: ★ 32 │ Configure the advisor reviewer model that observes the primary transcript and injects severity-ranked advice.
description.zh: ★ 32 │ 配置第二个模型旁观主会话，按严重程度给出审阅建议。

description.en: Consult multiple expert advisor models in a retro CRT chat-group card: one ask_advisors call runs an auto-deepen pipeline (driver deep-question, advisor relay,…

description.en: Pairs the running executor with a stronger reviewer model through zero-parameter advisor() calls and step-based patrol checks, returning plan, correction, or…

description.en: Runs a fixed set of agent benchmark cases in isolated sandboxes, scores each case with deterministic assertions, and diffs two runs to show which cases…

description.en: Flight recorder panel for DSH sessions: live monitoring, timeline replay with a tool waterfall and event inspector, per-agent cost attribution, and a…

description.zh: 多智能体防内耗防御插件：读取台账去重度量、免疫压缩规则区、完成机械门禁、低成本审查 lane。

description.en: Overlay reader for agent output files: Markdown rendering, in-panel PDF, DOCX/XLSX/PPTX text preview and reply-end file chips, with search, outline and…

description.zh: ★ 0 │ 管理可切换的角色、性格、表达、准则和记忆配置，支持导入导出及注入开关。

description.en: Loopback-first multi-agent message relay: HMAC-authenticated broker plus dsh plugin (relay_send/recv/peers/history), zero-dependency CLI and Python clients,…
description.zh: 本地优先的多 Agent 协作中继：HMAC 认证 broker + dsh 插件（relay_send/recv/peers/history）+ 零依赖 CLI 与 Python 客户端，wire protocol v1.0。

description.en: Browse, enable, disable, and manage Agent Skills from Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Gemini, and custom directories in the DSH settings panel.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置面板中浏览、启用、停用和管理来自 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、Gemini 及自定义目录的 Agent Skills。

description.en: ★ 44 │ Compose prompts, tools, skills, subagents and fallback models in a visual configuration panel.
description.zh: ★ 44 │ 可视化组合提示词、工具、技能、子 Agent 与备用模型。

description.en: Reusable Agent Team presets for DeepSeek Harness: a Settings page stores named Teams — a captain with its own prompt and tool allow-list, plus members carrying…

description.zh: 使用 AgentDebugX 诊断当前及已保存的 DeepSeek Harness 轨迹，并在其仪表盘中打开结构化报告。

description.en: Extensible AI-driven group-reaction narrative game framework for DeepSeek Harness: type one action and multiple NPCs each respond in their own chatroom message…

description.en: Always-on-top notch for Windows that shows which sessions are working, which need you, and which are done or failed: one bot per session, never takes focus,…
description.zh: Windows 屏幕顶部始终置顶的刘海：每个会话一个小机器人，显示哪些在工作、哪些在等你、哪些已完成或失败；不抢焦点，全屏应用下自动隐藏，带独立设置页。

description.zh: ★ 56 │ 抓取渲染后的网页、检索多个来源，并自动操作浏览器会话。
