description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面里并排运行、监控多个对话实例：多窗口墙 + 自动发现 + 单窗控制，内置带口令认证的局域网网关，手机/平板也能看。

description.en: Secondary working directories for a DSH project: the agent keeps the primary workspace as cwd and gains equal read/write/exec permissions on configured…
description.zh: 为 DSH 项目提供副工作目录：agent 保持主工作区为 cwd，同时对已配置的副目录获得同等读写/执行权限，可在会话头部与新会话页配置。

description.en: Multi-model orchestrator: the main brain decomposes complex tasks and dispatches subtasks to GLM / Kimi / Qwen sub-agents by each model's strengths, with…
description.zh: 多模型主脑编排器：主模型将复杂任务拆解，按各模型优劣分派给 GLM / Kimi / Qwen 子代理执行，并按模型统计 token 用量。

description.en: Multi-role parallel argumentation for DeepSeek Harness: runs the real Codex and Claude CLIs in parallel, has the DSH model (Judge) write a third-party verdict…
description.zh: 多角色并行论证：并行调用真实 Codex 与 Claude，由 DSH 主会话模型（Judge）生成第三方汇总并回对话；另含单 Agent 直接对话与各角色模型自由配置。

description.en: Replaces the sidebar workspace region with a two-tab browser: several workspace roots stay registered side by side while conversations are filed under the real…
description.zh: 把侧边栏的工作区区域换成双选项卡浏览器：多个工作区根并列登记、各自固定不变，对话按每个会话真实的工作目录归入目录树，资源是只读文件树、点击即用右侧栏预览。两个选项卡各自独立隐藏、只影响显示且完全可逆；资源文件夹或文件可复制路径，也可拖进输入框成为原生引用块；@ 补全覆盖全部已登记工作区，而不只是当前工作目录。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Multi2API account pool: turns multiple WorkBuddy accounts into separate, non-interfering models in DSH.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 管理多个 WorkBuddy 账号，在 DSH 中分别作为独立模型使用。

description.en: Single/multi-line composer toggle for the DSH Web GUI: an editable shortcut (registered through the harness shortcut service) — Cmd/Ctrl+E on desktop builds…
description.zh: DSH Web 输入框单行/多行切换：通过官方快捷键服务注册的可编辑快捷键（桌面版默认 Cmd/Ctrl+E，浏览器版默认 Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+E，Linux 浏览器默认未绑定） 在原生单行输入框与至少四行的多行输入框之间切换；输入框上沿的小 tab 常驻显示当前快捷键与目标模式；多行时 Enter…

description.en: Agent skill and tool for querying multi-platform model account balances: DeepSeek, Doubao / Volcengine, Qwen / Alibaba Cloud, Hunyuan / Tencent Cloud, and…
description.zh: 多平台余额 Agent 技能与工具：查询 DeepSeek、豆包 / 火山引擎、千问 / 阿里云百炼、混元 / 腾讯云以及自定义 HTTP 接口的账户余额；只读，内置 60 秒缓存。

description.en: A Multitask agent preset where the main conversation only plans, briefs subagents and summarizes results, while file reads, commands, search and builds run…
description.zh: Multitask 减震器模式（Agent preset）：主对话只做需求理解、任务下发与结果汇总，读文件、跑命令、搜索与构建全部下放子代理；含四类 worker、危险操作审批闸门，且零 DSH 源码改动。

description.en: Meta's Muse Code CLI inside DSH: a composer switch starts muse serve, a right-sidebar panel and five chat tools (muse_open, muse_prompt, muse_read,…
description.zh: 在 DSH 里使用 Meta 的 Muse Code CLI：输入框开关启动 muse serve，右侧边栏面板与五个聊天工具（muse_open、muse_prompt、muse_read、muse_status、muse_interrupt）共享同一个 Muse 会话，审批只能在面板里决定，本地花费护栏默认到…

description.en: ★ 21 │ Play music alongside coding conversations.
description.zh: ★ 21 │ 在编程会话中使用音乐播放功能。

description.en: MUV engine for DeepSeek Harness: runs the regex_scripts from a character card against model output, tracks variables, renders a status bar, expands macros and LaTeX, and styles tagged code blocks such as letter, terminal, newspaper and phone. Needs dsh-muv-table installed as well, which is its companion plugin.
description.zh: MUV 引擎：执行角色卡的 regex_scripts 实时替换模型输出，追踪变量、渲染状态栏、展开宏与 LaTeX、为标签代码块（信纸／终端／报纸／手机）套样式。需同时安装伴生插件 dsh-muv-table。

description.en: MUV variable table editor for DeepSeek Harness: a tree view of the variables being tracked, a macro test panel for random, pick and roll, a dice shortcut bar and pick-cache management. Companion plugin for dsh-muv-engine.
description.zh: MUV 变量表格编辑器：树形变量面板、宏测试浮窗（random／pick／roll）、骰子快捷栏与 pick 缓存管理。dsh-muv-engine 的伴生插件。

description.en: Electronic wooden fish in the bottom-right corner of the DSH web UI, a whale-girl sprite by default: tap the head to earn merit; it knocks by itself while the…
description.zh: 右下角电子木鱼，默认是鲸鱼娘图包：敲头记功德，模型忙碌时自动敲；功德按会话存本机，可换自定义图源。

description.en: Context lens: visualizes token usage of every request (context composition, KV cache hit rate) and enforces per-turn / per-session budgets with warning and…
description.zh: 上下文透镜：可视化每次请求的 token 用量（上下文构成、KV 缓存命中率），并提供每轮 / 每会话预算控制（超限提醒与拦截）（npm: `dsh-my-context`）。

description.en: Plugin governance: new/updated plugins stage in a candidate area first, then hot-mount after startup — success promotes, failure auto-disables, repeated failures freeze, one-click safe mode, sidebar diagnostics panel (npm: `dsh-my-guardian`).
description.zh: 插件治理：新装/更新插件先进候选区，启动完成后热挂载——成功自动转正，失败自动禁用，连续失败冻结，一键安全模式，侧边栏诊断面板（npm: `dsh-my-guardian`）。

description.en: Memory in global and per-project scopes: memories are injected into the system prompt at session start, a settings panel edits them with confirmation on write,…
description.zh: 全局 / 项目两级记忆：会话开始时把记忆注入系统提示词，设置页面板支持新增 / 修改 / 删除（写操作需确认），并为 agent 提供只读查询工具 memory_query（npm: `dsh-my-memory`）。

description.en: Browser notifications and a beep when a session turn ends, the agent asks a question or approval is pending; clicking the notification jumps to the session;…
description.zh: 会话（本轮）结束 / agent 询问 / 等待审批时弹浏览器通知 + 滴声，点击通知跳转会话；预留远程触发接口与 SSE 实时通道（npm: `dsh-my-notify`）。

description.en: Observability and git tooling: a persistent cross-session event audit log with a query API, a resource watchdog sidebar panel, structured Conventional Commits…
description.zh: 可观测性与 Git 工程工具：跨会话持久化的事件审计日志与查询 API、资源看门狗侧边栏面板、结构化 Conventional Commits 提交、提交前增量 diff 审查（npm: `dsh-my-observability`）。

description.en: Injects a per-session x-opencode-session header into opencode.ai inference requests, fixing the OpenCode Go gateway 400 MissingSessionID error; server-only, no…
description.zh: 为 opencode.ai 的推理请求注入按会话稳定的 x-opencode-session 头，修复 OpenCode Go 网关 400 MissingSessionID；纯 server 插件，无界面（npm: `dsh-my-opencode-session-header`）。

description.en: Remote control: pushes ask / approval / session-end events to an external channel webhook and lets you answer, approve, query status or continue a session from…
description.zh: 远程控制：把 ask / 审批 / 会话结束事件推送到外部通道 webhook，可用 token 鉴权在手机上回答问题、批准请求、查询状态或继续会话（npm: `dsh-my-remote`）。

description.en: Skill management: lists skills in global and per-project scopes and toggles each one per project; a disabled skill is not injected into that session (npm:…
description.zh: Skill 管理：按全局 / 项目两个范围查看 skill 列表，并按项目启用或禁用；被禁用的 skill 不会注入该会话（npm: `dsh-my-skill-manager`）。

description.en: Edit the host-wide global instructions (~/.dsh/AGENTS.md) from a dedicated Customize page in Settings - every session on this machine applies them.
description.zh: 在设置页的「个性化」页编辑此主机全局指令（~/.dsh/AGENTS.md），此机器上的所有会话都会应用。

description.en: Operate n8n from DeepSeek Harness with a multi-instance registry, alias-addressed agent tools and a settings page.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 n8n 工作流运维插件：多实例注册表、Agent 工具与设置页界面。

description.en: Keeps the NapCat QQ backend alive next to DSH: probes the OneBot 11 HTTP port at startup, launches NapCat when the port does not answer, then rechecks every 45…
description.zh: 让 NapCat 这个 QQ 后端跟着 DSH 一起活着：启动时探测 OneBot 11 的 HTTP 端口，连不上就拉起 NapCat，之后每 45 秒复查、清掉重复的进程链、隐藏控制台窗口、可在填写任务名后创建登录计划任务，并提供设置页以及 napcat_status、napcat_restart、napcat_d…

description.en: Controls user-authorized Chrome tabs from DeepSeek Harness through a local native-messaging broker, with semantic page reads, actions, screenshots, and…
description.zh: 通过本地原生消息 Broker，让 DeepSeek Harness 操作用户明确授权的 Chrome 标签页，支持语义化页面读取、交互、截图与显式交接。

description.en: Native per-workspace memory on the harness's own seams: facts and a bounded always-on profile on the storage-domain JSON unit, approval-gated writes with…
description.zh: 基于 DSH 原生接缝的按工作区记忆：事实与有界常驻档案落在 storage-domain 的 JSON 单元上，写入经人工审批并带 `(sessionId, seq)` 引证，确定性召回 + session-query 全文检索历史会话——无外部服务器、无自建 SQLite。

description.en: Global back/forward navigation for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: remembers every session and whole-page panel you visit, shows a configurable 1-7 entry history…
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供全局后退/前进：记录访问过的会话与整页面板，底部历史条可配置显示 1-7 个位置并可直接点击跳转，支持浏览器式快捷键与鼠标侧键。

description.en: Vertical message pointer rail on the left edge of the chat: one dash per user message, click to scroll to that message, hover for a preview bubble.
description.zh: 聊天区左侧的消息指针导轨：每条用户消息一个横条，点击滚动定位，悬停显示预览气泡。

description.en: Requirement-driven dsh plugin discovery and environment recipes: plugin_guide matches natural-language needs to a curated plugin directory with reasons and…
description.zh: 需求型插件导购与环境配方：plugin_guide 按自然语言需求语义匹配精选插件并给出理由与安装命令；recipe 一键安装整套社区配方（通知全家桶、安全审计套装等），带有序安装计划。

description.en: Keep branching from any completed answer at any depth while the main session stays untouched.
description.zh: 从任意层级的已完成回答持续创建隔离分支，主会话始终不受影响。

description.en: Route agent network requests through a local HTTP/CONNECT/SOCKS5 proxy.
description.zh: 让 agent 的网络请求走本机 HTTP/CONNECT/SOCKS5 代理。

description.en: Network and proxy doctor for DSH: checks system proxy settings, probes local proxy ports, detects TUN adapters, tests GitHub, TCP and HTTP reachability, scans…
description.zh: DSH 的网络与代理诊断工具：检查系统代理设置、探测本地代理端口、识别 TUN 适配器、测试 GitHub/TCP/HTTP 连通性、扫描 hosts 冲突，并给出具体的修改建议。

description.en: Hosted tool server over MCP: invoice and bank-statement extraction with in-code arithmetic checks, ledger reconciliation in integer cents, PDF and table…
description.zh: 托管工具服务器（MCP）：发票与银行流水提取并做代码内算术校验、按整数分对账、PDF 与表格转换、SQL 方言转写，以及从中国移动骨干网实测大陆可达性。

description.en: Authenticated LAN, Tailnet, and public HTTPS access for a DSH Host, with persistent host identity, pairing, and QR setup.
description.zh: 为 DSH Host 提供经认证的局域网、Tailnet 与公网 HTTPS 接入，支持持久主机身份、配对和二维码配置。

description.en: Standalone Network Engineer Assistant agent preset plus a bundled 32-doc command knowledge base skill for DPtech, H3C, Huawei and Ruijie switches and routers:…
description.zh: 网络工程师助手预设 + 四厂商（迪普/新华三/华为/锐捷）交换机路由器命令知识库：32 篇文档随插件以技能形式分发（含来源链接与 verified 分级），KB 优先检索、跨厂商语法对照、拓扑与回显截图识别、联网查官方手册并注明出处、高危命令强制 ⚠️ 风险标注；只回答网络工程主题。

description.en: Visualize the DSH process network path on Windows or WSL with layered DNS/TCP/TLS/HTTP probes, detect stale proxy configuration, and apply snapshot-guarded…
description.zh: 可视化 DSH 进程在 Windows 或 WSL 上的网络链路（DNS/TCP/TLS/HTTP 分层探测），检测失效的代理配置，并提供带快照回滚的安全修复。

description.en: Neumorphic DSH Web theme with light and dark palettes, ambient lighting, material shadows, grain texture, frosted-glass surfaces, and micro-interactions.
description.zh: DSH Web 轻拟物主题：提供浅色与深色配色、环境光影、材质阴影、纹理、磨砂玻璃表面与微交互。

description.en: New API gateway provider: several gateways with one active at a time, per-gateway model lists with context and modality details, quota, and image and video…
description.zh: New API 网关提供商：多网关同一时间激活一个，每个网关独立的模型清单与上下文/多模态标注、额度查询，以及生图与视频生成工具。

description.en: Suggests the next user reply in an empty composer after the assistant finishes, using the session model and rolling context summaries, with Tab to accept.
description.zh: 助手完成后，沿用会话模型与滚动上下文摘要，在空输入框中建议下一条用户回复，按 Tab 接受。

description.en: After each reply, shows a gray next-prompt suggestion in the empty composer that Tab or → accepts; in an empty composer, ↑ / ↓ browse the messages you sent in…
description.zh: 回答结束后在空输入框里显示一条灰色的下一句建议，按 Tab 或 → 采纳；空输入框按 ↑ / ↓ 翻看本会话发送过的内容；可在插件页直接修改设置；不会自动发送。

description.en: NextTavern is a long-form roleplay plugin for DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7-rc.2 Web, with character-card import and creation, worldlines, worldbooks, layered…
description.zh: NextTavern 是面向 DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7-rc.2 Web 的长篇角色扮演插件，支持角色卡导入与创作、世界线、世界书、分层长期记忆、关键词／语义／混合检索、角色 Agent，以及角色卡或小说导出；支持 SillyTavern 角色卡导入，v0.2.9 修复分发与安装问题。

description.en: Personal coding assistant that schedules, follows up on and verifies local Codex or Claude Code tasks from DSH, with WeChat, WeCom and Feishu remote channels.
description.zh: 个人编码助理：在 DSH 中安排、跟进与验收本机 Codex 或 Claude Code 任务，并提供微信、企业微信与飞书远程渠道。

description.en: Long-term memory backed by a local SQLite store: project-scoped memory auto-injection with junk filtering, rule-based or model-assisted memory extraction from…
description.zh: 基于本地 SQLite 的长期记忆：新会话自动注入项目相关记忆（噪声过滤），支持轻量规则或模型辅助提取，写入去重与反馈加权排序。Python 桥默认使用 $NEXUS_PYTHON 或 <DSH home>/dsh-runtimes/dsh-primary-runtime/dependencies/python/…

description.en: macOS system notifications for DeepSeek Harness: aborted, max-tokens, blocked, interrupted and error events, pending questions and approvals, and completion or…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 macOS 系统通知插件：任务中止、超限、阻塞、中断、出错、等待提问或批准、完成或子代理结束等事件通过 terminal-notifier 弹系统横幅；点击横幅打开指定应用，回到页面自动清空。

description.en: UI enhancement suite for DeepSeek Harness: one-click workspace open (copy path, reveal in Finder, open in an auto-discovered editor), DeepSeek-web-style…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 界面增强插件：工作区一键打开（复制路径、访达显示、自动发现编辑器打开）、用户消息导航条、会话待办标记、单列表增强与硬性重启按钮。

description.en: Switchable liquid-glass theme for the DSH web UI — 14 panels become frosted glass over a fluid backdrop, with material sliders and hover elasticity.
description.zh: 可切换的 DSH 网页端液态玻璃主题——14 个面板在流体背景上变成磨砂玻璃，材质参数有滑杆，悬停时玻璃与面板内容一起倾斜。

description.en: NiuLai meme desktop pet — shouts "Ma～ma～" with a synced mouth when your agent finishes; 6 skins, signature actions, action-event binding, WebAudio-synthesized…
description.zh: 牛来桌宠——agent 任务完成就蹦出来喊「妈～～妈～～」（嘴型同步）；6 个皮肤、签名动作、事件绑定、WebAudio 合成叫声，内置手绘 SVG 皮肤素材。

description.en: Approval sound effects from the movie NiuLai: plays 「妈妈」 when user confirmation is requested, interrupts it and plays 「牛来！」 the moment the user approves;…
description.zh: 牛来确认音：请求用户确认时播放「妈妈」，批准瞬间掐断并播放「牛来！」；梗源电影《牛来》，Windows 原生播放，零外部依赖。

description.en: Switch the current DSH session's model with a natural-language sentence, on web, TUI, or IM bridges (WeChat, Feishu), without touching the panel.
description.zh: 用一句自然语言切换当前 DSH 会话模型，可在 Web、TUI 及 IM 桥接的微信、飞书等对话框中使用，无需操作面板。

description.en: Sit-and-water reminder for DeepSeek Harness, with a cat that sits in the corner of the Web GUI. A focus cycle of 30-90 minutes ends in a centered overlay plus…
description.zh: DSH 的久坐与喝水提醒：一只猫待在 Web GUI 角落帮你盯时间。专注周期 30-90 分钟结束后居中弹窗并连响三声，喊你起来走两步、喝口水；点「再等会」给出 1 条久坐的真实案例 + 1 条缺水的真实案例（内置 17 条，均带来源媒体、发布日期和原文链接）；点「结束」输出本次工作评价：工作时长、完成轮数、成功中断…

description.en: Removes the Preview badge on DSH.
description.zh: 去除在DSH上的预览版标签。

description.en: Real-time 'We need…' and 'Let me…' reasoning-trajectory keyword stats for the DeepSeek Harness web chat.
description.zh: 实时追踪 DeepSeek Harness 网页对话中模型流式推理轨迹关键词统计的 UI 面板。

description.en: Noname (Sanguosha-like game) extension workshop. AI writes skill and card extensions behind confirmation gates, static validation and block-based safe writes.
description.zh: 无名杀扩展开发工坊。AI 在确认协议、校验门禁与区块化写入的保护下编写武将技能与卡牌扩展。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that lets you control Universal Robots (UR) collaborative arms directly from natural language — by default an offline,…
description.zh: 让 DSH 用自然语言直接控制 Universal Robots（UR）协作机械臂的插件——默认是一台离线、运动学级的仿真机械臂，真机通道在显式开启前始终关闭。需本机 Python 并 pip install -r requirements.txt（numpy、paramiko）。由拓德科技（Nonead）基于自研…

description.en: Connects DSH session status, approvals and questions to a native macOS notch app; requires the native app and Focus companion.
description.zh: 将 DSH 会话状态、审批和问题同步到原生 macOS 刘海程序，需要原生程序及 Focus 同步助手。

description.en: Companion for DSH Notch that synchronizes session navigation and read state with DSH Desktop and Web.
description.zh: DSH Notch 的配套助手，同步 Desktop、Web 与 Notch 之间的会话跳转和已读状态。

description.en: Workspace-wide sticky notes on an infinite canvas: notes are plain Markdown files, created manually, captured from conversations, or distilled by the AI, and…
description.zh: 工作区级的无限画布便签：便签以 Markdown 文件保存，可手动创建、从对话中摘录或由 AI 提炼生成，并能作为上下文提供给 AI 使用；附带 12 个模型工具与 5 个内置技能，用于创建、打标签、整理、比较与合并便签。

description.en: Notes-backed context compression for DeepSeek Harness: replaces LLM-summarized compaction with a model-written persistent notebook plus recoverable raw…
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供笔记式上下文压缩：用模型维护的持久笔记本取代 LLM 摘要式压缩，并保留可恢复的原始历史，窗口边界本身不产生模型调用。

description.en: Local Markdown notes as governable working memory for DeepSeek Harness agents: dual-mode source/WYSIWYG editor with images, convention or reference notes…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的可治理 Agent 工作记忆层，沉淀为本地 Markdown 笔记：双模式编辑器（源码⇄富文本，支持图片），约定/资料笔记自动注入系统提示（敏感值自动脱敏），另有快照版本历史、回收站、可撤销归档、AI 整理、双链与全文搜索。兼容 DSH 0.1.7～0.2.x。

description.en: Shows a focus-free notice card in the corner when a turn ends or DSH is waiting on an approval or a question.
description.zh: 任务跑完、等你审批或等你回答时，在屏幕角落弹出一张不抢焦点的通知卡。

description.en: ★ 1 │ DeepSeek Harness notification center: a tab-title whale status light (green = done / amber = pending) plus browser system notifications for completion and pending items, with 45 optional opencode sound effects and configurable volume.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 用标签页状态灯、浏览器通知和提示音提醒任务完成或等待处理。

description.en: ★ 2 │ Desktop, browser and webhook notifications when the agent finishes a turn, hits an error or waits for approval.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ Agent 完成回合、出错或等待审批时，通过桌面、浏览器或 Webhook 提醒你。

description.en: ★ 2 │ Send native desktop notifications or webhooks when tasks complete, fail or wait for confirmation.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 在任务完成、失败或等待确认时发送桌面原生通知或 Webhook 消息。

description.en: ★ 59 │ Send notifications through 28 outbound channels and handle approvals, questions and session control from your phone through 6 inbound channels.
description.zh: ★ 59 │ 通过 28 个出站渠道推送通知，并经 6 个入站渠道在手机上处理审批、回答提问和控制会话。

description.en: Adds Windows-native toast notifications and a system tray icon to dsh: alerts when the agent finishes, stops, or errors, with a tray menu to reopen the web…
description.zh: 为 dsh 添加 Windows 原生 Toast 通知与系统托盘图标：agent 完成、停止或出错时弹通知，托盘菜单可重新打开网页或退出后台进程。

description.en: Bark push notifications to iPhone: turn completion, waiting-for-input, and approval events sent from the DSH Host.
description.zh: Bark 推送通知到 iPhone：回合完成、等待回答、等待授权等事件由 Host 端发送。

description.en: Floating approval window for DeepSeek Harness that appears when you leave the app and hands the request back to the native card when you return. Windows-only…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的独立审批浮窗：离开应用时弹出，切回时把请求交还原生卡片。仅 Windows（WPF/PowerShell）；独立分支自 zeta987/dsh-notify-zeta（MIT），不能与上游同时运行。

description.en: Windows native toast notifications for DSH desktop sessions: turn ends, approvals, questions and a reminder for an unanswered wait — each with its own sound…
description.zh: DSH 桌面端会话的 Windows 原生 Toast 通知：回合结束、审批、提问与未应答催办，每个情况可单独选择音效与弹窗文本（每个情况最多 3 套命名模板），支持三种通知形式、预览效果与导入自定义音效；点击通知把 DSH 窗口拉回前台。

description.en: Browser system notification, sounded by the OS notification itself, when a session needs a reply or a run goes idle; no page-focus check, at most one…
description.zh: 会话出现待回复交互或一轮跑完落到空闲时弹出浏览器系统通知，提示音由系统通知自带；不判断页面是否聚焦，每个会话最多保留一条通知、新通知顶掉旧的，空闲时若还有后台任务会在正文里说明数量。

description.en: ★ 79 │ Show desktop or webhook notifications for task completion, questions and approvals.
description.zh: ★ 79 │ 为任务完成、提问和审批发送桌面或 Webhook 通知。

description.en: Windows desktop notifications for DSH that speak the turn result by default: Windows TTS needs no download, and 13 VOICEVOX voice packs can be installed from the settings page. A completed alert waits until running subagents and background jobs finish; approval, question and error alerts fire immediately. Voice packs are downloaded from GitHub after a terms confirmation.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 Windows 桌面通知，默认把回合结果读出来：Windows TTS 零下载即可用，另有 13 个 VOICEVOX 语音包可在设置页下载。完成提醒会等子代理与后台任务结束后再响；审批、提问、出错立即提醒。语音包从 GitHub 下载，下载前需确认使用条款。

description.en: Email reminders from your DSH agent when you're away: fires at goal completion, blockage, before asking the user a decision, and at long-task milestones via a…
description.zh: 你不在电脑前时由 agent 邮件提醒你：goal 完成、阻塞、向你提问决策前、长任务节点时触发，自带零依赖 Node SMTP 发送器。

description.en: Windows toast notifications when a DeepSeek Harness task finishes: the session title, the outcome, and a summary of the final reply, sent once when the agent…
description.zh: DSH 任务完成时，在 Windows 通知栏弹出原生通知，带上会话标题、结果状态与最后一条回复的摘要；在 agent 真正停下来时才发一条，而不是每跑一个回合就响一次。

description.en: Browser notification plugin for DeepSeek Harness - system toasts when a task finishes, a run errors, or your input is needed (question / approval / plan…
description.zh: DSH 浏览器通知插件 - 任务完成 / 运行出错 / 需要你回答、批准、审阅计划时弹系统级通知，点击气泡直达会话，三类通知独立开关，主会话等子代理期间不误报完成。

description.en: Windows system and custom desktop notifications for DeepSeek Harness events: task completed, failed, running, awaiting approval, and awaiting answer.…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness事件的Windows系统和自定义桌面通知：任务已完成、失败、正在运行、等待批准和等待答复。单击以跳转到会话。

description.en: Notion connector for DeepSeek Harness: search, read, query, create, update, and append Notion pages and databases via six agent tools, with a Web settings page…
description.zh: 配置一次 Notion Integration Token，Agent 即可搜索、读取、查询、创建、更新、追加 Notion 页面与数据库内容，并提供 Web 设置页。

description.en: ★ 2 │ Connect Notion from the GUI with OAuth 2.0 + PKCE, using the official Notion MCP with no integration token.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 在界面中通过 OAuth 连接官方 Notion MCP，无需另填集成令牌。

description.en: Novel writing panel for the DSH sidebar that binds a local manuscript folder, imports Agent Skills as analysis lenses, and scans platform rankings into…
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏的小说创作面板：绑定本地书稿目录，把导入的 Agent 技能当作分析视角，并扫描平台榜单归纳故事架构。

description.en: A novel-writing workbench for DeepSeek Harness: you tap thumbs-up or thumbs-down on candidate passages, and the model distils them into a short preference…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的小说写作工作台：你在候选段落上点赞或点踩，模型把这批点选蒸馏成一份简短的「作者偏好档案」带进后续写稿，正文本身不进写稿上下文。另有章节看板、每章写作包、只改被批注段落并逐字核对其余段落的批注式微调、项目台账，以及不把正文送进模型的本地情节体检。

description.en: ★ 31 │ Manage chapter drafting, setting constraints, repetition checks and whole-book reviews.
description.zh: ★ 31 │ 管理章节写作、设定约束、重复检查、批量起草与全书复核。

description.en: Novel generator: builds a world snapshot along a story timeline and, from the latest snapshot and the most recent chapters, deduces the next chapter. Requires…
description.zh: 小说生成器：按时间线生成世界快照，通过世界快照和最近章节自动推演新章节。需 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2。

description.en: New in v0.3.0, import your own TXT three ways - pick files or drag them in, browse folders and click a book, or type a path - while an AI companion rides along…
description.zh: v0.3.0 新增三种导入：选文件或直接拖进来、浏览目录点选、手填路径——选文件存的是内容哈希命名的副本，重复导入不重复加，你的原文件永不被碰；浏览目录走零复制。另有 AI 陪读在 DSH 右侧栏陪你看本地 TXT 小说，边读边吐槽：定时就着刚读到的内容说一句，也能随时点「现在就说」，四种风格可选，右下角常驻人物与气泡…

description.en: "Single-Core Writing" plugin for DeepSeek Harness: Thoroughly tool-streamlined and output-hardened for quantized small models, suitable for running long-novel…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的「单核写作」插件：面向量化小模型做了充分的工具瘦身与输出加固，适合在本机用本地模型跑长篇小说流水线。

description.en: A full-screen novel-writing workbench: chapter board, draft candidates reviewed and merged paragraph by paragraph, plot summaries carrying an index header, and…
description.zh: 一页式小说创作工作台：章节看板、候选稿逐段评审与合稿、带索引头的剧情总结，以及由大纲、人物卡与前文拼成的写作包。还能导入几本成品书，一次跑完粗扫、精读、汇总并融合成一套写法标准，写进偏好档案，之后每次生成都照着它来。

description.en: ★ 24 │ Manage chapter references, narrative continuity, revision checks and writing materials.
description.zh: ★ 24 │ 管理章节参考、叙事连贯性、改稿检查与创作素材。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Check application structure and potential identity disclosures in document text and metadata using supplied rosters and rules.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 依据提供的名单和规则，核对基金申请结构及正文、文档属性中的潜在身份泄露。

description.en: Connect any ACP-capable agent to DSH and use DSH as a single entry point for all conversations and tasks. Models, thinking levels and permission modes come…
description.zh: 把任意支持 ACP 的 Agent 接进 DSH，用 DSH 一个入口管理所有会话和任务。模型、思考等级和权限模式由 Agent 自己提供；工具调用显示在主聊天区，diff 汇总到独立的 NTR 页，权限询问出现在输入框。使用前需在本机安装支持 ACP 的 Agent 命令行工具。

description.en: Official DSH plugin for nuphus-mcp (by the nuphus-mcp maintainers): desktop and browser automation (38 tools) with PaddleOCR element perception and Chrome CDP…
description.zh: nuphus-mcp 官方 DSH 插件（由 nuphus-mcp 维护者发布）：桌面 + 浏览器自动化（38 个工具），配 PaddleOCR 元素感知与 Chrome CDP 浏览，经常驻 stdio MCP 子进程接入。

description.en: Checks nursing records for entry timing, signatures and assessment-form completeness, against 《病历书写基本规范》 and other published documents. Reports what is missing…
description.zh: 依据《病历书写基本规范》等公开文件，核对护理记录的书写时限、签名，以及评估表的完整性。列出缺失或次序不符之处供人复核。

description.en: Adds subscription OAuth and provider Plan API-key logins through Pi adapters, using a DSH-owned credential store.
description.zh: 通过 Pi 适配器接入订阅 OAuth 和厂商 Plan API Key 登录，使用独立的 DSH 凭据存储。

description.en: Distills session work into background observations and reflections to preserve context across compaction.
description.zh: 在后台将会话工作提炼为观察和反思，以便在上下文压缩后保留会话上下文。

description.en: Exports the session event stream to OpenTelemetry OTLP and Langfuse as sanitized, buffered traces and metrics, off by default.
description.zh: 将会话事件流导出为 OpenTelemetry OTLP 与 Langfuse 的脱敏、缓冲 traces 与指标，默认关闭。

description.en: ★ 37 │ Connect DeepSeek Harness (dsh) to a local Obsidian vault: search, read, write, move, and trash notes.
description.zh: ★ 37 │ 搜索、读取、编辑、移动和删除本机 Obsidian 笔记。

description.en: Turns a local Obsidian vault into a dedicated RAG chat panel: a sidebar page with the note browser, the retrieval-augmented chat and the cited source side by…
description.zh: 把本地 Obsidian 仓库变成专属 RAG 对话面板：侧栏一个完整页面，左侧笔记浏览、中间检索增强对话、右侧引用原文；检索用完全本地的 BM25 加中文 bigram，回答走 DSH 模型通道，[n] 引用可点击，索引按 mtime 增量更新。

description.en: Ambient fullscreen status grid for DeepSeek Harness sessions with token/rate graphs, plus ntfy push and alarm notifications when a turn ends, errors, or waits…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 全屏状态看板：会话状态网格与 token/速率图表一览无余，回合结束、出错或等待审批时通过 ntfy 推送与铃声提醒。

description.en: An opencode-inspired terminal UI for DeepSeek Harness that boots as a dsh profile app plugin, with a session sidebar, streaming chat, markdown tool cards, todo…
description.zh: 受 opencode 启发的 DeepSeek Harness 终端界面，以 dsh profile 应用插件形式启动，提供会话侧栏、流式聊天、markdown 工具卡片、待办列表、斜杠命令建议、带上下文用量表的遥测底栏与内联审批提示。

description.en: Local OCR using Apple Vision on macOS: text from screenshots, photos, and scans, with no install, no network and no API key.
description.zh: 在 macOS 上使用 Apple Vision 的本地 OCR：从截图、照片和扫描件中读取文字，无需安装、无需联网、无需 API 密钥。

description.en: Local OCR fallback for text-only routes: when the session model declares it cannot accept images, the attached image is cached locally and its path injected so…
description.zh: 纯文本路由的本地 OCR 兜底：会话模型明确声明不接受图片时，把附件的图片存入本地缓存并注入路径，模型调 ocr_image 用 PP-OCRv5 + ONNX Runtime 在纯 CPU 上离线识别，无需 API key，图片不出本机；模型能看图时静默。

description.en: Read-only Odoo tools over JSON-RPC: server info, model field introspection, and a restricted search_read limited to an allow list of models whose domain field…
description.zh: 经 JSON-RPC 的 Odoo 只读工具：服务器信息、模型字段自省，以及受限的 search_read——仅限白名单模型，且 domain 字段名不允许包含点号，因此无法沿关联关系穿透。草稿创建工具需显式开启 allowWrite 才会注册，且仅限 sale.order 与…

description.en: Spec-Driven Development pipeline for Odoo: 15 tools take a request from an immutable spec through architecture to module code or live configuration, then…
description.zh: 面向 Odoo 的规范驱动开发流水线：15 个工具把需求从不可变规范推进到架构、再到模块代码或线上配置，最终要求一个由真实 Odoo 实例证据支撑的持久判定；闸门 fail-closed，批量操作需在声明的环境中经人工批准，复用 Odoo 自带的 CSV／Excel 导入器，并有一份可回滚本插件所写数据的日志。

description.en: ★ 0 │ DeepSeek Harness pill showing whether the selected DeepSeek or z.ai billing plan is in a peak or off-peak (half-price) window right now, with a click-to-open schedule panel.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 显示当前 DeepSeek 或 z.ai 套餐所处的峰谷计费时段，点击查看时段表。

description.en: Office workspace & session dashboard: a floating 6-column sprite panel visualizing workspaces, sessions, token usage and subagents, plus Agent Mail and an…
description.zh: 办公室工作区/会话仪表盘：悬浮 6 列精灵面板，可视化工作区、会话、token 用量与子代理，并提供 Agent Mail 与办公日志页签。飞书相关视图（消息流、会议日程、妙记逐字稿）另需自行安装并授权 `@larksuite/cli`。

description.en: Creates, reads, and edits DOCX, PDF, PPTX, and XLSX through `/documents`, `/pdf`, `/presentations`, and `/spreadsheets`; renders pages to check layout, and…
description.zh: 通过 `/documents`、`/pdf`、`/presentations`、`/spreadsheets` 创建、读取与编辑 DOCX、PDF、PPTX、XLSX，把页面渲染出来核对排版，并将侧边栏预览中的选区变成发给会话的修改要求。需 Python 3.10–3.13。

description.en: Renders live multi-agent session activity as a pixel-art office in a Web UI side panel - each session is an ox/horse worker typing at its desk when busy or…
description.zh: 把多 agent 会话的实时活动渲染成 Web UI 侧边栏里的像素风办公室--每个会话是一名牛/马员工，忙时伏案敲键盘、闲时起身摸鱼，支持点击查看工位监控、就地处理审批。

description.en: ★ 40 │ Create and read documents, spreadsheets, and presentations in the session workspace, and update documents and spreadsheets.
description.zh: ★ 40 │ 在会话工作区中创建和读取文档、表格与演示文稿，并更新文档和表格。

description.en: A web theme recreating the DeepSeek Harness homepage with a fluid background, an elastic pointer grid, animated fish, and adjustable effects.
description.zh: 复刻 DeepSeek Harness 首页视觉的 Web 主题，提供流体背景、鼠标弹性网格、动态小鱼与可调节效果。

description.en: Pauses peak-hour requests that target official or listed models and lets everything else run, with editable peak windows, a per-model interception list and…
description.zh: 高峰时段只暂停指向官方或拦截列表内模型的请求，其余照常放行；峰谷时段、按模型的拦截列表与会话「畅跑」都能在徽标面板里编辑。

description.en: ★ 23 │ Use an authenticated Claude Code CLI as a model provider, forwarding sessions, approvals and image input.
description.zh: ★ 23 │ 把已登录的 Claude Code CLI 接为模型提供方，转发会话、审批和图片输入。

description.en: Web theme and file workspace plugin with global typography controls, @file mentions, a project file tree, Markdown preview, and a resizable side panel.
description.zh: DSH Web 主题与文件工作台：全局字体设置、@ 文件引用、项目文件树、Markdown 预览和可拖拽侧边面板。

description.en: Reimplements the shut-down BSide: Olivia Lin letter API on loopback so the game client keeps sending and receiving letters: every incoming letter is delivered…
description.zh: 在回环地址上复现已关停的《BSide: Olivia Lin》信件 API，让游戏客户端照常收发信件：每封来信投进同一个持久 DSH agent 会话，回信写回本地信件库。

description.en: In-chat read-aloud for DeepSeek Harness: tap to read, pause and resume AI replies with natural Doubao TTS voices (BYOK), reading only the final answer with…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 对话内朗读：点一下即可朗读、暂停、继续 AI 回复，豆包 TTS 自然音色（BYOK），只读最终回答并过滤代码、表格与图形，本地引擎，插件零 Key。

description.en: Omni-modal workstation for DSH: analyze_image over an ordered multi-card VLM failover chain, a six-tool vision toolkit (zoom, colour sampling, pixel diff, OCR,…
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的全模态工作站：analyze_image 走有序多卡片 VLM 故障转移链；六个视觉工具箱工具（局部放大、色调采样、像素比对、OCR、元素检测、内联展示）共用同一套图片来源解析；generate_image 支持 OpenAI/DashScope/ComfyUI 协议；多卡片异步…

description.en: Puts the DSH web UI on a phone browser over your own tailnet, with the remote channel built on Tailscale Serve. Both sides need only Tailscale: no dedicated…
description.zh: 让手机浏览器直接使用电脑上的 DSH 网页界面，远程通道建立在 Tailscale Serve 之上。两边除了 Tailscale 不用再装任何东西：没有专用 App、没有二维码、没有登录页，插件不设账号，也不中转你的内容。电脑端支持 macOS、Windows 与 Linux。

description.en: OneBot v11 hub: sits between an upstream OneBot implementation (LLOneBot and similar) and downstream bot implementations, relaying events and actions verbatim, and gives the agent a per-session timeline, an action ledger, layered memory (active topics and tasks, long-term events, person and group profiles) and onebot_* tools for replying, media, members and raw API calls.
description.zh: OneBot v11 枢纽：夹在上游 OneBot 实现（LLOneBot 等）与下游 bot 实现之间，逐字转发事件与动作；给 agent 一条按会话的时间线、动作账本、分层记忆（进行中的话题与任务、长期事件、人物与群档案）以及一组 onebot_* 工具（回复、媒体、成员、原始 API 调用）。

description.en: QQ channel for dsh via OneBot 11 (NapCat and friends): reverse or forward WebSocket, DM and group chats, image and voice transcription, t2i text-image cards, merged forwards, and a settings page.
description.zh: 给 dsh 加上 QQ 通道（OneBot 11，兼容 NapCat）：反向/正向 WS、私聊群聊、图片与语音转写、t2i 文字图卡片、合并转发、设置页可视化配置。

description.en: Windows desktop integration, a one-click launcher and tray controller for DSH, plus a sidebar button that puts DSH and a chat.deepseek.com window side by side…
description.zh: Windows 桌面集成：一键启动器 + 托盘控制器，另加侧边栏按钮把 DSH 和 chat.deepseek.com 并排放置并共用一个任务栏按钮。安装会写入桌面快捷方式并注册 dshsplit: 协议，两者都可用 lib/desktop.ps1 -Mode remove 清除。

description.en: ★ 20 │ A typed, inference-capable ontology (TBox + ABox) plugin for DeepSeek Harness — durable domain knowledge the agent can define, assert against, and query under schema constraints.
description.zh: ★ 20 │ 用类型和规则定义领域知识，保存事实并进行查询和推理。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to OOMOL-managed apps and services, with progressive Connector Action discovery and execution plus an in-app panel for managing…
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 接入由 OOMOL 管理的应用与服务，支持渐进式发现并执行 Connector Actions，并提供用于管理 Provider 连接的应用内面板。

description.en: Alibaba Open Code Review for DSH: host-model delegation with native preview/rule tools and a review skill, plus optional OCR-managed reviews.
description.zh: 将阿里 Open Code Review 接入 DSH：通过原生文件筛选、规则工具和审查技能复用当前会话模型，并提供可选的 OCR 独立审查模式。

description.en: Not another memory plugin: ODR is an evolving-worlds self-improvement loop (Dream-RSI) — attempts are recorded into a Discovery Tree, and between runs…
description.zh: 不是又一个记忆插件：ODR 是“演化世界”式（Dream-RSI）自我改进回路——每次尝试都记入发现树（Discovery Tree），任务间歇将数千个策略变体在这棵记录下来的世界上回放；策略、配方或经验只有通过反事实回放的考验才会晋升，绝不因模型自己说好就获得信任，Sentinel…

description.en: Open DSH workspace directories in installed file managers, terminals, and supported editors from the Web UI.
description.zh: 从 DSH Web UI 使用已安装的文件管理器、终端和受支持的编辑器打开工作区目录。

description.en: ★ 101 │ Adds this market to Discover and an Open Market tab to the Plugins page: rotating daily picks, rows ranked by likes and growth, a checkup of installed plugins, and likes that count once a day per plugin.
description.zh: ★ 101 │ 把开放插件市场加入「发现」，并在插件页增加「开放市场」标签：轮播的今日推荐、按点赞和增长排的推荐行、已装插件体检，每个插件每天可以点赞一次。

description.en: Click a delivered-file card to open the file with the system default application instead of DSH's built-in sidebar preview; hold Shift to keep the original…
description.zh: 点击交付文件卡片时用系统默认程序打开文件，而不是在 DSH 侧边栏里预览；按住 Shift 保留原来的预览行为。

description.en: Open the current registered Workspace from the Session Header or Workspace menu in a detected or configured editor, with hot re-detection and a remembered…
description.zh: 从 Session 页头或 Workspace 菜单用检测到或配置的编辑器打开当前已登记 Workspace，支持热重新检测和浏览器首选项记忆。

description.en: Share an existing OpenClaw Markdown workspace with DeepSeek Harness as bounded persona and memory context, with Sidebar browsing and editing.
description.zh: 把现有 OpenClaw Markdown workspace 作为有界的人格与记忆上下文共享给 DeepSeek Harness，并提供 Sidebar 浏览与编辑。

description.en: Browser tools for DSH that POST to the local OpenCLI daemon instead of spawning the opencli CLI per command, avoiding its cold start: oc_status, oc_exec,…
description.zh: 把本机 OpenCLI daemon 当常驻服务直连的 DSH 浏览器工具，替代「每条命令起一次 opencli CLI」的冷启动：oc_status、oc_exec、oc_navigate、oc_snapshot、oc_tabs 五个工具，每个 session 一个常驻自动化标签页。需要本机运行 OpenCLI…

description.en: OpenCode free models for DSH with dynamic model-list refresh, optional HTTP(S)/SOCKS proxy failover, a fail-closed tool bridge and offline agent-scoped…
description.zh: 在 DSH 中使用 OpenCode 免费模型，支持模型列表动态刷新与可选的代理出口轮换，并提供默认拒绝不安全转换的工具桥与离线、按 Agent 作用域的兼容性审计。

description.en: Bridge DSH to OpenCode-compatible models via the local OpenCode CLI: native LlmAdapter passthrough, persistent OC sessions with cross-turn tool results, tool…
description.zh: 经本机 OpenCode CLI 在 DSH 中使用 OpenCode 兼容模型：原生 LlmAdapter 透传、OC 会话持久续接（工具结果跨轮可见）、工具镜像回传、CLI 环境检测面板。需本机已安装 OpenCode CLI。

description.en: Brings the free models of a locally installed OpenCode CLI into DSH: starts or reuses a local opencode serve, discovers the live catalog and refreshes it every…
description.zh: 把本机已安装的 OpenCode CLI 免费模型接入 DSH：自动拉起或复用本地 opencode serve，读取实时模型目录并每五分钟刷新，再通过仅绑定回环、校验 Host 与 Origin 的 shim 把会话事件流转换为 OpenAI 兼容 SSE。

description.en: Free model provider plugin for DSH with 20+ models including Gemini, MiMo, GLM, etc.
description.zh: DSH free model provider plugin with 20+ models including Gemini, MiMo, GLM, etc.

description.en: ★ 214 │ Manage OpenCode Go models and multiple accounts with subscription quota displays in DSH.
description.zh: ★ 214 │ 在 DSH 中管理 OpenCode Go 模型与多个账号，并显示订阅额度。

description.en: Serves the live opencode Go model catalog from the harness's built-in opencode-go provider route.
description.zh: 让 DSH 自带的 opencode-go 供应商跟随 opencode Go 套餐的实时模型列表，opencode 上架新模型后无需改配置即可使用。

description.en: ★ 2 │ DSH plugin: standalone OpenCode GO LlmAdapter that owns its provider route, with per-model wire protocols (including union-alpha's anthropic-messages), and manages models, context and modalities.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 独立接入 OpenCode Go，为不同模型设置通信协议，管理上下文和输入类型。

description.en: Adds an independent OpenCode Go connection with credential settings, manual model discovery, and per-conversation session headers.
description.zh: 添加独立的 OpenCode Go 连接，支持密钥设置、手动获取模型和按会话发送标识。

description.en: ★ 1 │ DSH (DeepSeek Harness) plugin: OpenCode GO plan quota widget in the sidebar, same-origin usage proxy, and a /opencode-go chat command
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 在侧栏显示 OpenCode Go 套餐额度，支持通过 /opencode-go 查询。

description.en: ★ 89 │ Apply a collection of persistent color themes to the web interface.
description.zh: ★ 89 │ 为网页界面应用多套可持久保存的主题配色。

description.en: ★ 8 │ OpenCode on DeepSeek Harness: session affinity, Zen/Go gateway origin headers, free-tier tool fallback, and live Go quota display.
description.zh: ★ 8 │ 接入 OpenCode Zen/Go，保持会话与网关的对应关系，提供免费档工具调用回退和 Go 额度显示。

description.en: Attaches a stable per-conversation x-opencode-session header to OpenCode / OpenCode Go provider requests, fixing 400 MissingSessionID errors and keeping…
description.zh: 为 OpenCode / OpenCode Go 提供商请求自动附加每个会话稳定的 x-opencode-session 请求头，修复 400 MissingSessionID 错误，同时保持会话亲和与提示缓存路由。

description.en: Adds OpenCode Zen free models to DeepSeek Harness as one provider, backed by a managed, isolated OpenCode runtime, with a Settings page that lists each model…
description.zh: 把 OpenCode Zen 的免费模型作为一组 provider 接入 DeepSeek Harness，底层是受管、隔离的 OpenCode 运行时，并在设置页列出每个模型并可逐个检测。

description.en: OpenCode Zen free-tier models for DeepSeek Harness with anonymous no-key access, a loopback OpenAI-compatible shim, and real bash/read gate tools.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 OpenCode Zen 免费模型：默认免 key 走公共额度，内置回环 OpenAI 兼容 shim，并把网关要求的 bash/read 注册为真实可执行工具。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness integration for OpenContext with durable cross-session memory, automatic prompt capture and recall, session summaries, structured insights,…
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 OpenContext，提供跨会话持久记忆、提示词自动捕获与召回、会话摘要、结构化洞察和文档检索。

description.en: OpenDesign Go provider: 12 subscription models over Chat Completions, the real 5-hour and 7-day quota read from the local OpenDesign app, per-model parameters…
description.zh: OpenDesign Go 模型提供方：以 Chat Completions 协议接入 12 个订阅模型，从本机 OpenDesign 客户端读取真实的 5 小时 / 7 天额度，支持每模型参数与开关、多账号失败切换。

description.en: OpenRouter provider that reads the live /models list, so new models appear without a harness release: models sorted by name with input/output prices, per-model…
description.zh: 读取 OpenRouter 实时 /models 列表的模型提供商，新模型无需等待 harness 发版即可出现：模型按名称排序并显示输入/输出价格，按模型提供思考档位、图片输入、reasoning_details 回放、Anthropic 提示缓存，并按 OpenRouter usage.cost…

description.en: Per-Session OpenRouter routing: a loopback relay writes `service_tier`, `provider.sort` and the `:floor` variant into each request from one of nine presets…
description.zh: 按会话切换 OpenRouter 路由：本地回环中继把 `service_tier`、`provider.sort` 与 `:floor` 变体写进每个请求，九个预设从输入框的按钮里选，每个预设另有固定的基址供整条路由使用。

description.en: Ranks OpenRouter providers for the current DSH model by quantization, speed, cache-heavy price, context, and uptime, with one-click switching to help reduce…
description.zh: 按量化、速度、缓存重度价格、上下文和可用率为当前 DSH 模型推荐 OpenRouter 供应商，并支持一键切换以帮助降低 token 成本。

description.en: ★ 4 │ OpenRouter Provider List sets provider and quantization limits for OpenRouter requests, injected as provider.only, provider.order, and provider.quantizations. It can optionally route through billion-context.
description.zh: ★ 4 │ 设置 OpenRouter 请求使用的上游供应商、调用顺序和量化规格，可经 billion-context 转发。

description.en: ★ 0 │ DeepSeek Harness plugin: shows what the OpenRouter account actually charged today, per chat and in total, under the composer and in Settings, split by model and API key.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 显示 OpenRouter 今日和各会话的实际扣费，按模型与 API 密钥查看明细。

description.en: A dsh-better-sidebar reader for CSV/TSV/PSV files and xlsx/xlsm workbooks: a sortable, filterable table with sheet tabs. Ceilings on rows, columns and cells,…
description.zh: dsh-better-sidebar 的表格读取视图：读取 CSV/TSV/PSV 与 xlsx/xlsm 工作簿，表头可点击排序、可按子串筛选，多工作表以标签切换。行数、列数与单元格数均有上限，另有两道 zip 容器闸门，任何输入都不会卡死标签页。

description.en: OpenSpec spec-driven workflows for DeepSeek Harness, generated from OpenSpec 1.14.3: twelve /opsx-* slash commands that carry the workflow prompt plus the…
description.zh: 把 OpenSpec 的规格驱动工作流接入 DeepSeek Harness，内容由 OpenSpec 1.14.3 生成：12 个 /opsx-* 斜杠命令会把工作流提示词与你输入的参数一起注入会话，另有 12 个由模型自行加载的 openspec-* 技能。

description.en: ★ 6 │ OpenViking in the DSH web GUI: a Studio panel, a per-session memory-commit status pill with its commit timeline, and a right-sidebar tab showing what the current session retrieves.
description.zh: ★ 6 │ 在 OpenViking Studio 面板管理记忆，在会话中查看记忆保存记录和检索内容。

description.en: ★ 2 │ Configure the OpenViking memory plugin, diagnose connections and tune session recall scope and injection settings.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 配置 OpenViking 记忆插件、诊断连接，并调整会话召回范围和注入参数。

description.en: Brings the codebase knowledge-base capability of langchain-ai/openwiki into DSH — one-click generate/read/update of the repository Wiki, Grounded Claims…
description.zh: 把 langchain-ai/openwiki 的代码库知识库能力搬进 dsh —— 一键生成 / 阅读 / 更新仓库 Wiki 与 Grounded Claims（溯源知识卡片）与项目知识库（上传本地文件），直接复用 DSH 已配置的模型，无需二次填 Key。

description.en: Novel-writing workbench for DSH with an authoring preset, outline and character management, manuscript annotations, review workflows, and a managed local Python backend.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的小说创作工作台，提供创作预设、大纲与人物管理、正文批注、审稿流程和受管理的本地 Python 后端。

description.en: ★ 4,886 │ Provide Bash, PowerShell 7 and Rust-based command tools for DSH on Windows.
description.zh: ★ 4,886 │ 为 Windows 上的 DSH 提供 Bash、PowerShell 7 和 Rust 命令工具。

description.en: Persistent Endeavour and Challenger peer sessions for DeepSeek Harness that plan, execute sequential tasks, and verify reported results.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供常驻的 Endeavour 与 Challenger 对等会话：负责规划、按序执行任务，并核验汇报的结果。

description.en: ★ 2 │ Drives local Origin/OriginPro from chat: imports data, plots, fits, exports images and saves editable .opju projects; 27 MCP tools. Third-party, unaffiliated with OriginLab.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 在对话中操作本机 Origin/OriginPro，导入数据、绘图、拟合和导出，并保存可编辑的 .opju 工程。

description.en: ★ 32 │ Control OriginLab data import, scientific plot templates and figure edits through MCP tools.
description.zh: ★ 32 │ 通过 MCP 工具操作 OriginLab 数据导入、科研图模板与图表编辑。

description.en: Deliverables registry for DeepSeek Harness: agents register the final artifacts of a task (reports, pages, documents, sheets, images, datasets) into one…
description.zh: DSH 成果登记：agent 把一次任务的最终成果（报告、网页、文档、表格、图片、数据表）登记进设置页与管理页的同一份清单，只记路径、不搬文件，删除可撤销；独立 CLI（add/list/stats/check/remove/restore）在应用外也能查同一份清单，并核对登记的文件是否还在。

description.en: A philosopher's way of thinking made executable: dialectics and practice-testing to govern hallucination and long-session drift, so done is a verifiable fact…
description.zh: 把哲学家的思考方式变成可执行的东西：用辩证法和实践检验治理幻觉与长会话漂移，让「做完了」是可核事实而不是一句自述。

description.en: Outer Wilds theme with a static starfield, campfire effects, appearance settings, and bundled Jost and Source Han Sans fonts.
description.zh: 以《星际拓荒》为主题，提供静态星空、篝火动效、外观设置和内置 Jost 与思源黑体。

description.en: Zero-credential Outlook automation: 13 tools that drive the local desktop Outlook client via COM — search/read mail, drafts, reply/forward, calendar, address…
description.zh: 零凭据 Outlook 自动化：13 个工具通过 COM 直接驱动本地桌面 Outlook 客户端——搜信/读信/草稿/回复转发/日历/通讯录/会议室/忙闲查询——外加侧边栏新邮件角标。无需 Graph API 注册、无需 SMTP 密码；任何外发动作都过三层人工审批门。

description.en: Auto-expand reasoning and tool cards, tune code-block font size and line spacing, and choose the model output language (auto, Chinese or English).
description.zh: 自动展开思考与工具卡片，调整代码块字号与行距，并可选择模型输出语言（自动、中文或 English）。

description.en: Runtime-switchable model output styles with Claude Code outputStyles parity, plus the output.render.* presentation protocol: a /style command, per-session…
description.zh: 运行时切换模型输出风格（对标 Claude Code outputStyles），另加 output.render.* 呈现协议：/style 命令、按会话持久化、systemPrompt 注入、六个内置风格、Web 选择器，以及带按会话/按工具规则与 /export 的渲染器注册表。

description.en: Agent presets whose leader does no work itself: every non-management tool call is denied at the harness boundary so the task has to go to a subagent, after a…
description.zh: 让领导不亲自干活的 agent preset：非管理类工具调用在 harness 边界一律被拒，任务只能外包给子智能体，选人前先一次性摸清可选子智能体模型、再按任务逐个选型；另一个 preset 故意挑最不适合该任务的模型。

description.en: Connect multiple Overleaf projects to DSH through OverleafMCP for browsing, analysis, and Git-based file updates.
description.zh: 通过 OverleafMCP 将多个 Overleaf 项目接入 DSH，支持浏览、分析和通过 Git 写回 LaTeX 文件。

description.en: Running pace calculator: converts distance and time to min/km pace and km/h speed.
description.zh: 跑步配速计算：根据距离与时间换算配速（分/公里）与速度（公里/小时）。

description.en: ★ 20 │ Use PackyCode API keys in DeepSeek Harness, with multi-protocol models, image generation and editing, separate key rings, and balance display.
description.zh: ★ 20 │ 通过 PackyCode API 接入多协议模型和图片生成、编辑工具，管理密钥与余额。

description.en: Adds a refresh button and a power menu (restart / close DeepSeek Harness) to the conversation header. Client-only, zero tokens, no dependencies. The power menu…
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 会话头部加一个刷新按钮和一个电源菜单（重启 / 关闭 DeepSeek Harness）。纯客户端、零 token、零依赖。电源菜单目前仅支持 Windows。

description.en: A draggable pet in a blue-whale onesie: sticks to window edges, squashes flat, blinks, sleeps, and shows agent status in a thought cloud.
description.zh: 一个穿着蓝色鲸鱼连体衣、可拖动的宠物：会贴住窗口边缘、被压扁，会眨眼、睡觉，并用气泡显示智能体状态。

description.en: A conversation-view tab for DeepSeek Harness Web showing solar/lunar dates, ganzhi year/month/day, Chinese zodiac, 24 solar terms, festivals, China public…
description.zh: 会话页头的「熊猫日历」标签页：公历/农历、干支、生肖、24 节气、传统与外国节日、中国法定节假日（含调休）、多城市天气、时间戳转换（秒/毫秒 ↔ 年月日时分秒，可选时区）与内置离线的「历史上的今天」，数据免费、无需 API Key。

description.en: Panellist manager: reorder the entries on the left rail, rename them, replace their icons, hide them, and fold several into a Group with a flyout menu, from a…
description.zh: 面板列表管理器：在设置页里调整左侧轨道上的页签顺序、改名、换图标、隐藏，并把若干页签收进带飞出菜单的分组。

description.en: ★ 7 │ Paoding: an installer for DSH (DeepSeek Harness) orchestration mode, with host-aware role tool filtering and a visual configurator on the Web settings page.
description.zh: ★ 7 │ 安装庖丁编排模式，在网页中配置角色，并按宿主环境筛选各角色可用工具。

description.en: DSH Web GUI paperclip button: a 📎 button in the composer opens a file picker (drag & drop supported) and inserts file contents into the textarea.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 输入框添加回形针按钮：点击选择文件（支持拖拽），文件内容自动插入输入框。

description.en: Overleaf-style LaTeX paper workbench: annotate any text in the rendered PDF and let a dsh agent revise the sources with compile checks and git history.
description.zh: Overleaf 式 LaTeX 论文工作台：在渲染后的 PDF 上选中任意文字批注，由 dsh agent 改写源文件、编译验证并提交 git 修订。

description.en: ★ 80 │ dsh-passwords: a server-grade gateway that turns DeepSeek Harness into a multi-tenant platform — remote access + automatic HTTPS, per-subuser permissions & quotas, sandbox enforcement, first-run setup, SQLite auth with at-rest encryption, rate-limit and audit log (bilingual zh/en UI)
description.zh: ★ 80 │ 为远程访问配置登录、用户权限、配额、HTTPS 与审计日志。

description.en: Collapses long pasted text into an expandable chip in the composer: hover shows the body and where it came from, sending expands it back in place, and long…
description.zh: 长文本粘贴自动折叠成可展开的胶囊：悬停看正文与出处，发送时按原位展开；其他插件写入的长文本同样接管。

description.en: Cherry Studio-style paste: multi-line/indented/fenced text or code pasted into the DSH Web composer collapses into a bordered, collapsible, language-tagged…
description.zh: Cherry Studio 式粘贴：把多行/缩进/围栏文本或代码粘进 DSH Web 输入框时收成带边框、可折叠、带语言标签的卡片，发送时还原为围栏代码块。

description.en: Turns large text pastes into pastes/*.txt attachments with a dock above the composer and a minimal, recognisable badge in the draft.
description.zh: 大段文本粘贴自动存为 pastes/*.txt 附件,输入框上方 dock 卡片管理,草稿内只留可辨识的最小徽标。

description.en: Paste non-image files or folders into the chat composer as native @path references, or drag them in as absolute paths, instead of the images-only error.
description.zh: 将非图片文件或文件夹以原生 @path 引用粘贴进聊天输入框，或拖放插入绝对路径，替代仅支持图片的报错。

description.en: Finder clipboard paste for macOS: Cmd+C files or folders in Finder, then Ctrl+V in the DSH composer inserts their absolute paths; ordinary text paste with…
description.zh: macOS Finder 剪贴板粘贴：在 Finder 里 Cmd+C 复制文件或文件夹，回到 DSH 按 Ctrl+V 把绝对路径插入输入框；普通文本粘贴的 Cmd+V 不受影响。

description.en: Folds each 4-50 KB paste in the DSH composer into its own chip (expand or delete it individually), and turns a paste of 50 KB or more into a real file…
description.zh: 把 DSH 输入框里每次 4–50 KB 的粘贴折叠成独立的一枚 chip（可单独展开或删除），50 KB 及以上的粘贴转成真附件。声明 DSH >=0.1.7-rc.2 <0.3.0-0，因此在 0.2 版本线上保持可见。

description.en: A lightweight, general-purpose attachment Dock for DSH: paste, drop, or choose images, PDFs, documents, archives, code, and other files, review and manage them…
description.zh: 一个轻量、通用的 DSH 附件 Dock：支持粘贴、拖入或选择图片、PDF、文档、压缩包、代码等文件，发送前统一查看和管理，再以本地路径交给 Agent；解决非图片文件缺少统一附件入口的问题。

description.en: Applies structured unified diffs (git format) to the real filesystem: multi-file/hunk parsing, fuzzy hunk location with line-offset correction, all-or-nothing…
description.zh: 将结构化 unified diff（git 格式）应用到真实文件系统：多文件/多 hunk 解析、带行号偏移修正的模糊定位、全有或全无的应用与类型化冲突报告、反向补丁撤销日记及 dry-run——4 个 patch_* dsh 工具外加一个 CLI。

description.en: Patch-style file editing: one apply_patch tool accepting git/unified diff (default) and Codex apply_patch syntax (opt-in), applying every change all-or-nothing after a full read-only verification pass, with sandbox-aware delete and move and a dry-run mode.
description.zh: 补丁风格文件编辑：单个 apply_patch 工具，接受 git/unified diff（默认）与 Codex apply_patch 语法（可选开启），在完整只读校验后全量原子应用；删除与移动走沙箱感知路径，并提供 dry-run 模式。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness memory and knowledge hub that routes update, retrieve, and subscribe calls across compatible plugins, with an optional transactional Rust…
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的记忆与知识中台：在兼容插件之间路由 update、retrieve 和 subscribe 调用，并提供可选的事务化 Rust 后端。

description.en: Ctrl+click file paths and links in chat: paths open their folder in the OS file manager (with the file selected), links open in a new browser tab.
description.zh: 在对话中 Ctrl+点击文件路径与链接：路径在文件管理器中定位所在文件夹，链接在新标签页打开。

description.en: ★ 26 │ Pause before the next model request so the user can add instructions and continue manually.
description.zh: ★ 26 │ 在下一次模型请求前暂停，允许用户补充文字并手动继续。

description.en: One header button stops running turns, goals and background jobs and writes the plan to disk; after a restart the same button picks the work up again.
description.zh: 会话头一个按钮停掉回合、目标和后台任务，写盘；重启后同一个按钮把工作接回来。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Compare a local payroll table against supplied social-insurance, housing-fund and tax parameters; lists differences and rules it could not check. Does not file reports. Requires DSH >=0.2.1-0 <0.3.0 and Node ^22.19 or >=24.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 按提供的社保、公积金和个税参数核对本地工资表，列出差异及无法执行的规则，不代申报。需 DSH >=0.2.1-0 <0.3.0、Node ^22.19 或 >=24。

description.en: Registers the remove-pdf-background-gray skill for DSH: whitens gray/off-white scan backgrounds in image-based PDFs while preserving resolution, page geometry,…
description.zh: 注册 remove-pdf-background-gray 技能：去除扫描 PDF 的灰色/米白底色，保持分辨率、页面几何与抗锯齿文字边缘（无损 Flate 写回），核心为单文件 Python 脚本（pypdf + Pillow + numpy）。

description.en: PDF outline navigation and local reading bookmarks in the existing right-sidebar file preview; supports adding, renaming, deleting and revisiting page…
description.zh: 在现有右侧文件预览中提供 PDF 内嵌目录导航与本地阅读书签，可添加、改名、删除和跳回页内位置，并有版本与完整性保护。已验证 macOS Apple Silicon 上的 dsh Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2 与 0.2.1-rc.3。

description.en: PDF document editing plugin for precise text editing in PDF files.
description.zh: 面向 PDF 文档的编辑插件,精确编辑PDF文字

description.en: ★ 22 │ Parse documents with MinerU cloud or self-hosted providers, using background jobs, cached results and shared requests.
description.zh: ★ 22 │ 通过 MinerU 云端或自托管服务解析文档，支持后台任务、产物缓存和请求合并。

description.en: Windows PDF translator for DeepSeek Harness: a vision model locates and translates text, tables, figures and formulas; output is a Chinese PDF and a LaTeX…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Windows PDF 翻译插件：由视觉模型识别并翻译正文、表格、图表和公式，输出中文 PDF 与 LaTeX 源码压缩包。需要自备支持图片输入的 OpenAI 兼容 API。

description.en: Turns PDF, Word, PowerPoint and Excel files into Markdown or plain text with heading levels preserved where the source allows it, and refuses scanned PDFs that…
description.zh: 把 PDF、Word、PPT、Excel 转成保留标题层级的 Markdown 或纯文本；遇到没有文字层的扫描件会主动拒绝（退出码 2），不会写一个空文件骗过下游，并指明可改用 OCR（dsh-scan2md）。需 Python 3.10+ 并安装仓库 requirements。

description.en: A chip at the left end of the composer tool row showing whether DeepSeek bills at peak or off-peak right now. Clicking it opens a card with the current state…
description.zh: 输入框工具行左端的小胶囊：点一下就知道此刻 DeepSeek 按高峰价还是空闲价计费。点开是当前状态与计费方式、下次切换时间与倒计时，以及此刻为什么是这个状态：周末、具名的法定节假日、调休上班日，或者只是不在高峰时段内。判定用北京时间并显式写死 UTC 偏移，不看本机时钟；内置 2026 年中国法定节假日表（33…

description.en: During Beijing working-day peak hours (default 09:00-12:00 and 14:00-18:00) it blocks official DeepSeek requests or reroutes them to a configured target…
description.zh: 北京时间工作日高峰时段拦截发往官方 provider 的请求，默认 09:00-12:00、14:00-18:00，可切到配置的中转目标或直接阻止并提示，非高峰正常走官方。

description.en: Auto-switches the agent to ultra-compressed caveman-style output during DeepSeek peak-pricing hours (Beijing 09:00–12:00 / 14:00–18:00, price x2) and shows a…
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek 高峰计价时段（北京时间 09:00–12:00、14:00–18:00，价格 ×2）自动切换 caveman 超精简输出省 token，标题栏常驻状态徽章，档位切换时弹提醒。

description.en: Sidebar footer badge that shows whether DeepSeek is inside a peak-pricing window right now: a state dot, the current multiplier (x2 during peak, 5 zhe / half…
description.zh: 侧栏底部角标，标注当前是否处于 DeepSeek 高峰计价时段：状态圆点、当前倍率（高峰 ×2、空闲 5 折）、距下次切换的倒计时，以及一条用白色竖线标出当前时刻的 24 小时日程条。高峰为北京时间 9:00–12:00 与 14:00–18:00，周末与中国法定节假日按空闲计费。节假日表目前只覆盖 2026…

description.en: Session header badge showing DeepSeek peak/off-peak status, per-model token prices on hover, and real session/turn costs from actual usage.
description.zh: 会话头部徽标：显示 DeepSeek 高峰/闲时状态、当前模型 token 单价，并按真实用量统计会话与每轮费用。

description.en: Peak-hour reminder: while DeepSeek charges peak rates it shows a banner at the top of the DSH Web UI every N minutes (default 5, range 1-120), adds one at each…
description.zh: 峰时提醒：DeepSeek 走高峰计价时，每隔 N 分钟（默认 5，可设 1–120）在 DSH Web 界面顶部提醒一次「现在是峰时」，峰↔谷切换各提醒一条，谷时完全不打扰；侧边栏底部常驻一行显示当前峰/谷状态与下次切换倒计时。峰谷规则（北京时间工作日 09:00–12:00、14:00–18:00；周末、法定节假日…

description.en: Header chip for the DSH web GUI that shows whether the current Beijing time is inside DeepSeek's API peak window, with a live clock and countdown to the next…
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 会话头部高峰指示灯，实时显示当前北京时间是否处于 DeepSeek API 高峰时段，附实时时钟与下一转折倒计时。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Show DeepSeek peak and off-peak periods and remaining time above the composer, with themes and custom CSS.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在输入框上方显示 DeepSeek 峰谷时段和剩余时间，支持主题和自定义 CSS。

description.en: Peak / off-peak rate badges for the model selector (every row) and the composer tool row, judged per provider by its own time zone and schedule; the live…
description.zh: 为模型选择器（每一行）与 composer 工具行显示峰谷倍率，按每个 provider 自己的时区与时段规则判定；实时目录由 host 经带信任围栏的路由下发。

description.en: Peer channels between conversations at the same level: user-granted, symmetric, with durable grants that survive a restart and burst messages merged into one…
description.zh: 平级对话之间的通道：经用户授权、对称，授权跨重启保留；忙时多条消息合并成一批按发送时间排序投递。

description.en: A pelican riding a bicycle along a seashore in the bottom-right corner: an SVG animation that reflects the agent working state (thinking/done), with a chime…
description.zh: 右下角鹈鹕环海骑行 SVG 动画，随代理状态在思考/完成间切换，回复完成时播放提示音并可选发送系统通知。

description.en: Mounts the pen.dev desktop app MCP server in a DSH session so the model can read and edit the .pen document open in Pen through the get_app_state, read_skill,…
description.zh: 把 pen.dev 桌面应用的 MCP 服务器挂进 DSH 会话，模型即可通过 get_app_state、read_skill、execute、get_style、browser 读取并修改 Pen 中打开的 .pen 文档；服务器二进制按常见安装路径探测定位，另附一个 pen-dev 技能，以及一个把…

description.en: Highlights sidebar session rows by state (pending approval, running, just finished) with color, animation and a matching status dot.
description.zh: 按待审批、运行中、刚完成三种状态给侧边栏会话行上色并加呼吸动效，行尾配同色状态点。

description.en: ★ 88 │ Minimal Root-Orchestrator PTES pentesting plugin for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: ★ 88 │ 按 PTES 渗透测试流程组织任务，提供主 Agent 统筹的编排预设。

description.en: Client-side rendering optimizations for DSH Desktop: skips offscreen message rendering, pauses frames and timers while the window is hidden, lazily loads…
description.zh: DSH 桌面端纯客户端渲染优化：长对话省渲染、窗口隐藏不排帧、后台暂停定时器、媒体懒加载、会话列表节流、大会话文件预热，设置页显示实测省下的主线程时间。

description.en: Client-side performance HUD and always-on recorder for DeepSeek Harness: FPS and worst frame, long tasks with four-leg attribution (React fiber / subtree / DOM…
description.zh: 纯客户端性能 HUD 与默认常开的记录器：帧率与最差帧、Long Task 四条腿归因（React fiber / 子树 / DOM 写入 / 调度点）、每插件回调速率与同步耗时、DOM 增长与写入者、JS 堆、宿主 event-loop 与链路 RTT；守夜层自动留存最差几次卡顿，可逐帧回放并导出事故包。

description.en: One-click health check for DeepSeek Harness: 0-100 score, plain-language issue list, and safe reversible fixes via the profile's cordis.patch.yml.
description.zh: 一键体检你的 DeepSeek Harness：0-100 健康评分、问题清单，以及写入 profile 的 cordis.patch.yml 的安全可逆一键修复。

description.en: Free-interval session reports with AI-narrated daily/weekly digests over any date range, plus every-N-days scheduled reminders with system notifications (macOS…
description.zh: 自由周期会话报告：任意日期区间的 AI 叙事日报/周报/月报，支持每隔 N 天定时提醒并弹系统通知（macOS / Linux）。

description.en: Shipped with cc-safety-net-style mechanical safety-net rules appended; supports both no-model and model-assisted security review, in modes such as 自动审查 (auto-review) and 机械直通 (mechanical pass-through). P0–P4 deterministic-first permission gate with permissive tier, learning sedimentation and approval-history UI; hard-deny credentials and protected paths, auto-allow internal read-only tools.
description.zh: 已追加 cc-safety-net 风格的机械安全网规则，同时支持无模型、有模型辅助方式的安全审查，模式为自动审查、机械直通等。P0–P4 确定性优先权限门控，含 Permissive 档位、学习沉淀与审批历史 UI；凭据/受保护路径硬拒绝，内部只读工具自动放行。

description.en: ★ 136 │ Define allow, deny and ask rules for tools, arguments, workspace paths and network targets.
description.zh: ★ 136 │ 按工具、参数、工作区路径与网络目标配置允许、拒绝和询问规则。

description.en: ★ 90 │ Import, switch and manage bundled or custom conversation personas.
description.zh: ★ 90 │ 导入、切换和管理内置或自定义会话人设。

description.en: Rewrites your composer draft in the voice of a chosen character card before it is sent, using the model the current session is already on, with an optional…
description.zh: 发送前把输入框草稿按所选角色卡的口吻改写，用当前会话正在使用的模型；可先审查再发送，并有一项本地检查会点名改写过程中丢掉的技术记号。
按工作区分开的记忆面板：人设卡、用户画像、事件与模型自述日记各存一份，每条都带原话与改动史、可以撤回；工作区之间能共用同一份记忆并随时切断；可选按人记录的他人画像；事件有上限、可标 ★。纯本地、不联网、零依赖。
description.en: A memory panel for DeepSeek Harness with one store per workspace: persona traits, notes about you, dated events, and a first-person diary the model writes and…
Re-speaks each assistant report in a chosen persona outside the working prompt, with four built-in presets, per-session switches, and the original available on…
description.zh: 在系统提示词之外，用选定人格转述每条助手汇报；内置四个预设，支持会话级开关，原文随时可查。

description.en: Switches the running session's persona and speaking style in place with `/role <id>`, adds the persona as its own prompt section after the deployment persona…
description.zh: 用 `/role <id>` 就地切换当前会话的人设与说话风格，以独立的 prompt section 追加在部署人设之后（不替换宿主身份行），不动工具与技能；角色是角色库里的 `ROLE.md` 纯文本文件，切换后会在会话里声明一次。

description.en: ★ 114 │ Inspect token usage, costs and session state, and configure personal preferences.
description.zh: ★ 114 │ 集中查看 Token 用量、费用、会话状态并调整个人偏好。

description.en: Switch providers from the left column and choose a model from the right; hover, focus or click a provider to update the model list.
description.zh: 左侧切换供应商，右侧直接选择模型；悬停、聚焦或点击供应商即可切换右侧模型列表。

description.en: ★ 5,058 │ A lazy blue fish living in DeepSeek Harness: plays with a Rubik's cube, snacks, naps, roams the desktop, tracks your balance wallet, and chats when idle.
description.zh: ★ 5,058 │ 在 DSH 中添加蓝色鱼形桌宠，会玩魔方、吃零食、打盹和聊天，并显示账户余额。

description.en: An Astra Yao desktop pet for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI that renders the Codex v2 8x11 sprite atlas, follows session state through thinking, running, waiting…
description.zh: 把 Astra Yao（耀嘉音）的 Codex 桌宠图集搬进 DSH Web 界面：随会话状态切换到构思、执行、候场、破音等动作，头顶气泡显示正在跑的工具和余额（默认开启，可关），空闲时轮播她的官方台词。

description.en: Bridge dsh session status to the cc-pet desktop pet bubble: thinking, tool calls, and completion in real time. Ships on npm as `dsh-pet-bridge`.
description.zh: dsh ↔ cc-pet 桌面宠物状态桥：把会话状态（思考中 / 读取文件 / 运行命令 / 完成）实时推送到桌面宠物气泡。npm 包名 `dsh-pet-bridge`。

description.en: A fork of zhu1090093659/dsh-pet (Apache-2.0), adding per-conversation companions with whale-girl, MIKU and business blue whale skins, model-themed colors,…
description.zh: 基于 zhu1090093659/dsh-pet（Apache-2.0）改造，新增每个活跃会话一只桌宠，提供鲸鱼娘、MIKU 与商务小蓝鲸皮肤、模型配色、随生成速度跑动、完成待查看提醒、共享喂食与亲密度。

description.en: LAN co-op for the dsh-pet desktop pet: see colleagues' pets on the same network, wave at them, and drag their desktop windows anywhere; an optional included…
description.zh: 给 dsh-pet 桌宠加局域网联机：同一网络下能看到同事的桌宠，可以打招呼、自由拖拽桌面窗口；可选补丁同步实时动作、气泡和表情包。需要 dsh-pet 0.3.7。

description.en: ★ 63 │ A Live2D pet docked in the DSH interface: she follows the pointer, reacts to clicks and changes expressions with each session phase, with configurable motions, expressions and lines.
description.zh: ★ 63 │ 在 DSH 界面添加 Live2D 桌宠，随鼠标、点击和会话状态切换动作、表情与台词。

description.en: A photo-real desk pet for the DSH window: five personas with five expression sprites each, whose dance, hair-flip and walk actions play as 24 fps VP9 alpha video clips, plus a single-shot stage clip that walks to the centre, dances and walks back without cutting; proactive lines with an optional edge-tts neural voice, ink / confetti / cloud / fog / bomb effects, a right-click menu and a /dsh-pet command, plus a small chat box that answers through a one-shot host model call without writing to your session. UI text ships in en, zh, es, pt and hi.
description.zh: DSH 窗口里的超写实桌宠：五个形象各有五张表情立绘，跳舞、撩发、走路三套动作以 24fps VP9 alpha 视频片段播放，另有一条「走到中间跳完再走回」的 10 秒单镜头片段、全程不切镜；按活跃时段主动说话（可选 edge-tts 神经音色），带泼墨、撒花、乌云、起雾、炸弹特效、右键菜单与 /dsh-pet 斜杠命令，旁边的小输入框通过一次性宿主模型调用回话、不写进你的会话。界面文案内置中、英、西、葡、印五语。

description.en: ★ 62 │ Show session events through a sticker companion, status bubbles and a desktop window.
description.zh: ★ 62 │ 用贴纸角色、状态气泡与桌面浮窗反映会话事件。

description.en: The DSH app also doubles as a desktop pet: wake it with your voice, talk out loud, and give orders by speaking. Reach the DeepSeek Harness running on your own…
description.zh: DSH 的 App 端还融合了桌宠玩法：语音唤醒、随口说话、语音指挥。远程操作电脑上的 DeepSeek Harness 有三种连法——局域网、自建域名、服务器中转；也能直接和工作在项目里的小鲸鱼聊天，一句话指挥它干活。出门在外，再也不用担心没带电脑。

description.en: ★ 3 │ Notify for approvals, questions, completed work and errors through desktop alerts, sounds, title markers and webhooks.
description.zh: ★ 3 │ 通过桌面通知、声音、标题标记和 Webhook 提醒审批、提问、任务完成及错误。

description.en: Local decision-layer plugin for DSH: a fail-closed command approval gate and ask/gate tools backed by a 144.3M on-device model. Needs a separate local decision…
description.zh: DSH 本地决策层插件：失败关闭的命令审批门，以及由 144.3M 端侧模型支撑的 ask/gate 工具。需另装本地决策服务：`pip install phocinae-server` 后下载约 330MB 权重并常驻运行；服务不在时工具会返回 `PHOCINAE_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`。

description.en: Lists the attachments the current session actually received through the WeChat bridge and adopts one into the workspace on demand.
description.zh: 列出当前会话通过微信桥实际收到的附件，并按需将其中一个采纳到工作区。

description.en: Piano performance plugin: ask the agent to play a piece and it renders on a Canvas2D grand piano with real Salamander Grand samples, an immersive stage, and an…
description.zh: 让 Agent 弹一曲真钢琴：Salamander Grand 真实采样音色，Canvas2D 三角钢琴与沉浸式舞台渲染，88 键可弹。

description.en: Conversation navigation with full-history turns, collapsible process steps, final-result and structured question-and-answer keys, and pointer-following piano…
description.zh: 提供完整历史轮次导航、过程步骤折叠、最终结果与结构化问答琴键，以及鼠标连续跟随交互。

description.en: Pasted screenshots become numbered references: each Ctrl+V image is stored in the attachment library under a stable number, listed in a composer-dock thumbnail…

description.en: Long-term cross-session markdown memory with an LLM-Wiki structure and a SOUL.md persona, injected at session start (by default only after the first user message and only in the active session), plus remember/recall/consolidate/forget workflows, an embedded memory skill, pack/unpack migration tooling, and an idle-time first-person recall nudge that surfaces real memories in a companion voice. Also gives the store observability and upkeep it lacked: a per-file boot-block budget that keeps the index routing table from being truncated, automatic last_access stamping so salience decay actually works, a read-only memory health dashboard (size, freshness, lint-parity checks), a declarative index compiler (pages declare summary:, one command re-lines the index), an interactive memory graph (page links plus shared tags, draggable, wheel zoom), structured queries (tag/type/salience/hot/stale filters), cross-link suggestions for pages that have no relationship yet, and a `checkup` report that ends in a prioritised action list. The boot payload was also cut by ~23% by moving operational detail into the on-demand skill. Its settings section now carries its own navigation mark (a brain half wired to a node cluster, since the shell offers no icon slot to plugins) and a feedback entry that opens this repository. Requires DSH session format v4 (official DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7+): injected messages declare the producer-owned source kind plugin:memory.
description.zh: 带 LLM Wiki 结构与 SOUL 人格文件的长期 markdown 记忆库：会话启动注入 boot 块（默认提问后才注入、且只注入当前激活会话），含 remember/recall/consolidate/forget 工作流、内嵌 memory 技能、pack/unpack 迁移工具，以及空闲时以第一人称主动追忆（recall nudge）的拟人化能力。同时补上记忆库原先缺的“可观测 + 可维护”：按文件分配 boot 预算（索引路由表不再被截断）、自动戳记 last_access（salience 衰减真正生效）、只读记忆健康看板（体量/新鲜度/与 lint 同源的体检）、声明式索引编译器（页面声明 summary:，一条命令重写索引行），可拖动、可滚轮缩放的记忆图谱（页间链接 + 共享 tag）、结构化检索（tag/type/salience/hot/stale 过滤）、针对「尚无内容关系」页面的补链建议，以及以「最该做的 N 件事」收尾的 `checkup` 体检报告。同时把操作细节移到按需加载的技能，boot 注入体量减少约 23%。设置区块现在还有专属侧栏图标（半脑 + 节点——因为设置 shell 不给插件留图标位）和直达本仓库的反馈入口。要求 DSH session format v4（官方 DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7+）：注入消息使用 producer-owned source kind plugin:memory。

description.en: ★ 28 │ ChatGPT-style message editing for DeepSeek Harness: edit a past prompt to rewind and branch the conversation, switch versions with a counter under the bubble, and browse branches in a tree.
