description.en: Card-style plugin manager in Settings: enable/disable each plugin through the profile patch layer, install-source details, npm update check with one-click…
description.zh: 设置页卡片式插件管理：经 profile 补丁层启停插件（跨重启保留）、安装来源详情、npm 更新检查与一键更新、卸载、搜索与加载失败标识。

description.en: AI UI automation via Midscene — android_ui and web_ui tools that tap, type, query, and assert on a real Android device or an already-running Chrome through the…
description.zh: 基于 Midscene 的 AI UI 自动化——android_ui 与 web_ui 工具，通过 ctx.midscene seam 在真实 Android 设备或已运行的 Chrome 上完成点击、输入、查询与断言。

description.en: ★ 3 │ Mirror DSH sessions, messages and tool activity to a JARVIS Mission Control board, where finished turns wait for human review.
description.zh: ★ 3 │ 把 DSH 会话、消息和工具活动同步到 JARVIS Mission Control 看板，完成的回合交给人工审核。

description.en: Token-authenticated REST and SSE bridge with QR pairing, so a phone app can read sessions, send messages and approve tool calls.
description.zh: 带令牌鉴权的 REST 与 SSE 接口，扫码配对后可在手机 App 上看会话、发消息、批准工具调用。

description.en: Authenticated mobile gateway for DeepSeek Harness: connects the companion native iOS client over WebSocket for sessions, live events, tasks, goals, approvals, commands, and file transfers, with QR pairing and device revocation.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的设备鉴权移动网关：通过 WebSocket 连接配套原生 iOS 客户端，支持会话、实时事件、任务、Goal、审批、命令和文件传输，并提供二维码配对与设备撤销。

description.en: Host-side connector for the DSH Mobile iOS app: dials a self-hostable WSS relay so the phone can reach the DSH sessions on this computer over 4G/5G, without a…
description.zh: DSH Mobile 的电脑侧连接器：连上可自建的公网 WSS 中转，手机在 4G/5G 下即可访问这台电脑上的 DSH 会话，电脑不需要公网 IP 也不用组网；中转只做鉴权与转发。

description.en: Model Capability Manager for DSH Web: thinking levels, context window, output caps, input modalities, gateway compat presets, EN/中文 UI.
description.zh: DSH 网页端模型能力管理插件：控制推理档位、上下文与输出上限、输入模态及网关兼容预设，双语界面。

description.en: Read-only Molio knowledge base tools: list vaults, browse the file tree, full-text search and read documents, served over the local Molio daemon HTTP API,…
description.zh: Molio 本地知识库只读工具集：列知识库、浏览文件树、全文搜索、读取原文，经本机 Molio daemon HTTP API 取数（需 daemon 常驻运行）。npm 包名 dsh-plugin-molio，dsh plugin add 即装。

description.en: Give the agent a talking face: seven tools that drive a self-hosted Mynah realtime digital human — speak (queued or interrupting), play a gesture clip,…
description.zh: 给 Agent 一张会说话的脸：七个工具驱动自托管的 Mynah 实时数字人——开口说话（排队或打断）、播放动作片段、打断、查看在线会话与频道、健康检查、往知识库加文本。

description.en: Icon, Chinese display name and a one-line note for every DSH plugin, organized with folders, favorites, drag or pinyin ordering, list and grid views. Icons are…
description.zh: 给 DSH 插件换自定义图标、中文显示名和一句话说明；用文件夹与收藏整理，支持拖拽排序、按备注名拼音排序、列表与铺陈两种视图。所有已安装插件自动分配图标（可手动覆盖）；导入导出覆盖图标、备注名、说明、文件夹与排序。只改显示，不修改插件文件与 cordis 配置；启用开关转调官方插件管理器。

description.en: Declares a spec-driven development agent preset with a Chinese persona and four static Claude Code/Codex delegation tools for planning, implementation, review…
description.zh: 声明规范驱动研发预设，包含中文人格与四个 Claude Code/Codex 静态委派工具，用于规划、实现、审查与知识提炼；角色由提示词引导，并非自动状态机。

description.en: Natural-language data queries + BI reports: Text2SQL, charts, report saving, schema/data grid panel, and a sidebar workbench — all behind DSH's MySQL…
description.zh: 自然语言查询 + 商业智能报表：Text2SQL、图表、报表收藏、Schema/数据面板与侧栏工作台，基于 DSH 的 MySQL 连接层。

description.en: Start and detach standalone chats without a mandatory workspace, keeping DSH's native workspace UI intact.
description.zh: 无需强制绑定工作区即可新建和分离独立会话，同时保留 DSH 原生的工作区界面。

description.en: Shows per-turn changes in cyclomatic complexity, cognitive complexity, and maximum nesting depth for TypeScript, Python, and Go in the Web UI, with expandable…
description.zh: 在 Web UI 中展示每轮任务前后的圈复杂度、认知复杂度和最大嵌套深度变化，支持 TypeScript、Python 和 Go，可展开文件和函数查看详情，帮助确定代码审查重点。

description.en: Notification outbox: agent proactively notifies via toast / Chinese TTS voice / sound effects (explosion, victory, alarm), 60s confirmation window voice-calls…
description.zh: 通知出口：agent 主动通过桌面通知 / 中文语音 / 音效（炸裂、胜利、警报）联系你，60 秒确认窗口后语音呼叫，音量增强，设置面板。

description.en: Per-workspace completion ringtones plus attention sounds for approval, question, plan-review, goal-blocked, and task-failure events, with built-in synth, voice…
description.zh: 按工作区定制的任务完成铃声，以及审批、提问、计划评审、目标受阻、任务失败等需要人介入事件的注意提示音，支持内置合成音、语音播报与自定义音频。

description.en: Native-style notification sounds for DeepSeek Harness: a chime when the agent needs your decision or finishes a task, clickable system notifications that jump…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 原生风格提示音插件：智能体需要你决策或任务完成时播放提示音，点击系统通知可跳回窗口；支持重复提醒、静音时段，以及目标模式下只在最终轮提醒。

description.en: Converts Office and PDF files in the DSH workspace to Markdown locally — no network, no API quota — before the model reads them. Writes each .md next to its…
description.zh: 在模型读取之前，把工作区里的 Office / PDF 文件在本机转成 Markdown（不联网、不消耗 API 额度），.md 写在源文件旁边，因此进入上下文的只是一个文件路径，并返回字节数、行数、token 估算与标题结构索引，支持单个文件或整个目录。

description.en: Adds a capsule split-button to the conversation header: launch VS Code, terminal, or File Explorer at the current workspace directory in one click.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 会话头部添加胶囊拆分按钮，一键在当前工作区打开 VS Code、终端和文件资源管理器。

description.en: Shows OpenCode Go subscription usage (rolling, weekly and monthly used and remaining percentage with reset times) in a floating panel anchored to the…
description.zh: 在会话窗口左下角的悬浮面板中显示 OpenCode Go 订阅用量（滚动/每周/每月的已用与剩余百分比及重置时间）。

description.en: Pre-boot health checks and repair for dsh plugin trees — ten static scan rules that follow the launcher runtime resolution, fault attribution after a failed boot, whitelisted reversible fixes verified in an isolated instance first, an upgrade preview naming the plugins a target release would skip, and a panel with plugin-row management plus a RAG knowledge base of past failures.
description.zh: dsh 插件树的启动前体检与修复——十条跟随启动器运行时解析的静态规则、启动失败后的故障归因、先在隔离实例复验再落地的白名单可逆修复、点名目标版本会跳过哪些插件的升级预演，以及带插件行管理面板与历次故障 RAG 知识库的设置界面。

description.en: Read-only orchd panel for the DSH right sidebar: task board, ideas board, dependency graph, review timeline and an install entry for the project of the current…
description.zh: 把 orchd 项目状态带进 DSH 右侧栏的只读面板：任务看板、想法看板、依赖图、审查时间线与接入入口，只跟当前会话的项目。

description.en: Pre-install compatibility gate for DSH plugins: locks the resolved version, checks peer/engines declarations, dry-installs into an isolated DSH_HOME and boots…
description.zh: DSH 插件安装前兼容性门控：锁定解析版本、校验 peer/engines 声明、在隔离 DSH_HOME 中试装并限时试启动，任一失败即阻止；正式安装失败自动还原 profile。可选拦截 dsh-market 的安装/更新点击，兼容 DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x。

description.en: Global proxy for DeepSeek Harness: route agent tools, model requests and web fetches through the Windows system proxy or a custom address with one persistent…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 全局代理插件：通过 Windows 系统代理或自定义地址统一代理模型请求与工具流量，主界面常驻开关，且 Agent 在对话中实时感知代理状态。

description.en: ★ 4 │ Route the pwsh tool to PowerShell 7 on Windows, with status, diagnostics and portable installation controls.
description.zh: ★ 4 │ 在 Windows 上把 pwsh 工具路由到 PowerShell 7，并提供状态、诊断和便携安装入口。

description.en: A QR-code button above Settings that lets phones connect to the web UI through an auth-gated reverse proxy.
description.zh: 「设置」按钮上方的一键二维码，让手机通过带鉴权的反向代理连接 Web 界面。

description.en: ★ 21 │ Creative branching canvas plugin for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: ★ 21 │ 在树状创意画布中生成、对比和迭代多个可交互方案。

description.en: Third-party adapter that registers the upstream REA (Reverse Engineer Anything) MCP server into DeepSeek Harness as mcp__rea__* tools. 2.x provisions its own…
description.zh: 第三方适配插件：把上游 REA（逆向一切，github.com/morluto/rea）的 MCP 服务接入 DeepSeek Harness，提供 mcp__rea__* 工具。2.x 自带供给：把 Node、REA CLI、JDK、Ghidra 装到 <DSH_HOME>/plugins/rea-bundle…

description.en: Cross-session memory for the model: full-text search all past sessions (SQLite FTS5 via ctx.sessionQuery) and bring the strongest matching excerpts back into…
description.zh: 跨会话记忆：全文检索所有历史会话（复用 ctx.sessionQuery 的 SQLite FTS5 索引），把最强匹配片段带回当前上下文。

description.en: Plugin recommender for DSH: search and rank plugins from an embedded 1100+ entry marketplace catalog by need description, category and tags, with match reasons…
description.zh: DSH 插件推荐器：按需求描述、分类与标签在 1100+ 条内嵌市场目录中搜索并排序插件，返回匹配理由，支持从 awesome-dsh-plugin README 在线刷新目录。

description.en: Role-based plugin recommender for DSH: asks the user's role (developer, designer, writer, researcher, ops, student...), recommends suitable plugins, and audits…
description.zh: 按职业/角色推荐 DSH 插件：询问用户是做什么的（程序员、设计师、写作、研究、运维、学生…），推荐适合的插件，并对每个插件做本地静态安全审计（危险代码模式 + 0-100 风险分）与口碑检查（npm 下载量 / GitHub 星数）。

description.en: In-place redaction and row-level rollback for session logs, preserving the seq-equals-row-index invariant that makes deleting a middle row corrupt the entire…
description.zh: 会话日志的原地脱敏与按行回退：守住「每行 seq 必须等于它的行号」这一不变式（删中间行会让整份日志打不开）。任何写入前先把原文复制成隔离备份，并以读取端自身的语义作为写前闸门。

description.en: ★ 5 │ Exposes this machine's DSH web GUI to a chosen CIDR range, such as Tailscale, on DSH 0.2.1+. It can require an optional numeric access code and provides a phone layout that applies only to remote pages.
description.zh: ★ 5 │ 将网页界面开放给指定网段，可设置数字访问码，并为远程页面提供手机布局。

description.en: Browse the GitHub issues and pull requests of a workspace's origin remote, filter and comment, close or reopen, and file one as a task on dsh-plugin-taskboard…
description.zh: 浏览工作区 origin 远端对应的 GitHub issue 与 pull request，筛选、评论、关闭或重开，并可转成任务写到 dsh-plugin-taskboard 的看板上等 agent 领取。

description.en: Agent-facing plugin installer that resolves DSH-compatible versions, handles ambiguous names, and verifies the loader entry after install.
description.zh: 面向 agent 的插件安装器：解析 DSH 兼容版本、处理同名歧义，并在安装后校验 loader 入口。

description.en: Windows only. Prompts to restart DSH after a plugin install, update or uninstall, restarts it in one click without any console window, and shows a per-file…
description.zh: 仅 Windows。DSH 插件变动后提示重启，一键静默重启（全程无命令提示符窗口），并可展开本次改动的逐行差异。

description.en: Restores the DSH right sidebar divider drag after whole-interface zoom shifts the host handle off it, and widens the hit area to 12px with a hover affordance.
description.zh: 修复整页缩放后右侧栏拖拽手柄偏移、分割线拖不动的问题，把命中区加宽到 12px 并显示悬停提示线。

description.en: Detects which conversation model an account is being served: launches concurrent throwaway probe conversations, scores each streaming chain-of-thought by how…
description.zh: 检测账号当前被分配到哪个对话模型：并发发起一次性探测会话，按段落开头的写法为流式思维链打分，读起来像旧模型的在数秒内中止。附带离线自检，用同一分类器回放 13 条人工标注的思维链。

description.en: Plugin inventory manager for DeepSeek Harness Web: table view of installed plugins with status filters, enable/disable switches applied via HMR, config…
description.zh: DSH 插件总览（逃咪）：以表格视图管理已安装插件，支持状态过滤、HMR 热生效的启停开关、配置查看/复制、卸载与 npm 更新提醒。

description.en: Reversible context slimming for DeepSeek Harness: TOON-style lossless tabular re-encoding of uniform JSON arrays, stride-sampled table windows with line numbers, and cross-turn dedup for repeated tool output; every replacement passes a byte-plus-token gate (≤72% bytes, strictly fewer estimated tokens) and the original is spilled to disk behind a `[save-token #id]` notice retrievable in one call via the `save_token_expand` tool, with billed and avoided token metering on a settings dashboard.
description.zh: 可逆的上下文瘦身插件：均匀 JSON 数组走 TOON 式无损表格化重编码，管道表按行号抽样保留窗口，90 秒内字节级相同的工具输出跨轮去重；每次替换都要通过双重门（压缩后 ≤72% 字节且估算 token 严格下降），原文落盘并以 `[save-token #id]` 标记，可用 `save_token_expand` 工具一步取回；设置页仪表盘分别统计实际计费与节省的 token。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Discover DSH plugins on GitHub, inspect trust and compatibility evidence, and install through the official installer.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 从 GitHub 发现 DSH 插件，检查可信度与兼容性证据，再通过官方安装器安装。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Capture, OCR and control Windows background windows through a bundled Rust engine. Windows x64 only; declares DSH ^0.2.0-rc.2 and Node.js ^22.19 or >=24. Grants screen capture, mouse and keyboard capabilities.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 通过随包 Rust 引擎截取、识别和操控 Windows 后台窗口，提供鼠标与键盘工具。仅限 Windows x64，声明适配 DSH ^0.2.0-rc.2，需 Node.js ^22.19 或 >=24。

description.en: ★ 2 │ Review dependency advisories and static behavior evidence; automatic disabling requires a reviewed malicious finding.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 检查依赖漏洞和插件行为证据，只有审核确认恶意行为后才自动停用插件。

description.en: Live estimated session spend in the composer dock, pricing each assistant step at DeepSeek's peak or off-peak rate for its own timestamp.
description.zh: 在输入框底栏显示当前会话的预估花费，每一步都按其自身时间戳采用 DeepSeek 的峰时或非峰时单价计价。

description.en: ★ 2 │ Preview and move selected session workspace files to a local trash when deleting a session; files can be restored. Requires DSH >=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0 and Node >=20.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 删除会话时预览并将选中的工作区文件移入本地回收站，支持恢复。需 DSH >=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0、Node >=20。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Search session messages with Chinese-friendly substring matching, jump to highlighted results and move between matches.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 按字词搜索会话正文，支持中文短词匹配、结果定位高亮和命中跳转。

description.en: Import claude-code / codex / reasonix / zcode chat history into dsh sessions: workspace binding, tool calls preserved, oversized-session protection, zcode…
description.zh: 把 claude-code / codex / reasonix / zcode 的聊天历史导入为 dsh 会话：工作区绑定、工具调用保留、超长会话保护、zcode 压缩还原。

description.en: Two-step session deletion: the session menu moves a chat into a recycle bin without deleting anything, the bin panel restores an entry, deletes one for good…
description.zh: 两步删除会话：会话菜单先把会话移入回收站（不删任何内容、可随时恢复），面板可恢复、可逐条立刻删除、也可整体清空，下次启动 DSH 时才真正清掉日志、投影缓存、spill 文件与工作区登记。

description.en: ★ 4 │ View a session’s plugins and skills from its header, and enable or disable installed bundles and configured MCP servers in the current profile. Requires DSH >=0.2.1-rc.3 <0.3.0-0.
description.zh: ★ 4 │ 在会话标题栏查看当前会话的插件和技能，并启停当前 profile 中的插件包与 MCP 服务。需 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.3 <0.3.0-0。

description.en: ★ 4 │ Encode a plugin set as a share code or QR code that others can import and install item by item.
description.zh: ★ 4 │ 把插件组合生成分享码或二维码，供他人导入后逐项安装。

description.en: Opening animation, three bundled wallpapers, up to nine uploaded wallpapers with random rotation, and live panel and sidebar opacity.
description.zh: 开场动画、三张内置壁纸、最多九张上传壁纸与随机轮换，以及实时生效的面板与侧边栏透明度。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Shows the DeepSeek account balance in the sidebar footer, just above the account entry.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在侧边栏底部、账户入口上方显示 DeepSeek 账户余额。

description.en: DSH settings section for managing a local Sirchmunk knowledge backend: graph inspection, cluster management, audit history, runtime metrics, and privacy…
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置中管理本地 Sirchmunk 知识库：图谱导出、聚类管理、审计历史、运行指标与隐私控制。

description.en: Run one deterministic skill-routing pass on every user instruction, so the skill catalog is consulted before the model answers instead of after it remembers.…
description.zh: 对每条用户指令自动做一次确定性的技能路由，让技能目录在模型作答之前就被查阅，而不是等它自己想起来。宿主侧只依据指令关键词与目录元数据打分，不调用 LLM 也不做向量检索，然后向该步追加恰好一条带生产者标签的消息：默认是候选排名简报，分数过线时改注入冠军技能的 SKILL.md…

description.en: Better streaming text animation for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加入更好的流式文字动画。

description.en: Bi-temporal memory backed by a SodaMem daemon: recall is contributed to the prompt while each turn is assembled and every closed turn is ingested, with no tool…
description.zh: 基于 SodaMem 守护进程的双时间轴记忆：每轮组装提示词时注入检索结果，回合结束后自动写回，读路径不经工具调用也不额外调用模型；每条召回的事实都标注来源回合并带有效期，失效的事实不再被检索到。

description.en: Visual branch brainstorming that creates an isolated Session for each direction, automates parent, sibling, checkpoint, and return Handoffs, and provides a…
description.zh: 可视化分支头脑风暴：为每个方向创建独立 Session，自动处理父子继承、兄弟感知、进展与回传 Handoff，并提供完整树形 Tab 与可选 Better Sidebar 右栏。

description.en: Provides a specification-driven engineering workbench with versioned requirements and documents, isolated Git workspaces, independent review, verification, and…
description.zh: 提供规格驱动的工程工作台，支持需求和文档版本、隔离 Git 工作区、独立复核、验证与人工接纳。需 Node.js 24+ 与 Git。

description.en: Refuses agent-generated SQL that reads tables or columns outside a configured blacklist or whitelist, returning a structured permission reason instead of…
description.zh: 拒绝智能体生成的越权 SQL：读取的表或字段不在黑白名单策略内时直接拒绝，返回结构化权限原因，不改写查询。

description.en: SSH terminals, SFTP file transfer and text editing inside DeepSeek Harness, with server troubleshooting through host models.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内使用 SSH 终端、SFTP 文件传输与文本编辑，并通过宿主模型排查服务器问题。

description.en: Freshness gate for the agent's test, typecheck, lint and build claims: each verification run becomes a receipt on tools/post-execute, file edits are tracked,…
description.zh: 为智能体的测试、类型检查、lint 与构建结论提供新鲜度检查：每次验证运行在 tools/post-execute 上记录为凭据，文件修改被跟踪；在 agent/turn-stopping 时，若结论对应的最新凭据已过期、失败或没有可读结果，则引导再走一步，并指出凭据与其后被修改的文件。

description.zh: dsh 自我学习闭环：记录经验、生成并发布技能，定期审查修正、合并与退役技能。

description.en: Token usage and cost metering for dsh: per-session and aggregate statistics with configurable pricing and reports.
description.zh: dsh 用量计量：会话级与汇总 token 统计、可配置计价与报告。

description.en: ★ 2,598 │ Pair a phone with desktop DSH over LAN or a public connection to follow the same session.
description.zh: ★ 2,598 │ 通过局域网或公网将手机与电脑 DSH 配对，同步访问会话。

description.en: Forwards an unattended DeepSeek Harness run's tool-call approvals and ask_user_question prompts to Feishu cards on your phone. The desktop GUI answers first —…
description.zh: 把无人值守运行时 DeepSeek Harness 的工具调用审批与 ask_user_question 提问推送到手机飞书卡片。桌面 GUI 优先作答——只有在 `delaySeconds`（默认 120 秒）内无人应答时才发出卡片——手机上的批准等同于 `allowed-once`，因此不会在手机上累积任何权限。仅…

description.en: Phone and remote access to the DSH Web UI: scan a LAN QR code, or reach your PC from anywhere through a self-hosted relay server you run yourself instead of a…
description.zh: 手机与远程访问 DSH Web 界面：局域网扫码即用，或用自建 relay 中继服务端（替代 cloudflared 隧道）随时随地连回电脑；每台设备独立凭据，可配对、查看与单独撤销；多台电脑共用一个中继并自动热备。

description.en: Pre-install supply-chain poison scanner for DSH plugins: AST (JS-X-Ray) + deobfuscation + regex heuristics, exits non-zero on findings for CI gating.
description.zh: DSH 插件安装前投毒扫描：AST（JS-X-Ray）+ 去混淆解码 + 正则启发式，发现即非零退出，可作 CI 门禁。

description.en: A no-limit Texas holdem table where you are the only human. Eight seats: you plus seven LLM agents written on AI-founder personas (Altman, Dario Amodei, Musk,…
description.zh: 一张只有你一个人类的无限注德州扑克桌。八个座位：你，加上七位以 AI 创始人设写成的 LLM 智能体（Altman、达里奥、马斯克、梁文峰、黄仁勋、雷军、张一鸣）。每个智能体都通过宿主当前选中的模型下注，模型不可用时回落到自己的启发式风格；每个智能体只看得见自己的底牌，因为提示词只由它自己那个座位拼出来。一手结束时亮出…

description.en: Pomodoro focus-and-break timer for DSH Web with configurable cycles, a draggable mini panel, and in-app, sound, and browser notifications.
description.zh: DSH Web 番茄钟：提供可配置专注/休息循环、可拖动迷你面板，以及站内提醒、提示音和浏览器通知。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Pomodoro timer for the DSH right sidebar: 25-minute focus and 5-minute break cycles, timed on the host; the agent can read status and start or stop it via pomodoro_panel.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在侧栏使用 25 分钟专注、5 分钟休息的番茄钟，关闭面板仍会计时，Agent 可查看和控制。

description.en: Pomodoro timer with four-quadrant tasks: bind focus rounds to a task, grow a desktop pet with EXP and achievements, and let the agent start rounds or propose…
description.zh: 番茄钟搭配四象限任务：专注轮次可绑定任务，桌宠随经验成长并解锁成就，Agent 可开始专注或提议任务。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Pomodoro timer for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: a full sidebar page with focus, short-break, and long-break cycles, plus a countdown pill beside the composer.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 提供专注、短休息和长休息计时，在侧栏及输入框旁显示倒计时。

description.en: Ponytail lazy senior dev mode: 6 skills adapted from DietrichGebert/ponytail.
description.zh: Ponytail 最懒资深工程师模式：6 个技能，改编自 DietrichGebert/ponytail。

description.en: ★ 205 │ View artifacts in a sidebar or open the panel in a larger browser tab.
description.zh: ★ 205 │ 在侧栏查看产物，或将面板弹出为更大的浏览器标签页。

description.en: Track the origin of local development ports on Windows and safely manage verified DSH services.
description.zh: Windows 本地开发端口来源追踪与安全处理工具。

description.en: Export a whole working DSH home — profile, installed plugins with their node_modules, skills, hooks and task boards — into one .dshpkg tar and import it on…
description.zh: 把整套可用的 DSH 主目录——profile、带 node_modules 的已装插件、技能、hooks 与任务板——打包成单个 .dshpkg，在另一台机器上免联网、免 pnpm 还原；也支持 HTTP 上传与一次性局域网链接。

description.en: ★ 559 │ Connect Postiz over MCP to inspect channels and posting rules, manage drafts and publish immediately or on schedule.
description.zh: ★ 559 │ 通过 MCP 连接 Postiz，查询渠道与发帖规则、管理草稿，并立即或定时发布。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Recalculate energy loss, loss rates and meter totals, reporting arithmetic differences against declared figures.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 重算线损电量、线损率和计量点合计，提示与填报数值的算术差异。

description.en: Checks an electrical work permit for the elements it must carry and for the issue and permission sequence the current electrical safety regulations require.…
description.zh: 依据现行电力安全工作规程，核对电力工作票应载明的要素，以及签发与许可的先后顺序。只报告发现的差异，不判定作业是否安全、许可是否有效。

description.en: Power Mode typing effects for the DSH web composer: caret particles and glowing character echoes, a heat ramp from amber to red with rising embers as the combo…
description.zh: DSH Web 输入框的 Power Mode 打字特效：光标粒子与发光残影，连击越高当前输入行越热（暖黄到红）并升起余烬，按可视字符累计的连击计数，以及合成的按键音与更重的回车冲击音。

description.en: Power management plugin for DeepSeek Harness - sidebar power button with restart/shutdown menu, self-contained restart engine without external dependencies,…
description.zh: DSH 电源管理插件 - 侧边栏电源按钮、重启/关机菜单、自包含重启引擎（无需外部依赖）、优雅会话刷新。

description.en: ★ 21 │ Turn material into an HTML slideshow, an editable PPTX and a project file, with charts, light editing, undo and quality checks. Final PPTX rendering can use LibreOffice.
description.zh: ★ 21 │ 把材料做成 HTML 放映稿、可编辑的 PPTX 和工程文件，支持图表、轻量编辑、撤销与质量检查。最终 PPTX 渲染可选用 LibreOffice。

description.en: Element-level PowerPoint canvas that edits the opened .pptx in place: click, marquee-select or pick a whole slide, describe the change, and the AI writes…
description.zh: 元素级 PPT 画布，就地改写已打开的 .pptx：点选、框选或整页选中后用自然语言描述改动，AI 以字节保真的 OOXML 补丁写入，支持撤销与重做。

description.en: Build PowerPoint decks from a brief: plan and storyboard gates, per-page authoring through pptwise and ppt-master, a design-profile pass, page-image snapshots…
description.zh: 从需求生成 PPTX：规划与分镜门、pptwise + ppt-master 页级作者、设计档案 pass、渲染页图快照与渲染审计，以及把页图交给支持图片的模型自评的工具。

description.en: ★ 17 │ Create, edit, inspect and export presentations, reverse existing decks and use bundled design systems and templates.
description.zh: ★ 17 │ 创建、编辑、检查和导出 PPT，也可解析已有演示文稿，复用其结构与设计模板。

description.en: Preview and edit attached PowerPoint presentations in the DSH sidebar through conversation or manual controls, with shared undo/redo and PPTX download.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏预览附件中的 PowerPoint 演示文稿，通过对话或手动操作编辑，共享撤销与重做历史，并下载编辑后的 PPTX。

description.en: A dsh-better-sidebar reading view for .pptx decks: slides in deck order, bullet levels, speaker notes and inline pictures. Ceilings on archive size, per-part…
description.zh: dsh-better-sidebar 的 .pptx 阅读视图：按演示顺序列出幻灯片，还原项目符号层级、演讲者备注与内嵌图片。归档体积、单部件解压字节与幻灯片数量均有上限，演示文稿不会卡死标签页。

description.en: Maintainer and developer PR board for the DSH sidebar: a five-state review queue (waiting on me / waiting on author / ready to merge / merged / inbox), a…
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏的维护者 + 开发者 PR 看板：五状态评审队列（等我 / 等作者 / 可合并 / 已合并 / 待分诊）、三列 issue 看板、跨仓库跟踪自己 PR 的 mine 视图（我的回合 / 等别人 / 已合并），附 CI 汇总徽章与不活跃过滤，点卡片一键打开或新建对应的评审会话。

description.en: Deterministic write gate: scope policy denies out-of-scope write/edit calls before they touch the disk, residue rules scan the written text, and every decision…
description.zh: 确定性写入门禁：范围策略在落盘前拒绝越权写入，残留规则扫描所写文本，每个决定落入带内容哈希的 JSONL 台账；可复用仓库的 agent-pr-gate.yaml 让 CI 与会话共用同一策略。

description.en: Trimmed fork of ItQianChen/dsh-github-flow: a floating panel plus a right-column review pane for the pull requests raised in a session, showing CI state,…
description.zh: fork 自 ItQianChen/dsh-github-flow 并裁剪：本会话 PR 的浮窗与右列审阅面板，显示 CI 状态、评审意见与合并状态；同时注册 github_* 工具（含合并/评审 PR、密钥、原始 API），勿与原版同装。

description.en: Pre-visit due diligence and company research in DeepSeek Harness for customer background checks and risk briefs, with Qichacha MCP tool-call budget approval…
description.zh: 访前尽调智能体：面向拜访前调查，提供企业尽调、客户尽调、客户背景调查、工商核验与风险信息整理；使用企查查 MCP，设有调用预算授权和主体确认。

description.en: Pre-claim gate: a commit, push or tag claim like "tests pass" is checked against the session evidence ledger before it is written.
description.zh: 提交前声明门：把“测试通过”等 commit/push/tag 声明与本次会话的真实执行证据核对后再写入。

description.en: Preset doctor for agent presets: scans home/profile `cordis.patch.yml` declarations and legacy `.agent-presets/` dirs across host lines 0.1.0→0.2.0, shows…
description.zh: Agent 预设医生：跨宿主线（0.1.0→0.2.0）扫描 home/profile `cordis.patch.yml` 声明与遗留 `.agent-presets/` 目录，把检测到的每个预设以官方同款卡片展示（来源/代际徽章、失效红边、逐条修复项明细、当前 DSH 版本与代际目录）；卡内「同步到当前版本」走显式…

description.en: ★ 54 │ Preset editing, prompt injection, and DeepSeek adapter configuration.
description.zh: ★ 54 │ 预设编辑、提示词注入与 DeepSeek 适配器配置。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Guide the agent to clarify requirements with an explained questionnaire before execution; this is a prompt-based workflow.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 引导 Agent 执行前用带逐题说明的问卷确认需求，通过提示词约束流程。

description.en: DSH project scaffold preset: strict 5-phase init runbook, engineering standards and six runnable starter templates (node-ts / react-vite / python / go /…
description.zh: DSH 项目初始化脚手架预设：严格 5 阶段初始化流程 + 工程规范 + 六套可运行模板（node-ts / react-vite / python / go / spring-boot / monorepo）。

description.en: ★ 14 │ Edit personas, prompt sections and tool descriptions per preset, select tools and skills, and import or export JSON/YAML.
description.zh: ★ 14 │ 逐预设编辑人设、提示词段和工具描述，选择工具与技能，并导入导出 JSON 或 YAML。

description.en: Browser-side preset visibility and ordering controls for the new-session page.
description.zh: 在新会话页控制 Agent 预设的显示与排序。

description.en: Compact interface with borderless messages, a light queue, composer controls, and adjustable corners. Built for DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 only; while enabled it replaces…
description.zh: 紧凑界面：无边框消息、轻量队列、输入区控制，以及可调圆角。仅适配 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2；启用期间会替换官方侧栏模块，移除后恢复原样。

description.en: Headless-browser verification tools so the agent opens the page it just built, reads the rendered DOM and computed styles, checks the console, and screenshots…
description.zh: 无头浏览器验证工具：让 agent 打开自己刚写的页面，读取渲染后的 DOM 与计算样式、检查控制台、截图留档；内置 frontend-verify 技能。

description.en: Open .blend files in the right-Sidebar document preview: cached Blender headless GLB export plus a dependency-free WebGL viewport and scene statistics.…
description.zh: 在右侧栏文档预览里打开 .blend：Blender headless 导出缓存 GLB，零依赖 WebGL 视口与场景统计。需要本机安装 Blender 3.6 或更高版本。

description.en: A vertical preview market for DeepSeek Harness: discover preview plugins, inspect the installed inventory, and install, enable/disable or configure them…
description.zh: DSH 垂直预览市场：发现预览插件、查看已安装清单，并通过 dsh-market 或 dsh CLI 安装、启用/停用与配置。一键安装与启用/停用依赖 dsh-market；没有它时卡片只显示可复制的安装命令。

description.en: Play video and audio in the right-Sidebar document preview, streamed over an authenticated HTTP Range route with desktop seek.
description.zh: 在右侧栏文档预览里播放视频/音频，经带鉴权的 HTTP Range 路由流式读取，桌面端可拖动进度。

description.en: Open STL meshes in the right-Sidebar document preview: browser-side binary/ASCII parsing, a WebGL viewport, and size/volume/surface-area/watertightness…
description.zh: 在右侧栏文档预览里打开 STL：浏览器解析二进制/ASCII，WebGL 视口 + 尺寸/体积/表面积/水密统计。

description.en: Color presets and a custom paper-color picker for the built-in DSH sidebar PDF, converted Office, and spreadsheet previews, with dark-mode brightness control…
description.zh: 为 DSH 内置侧边栏的 PDF、转为 PDF 的 Office 文档及表格预览提供配色预设与自定义纸张底色，支持深色模式亮度调节和本地保存偏好；只改变显示，不修改文件。

description.en: Shows the DeepSeek API peak and off-peak hours, the current model's output price and the account balance in the Web UI.
description.zh: 在 Web UI 中显示 DeepSeek API 高峰/空闲时段、当前模型的输出价格与账户余额。

description.en: ★ 17 │ Layered memory that captures conversations, extracts facts, consolidates scenes and distills a profile, then recalls what is relevant before each model step. The pipeline is adapted from TencentDB Agent Memory.
description.zh: ★ 17 │ 分层蒸馏记忆：自动记录对话、抽取原子记忆、整合场景并提炼画像，在每次模型调用前召回相关内容。管线设计移植自 TencentDB Agent Memory。

description.en: Prompt-box screenshot shortcut button. Drag a box, shot taken immediately. DSH hides automatically; multi-monitor supported. Ctrl+Alt+1--hides the window then…
description.zh: 方便大家直接截屏的提示词框快捷按钮。拉完范围框后直接截屏。自动隐藏dsh，支持多屏幕。Ctrl+Alt+1--隐藏窗口截屏；shift+点击按钮--不隐藏窗口；按住Ctrl+Alt后点击1，反复截屏。！默认以哈希值名称保存1份在DSH附件库，各会话生成索引记录图片归属（可修改为多备份一份至会话文件夹）。图片属于上下文，…

description.en: Host-level proactive wake-ups for DeepSeek Harness: the model schedules its own alarms (once, recurring interval, or cron, with optional random jitter), cold sessions are woken on time by session resume, model-initiated follow-ups are gated by quiet hours and a daily delivery budget, silent wake turns end with proactive_reclaim and fold out of model context as tombstones, declared schedule files glob-sync JSON schedules into host alarms idempotently, min_idle_seconds defers wakes until the destination session quiets down, and a web panel (settings section plus per-session tab, SSE live refresh) manages alarms and wake history — the heartbeat engine for AI companions and roleplay characters with their own daily routines and world evolution.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 host 级主动唤醒：模型用 proactive_set 给自己设定闹钟（单次 / 循环间隔 / cron，支持 jitter 随机抖动），到点自动唤醒冷会话执行心跳、定时提醒与任务跟进；安静时段与每日投递预算约束模型自主跟进，静默唤醒以 proactive_reclaim 收尾并把唤醒上下文折叠为墓碑；声明式闹钟文件把 JSON 时间表幂等同步成 host 闹钟，min_idle_seconds 静默门让唤醒等会话空闲；自带 Web 管理面板（设置页节 + 会话页签，SSE 实时刷新）管理闹钟与唤醒历史——适合驱动 AI 陪伴、角色扮演（酒馆式人设）与 living agent 的心跳、日常安排和世界演算。

description.en: Bridges Multica to DeepSeek Harness through a versioned JSONL process protocol.
description.zh: 通过版本化 JSONL 进程协议将 Multica 接入 DeepSeek Harness。

description.en: Describe the persona you want and the agent writes it: nickname, bio, taglines and links come from the host model, the avatar comes from your local asset…
description.zh: 你说想要什么样的人设，它把文案写出来并把资料页填好：昵称/简介/标语/链接由宿主模型生成，头像取本地素材库（或你给的路径），再由站点自己的上传控件完成头像入库。**默认 dry-run**，只写资料字段 —— 不碰密码、邮箱、安全设置。

description.en: A one-line caption above the composer that tells you what the AI is doing right now: the step number, the action (e.g. running npm test), and whether it is…
description.zh: 在输入框上方加一行小字，告诉你 AI 现在第几步、在做什么、成没成，比如「第 3 步 · 正在执行命令 npm test · 琢磨中」。全部靠本机规则推断，不调模型、不联网、不改 DSH 的任何数据。

description.en: Project-based learning coach: a subject-agnostic teaching engine plus swappable domain packs (Unity/C# included), shipped both as a DSH skill and as an…
description.zh: 项目制教学教练：学科无关的教学引擎 + 可替换领域包（随包提供 Unity/C#），同时以 DSH 技能与可安装组合包分发。技能协议强制"先做后教"与分级提示；零依赖校验器会拒绝证据不支撑的能力结论，并在存在未解决阻塞项时阻止阶段通过。

description.en: ★ 91 │ Analyze the workspace, explain its architecture, keep decisions and TODOs, and restore project context in later sessions, with optional hybrid retrieval.
description.zh: ★ 91 │ 分析当前工作区、讲解项目架构、保存开发决策和待办，并在后续会话中恢复项目上下文，可选混合检索。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Explain the consequences of extra-permission requests in full-access mode, with confidence and inspection scope.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 在完全权限下分析额外授权请求的影响，并标注置信度与已检查范围。

description.en: Per-workspace project kanban board: nine kanban_* model tools for agent-driven planning plus a browser board UI, with disk persistence, undo, templates, and…
description.zh: 按工作区（项目）隔离的项目看板：9 个 kanban_* 模型工具供 Agent 规划时写卡，另带浏览器看板 UI，支持磁盘持久化、撤销、模板与归档。

description.en: Project board: kanban card groups with custom stages, cards linked to landfill-project memory, mounted repos and existing sessions; sessions opened from a card…
description.zh: 项目看板：卡片组泳道自定义阶段，卡片关联落盘项目记忆、挂载仓库与已有会话（可恢复归档）；从卡片开的会话自动读取项目记忆。

description.en: Per-project MCP servers: a project declares servers in its own documents (`.dsh/mcp.json` by default; the local and global file lists are settings), and they…
description.zh: 按项目挂载 MCP 服务器：项目在自己的文档里声明服务器（默认 `.dsh/mcp.json`，本地与全局文件列表均为配置项），只对在该项目中工作的会话挂载——会话首个 turn 时挂载，空闲后释放。右侧栏标签页与设置页列出每个有活动会话的项目、各服务器状态以及持有挂载的会话，并提供 `Sync` / `Retry`…

description.en: Adds a Session without workspace entry to the DSH Workspace picker, creates isolated date-organized directories, and keeps started sessions resumable under…
description.zh: 在 DSH 工作区选择器中添加无工作区会话入口，创建按日期整理的独立目录，并让已开始的会话在未分组区域保持可恢复。

description.en: Exposes bounded Prometheus metrics for DSH sessions, agents, LLM calls, tools, approvals, subagents, and jobs, with a Grafana dashboard and a loopback-only…
description.zh: 导出有界的 DSH Session、Agent、LLM、Tool、Approval、Subagent 与 Job Prometheus 指标，附带 Grafana 仪表盘，Endpoint 默认仅监听回环地址。

description.en: ★ 87 │ Manage preset and custom prompt templates and insert them into the composer.
description.zh: ★ 87 │ 管理预设和自定义模板，一键插入当前输入框。

description.en: One-click 💪 prompt enhancement (prompt): thin draft? continue 🔜, unhappy? regenerate 🔄; auto-archive history 🕐 with rollback ↩️; result syncs back to the…

description.en: System-prompt surface drift gate: every section any plugin or preset contributes to the assembled system prompt is hashed and baselined; a silent rewrite of…

description.en: Applies personal prompts and system-prompt edits at the global level or on a single session, so each session can work with its own prompt setup without…
description.zh: 可以自行选择在全局范围或单独会话中增加个人提示词、修改系统提示词来工作，各会话互不影响。

description.en: One-click prompt enhancement in the composer — rewrites the draft into a structured prompt (role and goal, executable steps, output format, acceptance criteria, edge cases) with before/after preview, fill-back, and undo. Never changes intent, never fabricates requirements.
description.zh: 输入框一键提示词增强——把草稿改写为结构化提示词（角色与目标、可执行步骤、输出格式、验收标准、边界条件），支持前后对比、回填与一键撤销；不改变原意、不凭空编造需求。

description.en: Four-tier prompt enhancer for the composer — the system tier always emits a LangGPT-structured system prompt (# Role / Profile / Skills / Rules / Workflows /…
description.zh: 输入框四档提示词增强——系统档无条件输出 # Role / Profile / Skills / Rules / Workflows / Initialization 的 LangGPT 结构化系统提示词（任务型草稿升格为对应智能体），其余三档改写为轻度整理、单段或五段任务书；迭代工作台以可编辑基准加可选要求继续改写，…

description.en: Context-aware next-message suggestions in the DSH composer, with repeated Trigger cycling and explicit user review before sending.
description.zh: DSH 输入框的上下文感知下一句建议：重复 Trigger 可持续换一条，发送前始终由用户确认。

description.en: Composer prompt refinement: rewrite the draft through the harness LLM, preview the result, then apply or send it, with style presets, model-aware reasoning…
description.zh: 输入框一键提示词增强：通过宿主模型改写草稿，预览后再替换或发送；支持风格预设、按模型自适应思考档位、费用估算与设置页。

description.en: Terminal-style composer for the DSH web GUI: shell prompt history (↑/↓, prefix search, Ctrl+R), Codex-style completion and next-prompt prediction (Tab or → to accept), selection toolbar (copy / quote / ask in side chat), right-click paste, draggable chat TOC, and a parallel side-chat thread in the right sidebar.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 输入框提供终端式体验：↑/↓ 历史（前缀搜索、Ctrl+R）、Codex 风格的历史补全与下一句预测（Tab/→ 接受）、选中工具栏（复制/引用/侧聊追问）、右键直接粘贴、可拖动会话目录，以及能在右栏并行跑第二条 agent 线程的侧聊（fork 全上下文、浮动/分屏、双向桥接、并发写提醒）。

description.en: Browser-local prompt library with a composer picker for injecting multiple session-scoped system prompts, branch inheritance, bilingual UI, favorites, and JSON…
description.zh: 浏览器本地提示词库：在输入框选择器中同时注入多条会话级系统提示词，支持分支继承、中英界面、收藏与 JSON 备份。

description.en: Prompt market beside the composer: browse and search three built-in online prompt sources, bookmark or write your own, and insert into the input box.
description.zh: 对话框旁的提示词市场：浏览并搜索三个内置在线提示词源，可收藏或自建，选中即插入输入框。

description.en: Composer prompt refinement for DSH: rewrites a rough draft into a structured, unambiguous prompt with one-click undo, reference-chip protection, three model…
description.zh: DSH 输入框提示词优化：把粗糙草稿改写成结构清晰、无歧义的提示词，支持一键撤回、引用芯片保护、三种模型来源与断连即停。

description.en: Adds a button to the composer that rewrites the unsent draft into a clearer, more specific prompt, with one-click restore, a settings page and an optional…
description.zh: 在输入框加一个按钮，把未发送的草稿改写为更清晰、更具体的提示词；支持一键还原、独立设置页，以及单次调用的模型覆盖。

description.en: Polishes the draft in the composer into a clearer, better-structured prompt from the ✨ button or Alt+O; streams the result live over SSE with reasoning shown…
description.zh: 在输入框按 ✨ 或 Alt+O 一键把草稿润色成更清晰、更结构化的 prompt；默认零配置复用当前会话模型（SSE 真流式、推理过程先出），也可自配任意 OpenAI 兼容端点。

description.en: ★ 2 │ Predicts your next message after each reply and shows it as gray ghost text in the composer: Tab accepts, Alt+→ accepts piece by piece, ↻ suggests another and Esc dismisses. Uses the session model by default and sends only recent conversation text.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 每轮回复结束后预测你的下一句话，以灰色提示文字显示在输入框中：Tab 采纳、Alt+→ 逐段采纳、↻ 换一条、Esc 忽略。默认使用当前会话的模型，只发送最近的对话文本。

description.zh: PWA 图标：把 Web GUI 安装/添加到桌面时使用的图标（以及 manifest 应用名）换成自定义内容，包内自带默认图标集，也可配置自己的图片。

description.en: Bridges QQ into DeepSeek Harness over OneBot 11: private and group chats, on-device voice-to-text, image support, and ten interaction tools (poke, react, like, image, file, recall and more). Needs an OneBot 11 implementation such as NapCat running alongside.
A QQ NT messenger skin for DeepSeek Harness: light and dark share one QQ NT language — clean restrained light mode (brand blue #12B7F5, light-blue bubbles) and…
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的 QQ NT 皮肤：浅色与深色共用一套 QQ NT 语言——浅色干净克制（品牌蓝 #12B7F5、浅蓝气泡），深色为沉稳蓝灰（#101822）——以可逆的 token 与布局两层实现，不改变你的浅色/深色偏好。

description.en: Remotely control DeepSeek Harness sessions and workspaces from QQ (official Bot API v2, direct chat only): list and switch workspaces, create sessions, compact…
description.zh: 通过 QQ（官方 Bot API v2，仅单聊）远程控制 DeepSeek Harness 会话与工作区：列出/切换工作区、新建会话、压缩历史、切换模型，支持流式输出、Markdown 与审批转发。未做按用户门禁——任何能给该机器人发消息的人都能控制这些会话，消耗你的模型额度与文件权限。

description.en: Independent extension pack and patch set for @zaofan/dsh-qqbot — install that plugin first (pinned to 1.10.39). Adds two-layer SQLite memory with hippocampal…
description.zh: 独立扩展包与补丁集，依赖并锁定 @zaofan/dsh-qqbot 1.10.39（请先装本体）。提供两层 SQLite 记忆（类海马体召回/巩固）、会自己长的人格（特别关心的人影响性格，B站/抖音的运营事件被收成摘要参与每天一次的自我反思）、人格漂移护栏、群分级、本地小模型代答与单脑仲裁、TTS…

description.en: ★ 0 │ QQ Mail for the DSH right sidebar: read recent mail and send plain text with a confirm gate. Credentials are read only from a private secret.json.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在右侧栏读取 QQ 邮件、查看正文，并在确认后发送纯文本邮件；凭据从私有配置文件读取。

description.en: Scores each assistant answer on five dimensions plus topic coverage, shows evidence, and turns the weakest dimension into copy-ready prompt advice.…
description.zh: 为每条回答给出五维质量分与话题覆盖度，附证据，并把最弱的一项转成可直接复制的提示词改写。只观测不改写；默认本地评分，可选 Jev 精评。

description.en: Plugin quality scorecard for DeepSeek Harness: 0-100 with grade, 6 components, fix suggestions per deduction, batch leaderboard - CLI plus an agent-callable…
description.zh: dsh 插件质量评分卡：0-100 分 + 等级 + 六项分项，逐项修复建议，支持批量榜单 - CLI + agent 可调用 quality_score 工具。

description.en: Search the documents and pictures in your Quberi knowledge base, browse its spaces and documents, save notes to it, and upload files into it with your approval…
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内通过 OAuth 检索你的 Quberi 知识库中的文档和图片，浏览空间和文档，保存笔记，并上传文件（每个文件都需你确认）。

description.en: Adds an optional note field under each selected option in the DSH Web UI ask_user_question popup; submitted notes travel to the model in the answer's custom…
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页端 ask_user_question 弹窗中为每个选中选项增加可选的补充说明输入框，提交时补充内容随答案一并传给模型。

description.en: Tree-style questioning for DSH: click "Ask in tree" on a selection to add a node to the right-sidebar tree and ask inline under it; clicking another node makes…
description.zh: 对话里划取文字后点「树形提问」，右栏问题树就多一个节点，问题直接写在节点下；单击别的节点就把它设为当前节点，之后再划取默认挂在它下面，「Alt + 树形提问」新开根节点，「Ctrl + 树形提问」把新段落追加进同一节点；双击节点跳回原文，点左侧圆点标记「懂了」；右上角可在列表与横向分支图之间切换。划取后点「添加到对话」…

description.en: A simple DSH queue panel for editing, removing, steering, reordering, and bulk removal.
description.zh: DSH 排队消息增强面板，支持编辑、删除、插话、排序和批量删除。

description.en: Reorder the messages queued while a DSH agent is busy, from inside the official queue dock: a drag handle and per-row ↑ / ↓ buttons on the dock's own rows,…
description.zh: 在官方队列 dock 内直接重排忙碌时排队的消息：每一行带拖拽手柄与上下移动按钮，移动在宿主端以一次带并发校验的 inbox splice 完成。只装饰官方 dock 而不替换它，因此预览、行内编辑、插话、删除与附件保持原样。队列已变化、该行不是用户消息（例如目标轮次提示）、或队列属于子代理会话时，移动会被拒绝。

description.en: Global Quick Actions beside every session-backed composer in DSH. One press sends a preset or your own saved text, with per-action send confirmation.
description.zh: 在 DSH 每个由会话支持的消息编辑器旁提供全局快捷动作。一键发送预置或你自己保存的文本，每个动作可单独设置发送确认。

description.en: ChatGPT-style side chat for the DSH Web GUI: ask small questions about the current topic in a floating side panel, answered by an independent lightweight…
description.zh: ChatGPT 式侧边快速提问：在 DSH Web 聊天界面右侧悬浮面板中就当前话题提小问题，由独立轻量会话通过官方 /api RPC 回答，绝不写入、不影响主对话。流式正文、可折叠思考、工具 chips、停止按钮、agent 预设选择，自动抓取主对话最近内容作为背景。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Back up the DSH desktop environment to a local Git repository and manage versions from Settings. Windows only; requires PowerShell, Git for Windows and initialization with setup.ps1. Export snapshots or copy a restore command; credentials are excluded by default.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 把 DSH 桌面环境备份到本地 Git 仓库，在设置中管理版本、导出快照和复制恢复命令。仅适用于 Windows，需要 PowerShell、Git for Windows，并先用 setup.ps1 初始化备份仓库；凭据默认不备份。

description.en: A 3×3 pad of saved phrases sitting to the left of the composer and tracking the input box's height: clicking a cell inserts its text at the caret as one…
description.zh: 输入框左侧的九宫格快捷短语面板，高度跟随输入框：点一格就把该条短语以一次可撤销的编辑插入光标处；面板内可就地编辑，每页 9 格、最多 12 页，界面跟随 DSH 语言设置。窗口放不下时退回输入框上方浮层。

description.en: Quick-open palette for the Web GUI: Ctrl+P fuzzy-searches an in-memory index of the session workspace (about 51k entries, median query 5 ms) with per-segment…
description.zh: Web GUI 的快速打开面板：Ctrl+P 在会话工作区的内存索引上做模糊检索（约 5.1 万条目，查询中位数 5 ms），支持逐段路径锚定、dir: 与 file: 前缀、Tab 目录下钻与 :行号 跳转；选中文件走 DSH 原生右栏打开，Ctrl+Enter 把文件引用放进会话草稿。另为内置文件预览补上文件内查找…

description.en: Adds a composer button that rewrites the current draft into a precise prompt in place, in one click, with a revert action.
description.zh: 在输入框加一个按钮，点一下就把草稿原地改写成精确提示词，可一键恢复原文。

description.en: Manageable one-tap text chips above the session composer; idle sessions queue the message and running sessions steer at the next safe boundary without…
description.zh: 在会话输入区上方提供可管理的一点即发文本 chip；空闲时 queue、运行中 steer，不改写草稿。

description.en: ★ 2 │ Turn conversation Markdown headings into a searchable outline with previews and navigation.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 把会话中的 Markdown 标题整理为可搜索大纲，支持预览与跳转。

description.en: Replaces the host-side folder chooser in the Add workspace flow with a name dialog, so a remote browser can create and open a workspace instead of an OS dialog…
description.zh: 將「新增工作區」流程中喺主機彈出嘅資料夾選擇器，改成輸入名稱嘅對話框，令遠端瀏覽器可以直接建立並開啟工作區。

description.en: Developer quick-reference toolbox for DSH: 12 themed categories (195 entries) plus zero-dependency tools — regex tester, JSON formatter, timestamp converter,…
description.zh: 开发者速查工具箱：12 个主题 195 条速查 + 6 个零依赖工具（正则实时测试、JSON 格式化、时间戳转换、Base64/URL 编解码、Cron 生成、行 diff），设置页可搜索查阅。

description.en: Two-tier image reading for text-only models: fast local OCR (RapidOCR, offline) first, vision-model fallback (modlens).
description.zh: 纯文本模型双层识图：优先本地快速 OCR（RapidOCR，离线），不足时回落视觉模型（modlens）。

description.en: System-level desktop floating-window plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): a global hotkey opens a floating window; the plugin supports workspace and session…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的系统级桌面悬浮窗插件：按下全局快捷键即可呼出桌面悬浮窗口，支持工作区与会话切换、审批与追问处理，以及插件自身的诊断日志导出。

description.en: Bottom-right quota pill and panel aggregating membership quotas across AI platforms (Kimi Code, DeepSeek, Zhipu Coding Plan, BigModel, Qwen, Scnet,…
description.zh: 右下角「会员额度」悬浮球与面板，聚合各 AI 平台套餐额度（Kimi Code、DeepSeek、智谱 Coding Plan、BigModel、通义千问、超算、TokenRouter、SupaWriter），API key 自动同步自 DSH 凭证域，彩色进度条展示用量。

description.en: Real-time DeepSeek account balance badge in the sidebar footer with odometer roll animation, multi-currency support, balance trend chart, per-key usage…
description.zh: 侧边栏底部实时显示 DeepSeek 账户余额徽章：数字滚轮动画、多币种支持、余额趋势图、按 Key 用量统计（含安装前历史回填），并支持 GitHub 版本自动检查。

description.en: Bottom-right quota capsule that auto-discovers every configured provider (DeepSeek, OpenRouter, SiliconFlow, GLM, one-api/new-api, coding plans) and shows…
description.zh: 右下角额度胶囊：自动发现所有已配置 Key 的供应商（DeepSeek、OpenRouter、SiliconFlow、GLM、one-api/new-api、各类 Coding 套餐），显示余额或 5 小时/周滚动用量，支持按供应商设置可见性、告警阈值与代理；另支持火山方舟 Agent Plan / Coding…

description.en: Select response text or code to ask contextual follow-ups with streaming replies in a native sidebar.
description.zh: 选中回答里的文字或代码，在原生侧边栏中结合上下文实时追问。

description.en: Adds selection quoting and anchored annotations to DSH conversations: selected text enters the composer as an anchored quote reference, a quote bar jumps back…
description.zh: 为 DSH 会话添加选区引用与锚点批注：选中文字带锚点进入输入框，输入框下方的引用条可跳回原文并高亮，发送后的引用块标明出处轮次与角色。

description.en: Quote selected conversation text into the Web composer as native reference chips for focused follow-up turns.
description.zh: 在网页会话中划选文本，以原生引用 chip 插入输入框，进行针对性追问。

description.en: Qwen Token Plan CN Responses provider for DeepSeek Harness via the OpenAI Responses API, with Qwen server-side tools, DSH local function tools, text/reasoning/tool-call multi-turn history, persisted image attachments, and a per-release official model catalog snapshot.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的千问 Token Plan 个人版 Responses API 提供方，保留 Qwen 服务端内置工具与 DSH 本地函数工具，多轮文本/推理/工具调用历史与图片附件均被支持，官方模型目录按 npm 版本冻结快照发布。

description.en: Compaction fix for NInfer-hosted qwen3.8-27b gateways: disables thinking on dsh context-compaction and session-title calls so xhigh reasoning stops burning the…
description.zh: 针对 NInfer 托管的 qwen3.8-27b 网关的压缩修复：在 dsh 上下文压缩与会话标题调用中关闭思考，避免 xhigh 推理耗尽全部输出预算；同一思路适用于其他启动方式，本包仅面向 NInfer。

description.en: Adds DSH 0.2.x kernel support to the SenseTime XiaoHuanXiong desktop-app models, reusing that app's stored sign-in so no API key is needed.
description.zh: 为商汤小浣熊桌面 App 的模型补上 DSH 0.2.x 内核支持，复用该 App 的登录态，无需填写 API Key。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Moves the in-car radio from godot_citys into the DSH right sidebar: a three.js in-car view, winding night roads, and radio-browser internet stations (City Pop).
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 将 godot_citys 中的车载电台搬进 DSH 右侧栏：three.js 车内视角、蜿蜒的夜路，以及 radio-browser 网络电台（City Pop）。

description.en: Read-only Raindrop.io dashboard in the sidebar with collection and tag distribution, top source domains, content types, a 12-month trend and a cleanup backlog,…
description.zh: 侧边栏里的 Raindrop.io 只读仪表盘：分类与标签分布、域名来源 Top、内容类型、近 12 个月趋势与待清理项，并提供两个只读 Agent 工具分析收藏。需 Raindrop.io API token（创建应用后粘贴）。

description.en: Reverse-engineering workbench: bridges a local IDA Pro into DeepSeek Harness through @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client, exposing the ida-pro-mcp toolset (decompile,…
description.zh: 逆向分析工作台：通过 @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client 把本机 IDA Pro 桥接进 DSH，将 ida-pro-mcp 工具集（反编译、xref、重命名、注释）以 mcp__ida__* 注册给模型。自动选择 idalib 无头模式（进程内分析二进制，无需打开 IDA GUI）或 GUI…

description.en: ★ 6 │ Install a pinned rea-agents release locally, start its MCP service and upgrade through an update control.
description.zh: ★ 6 │ 在本地安装指定版本的 rea-agents、启动其 MCP 服务，并通过更新入口升级。

description.en: Config-only DeepSeek Harness bundle that mounts the in-box MCP client bridge against morluto/rea over stdio, for reverse engineering anything with agents, from…
description.zh: 纯配置型 DeepSeek Harness 插件，用本体自带的 MCP 客户端桥，经 stdio 连接 morluto/rea，让 agent 从应用行为一路逆向到底层原生二进制。

description.en: Installs and verifies the reverse-engineering engines REA needs on Windows (Ghidra, JADX, apktool, adb, WABT, frida and more), pins the rea-agents MCP server…
description.zh: 在 Windows 上安装并校验 REA 所需的逆向引擎（Ghidra、JADX、apktool、adb、WABT、frida 等），固定 rea-agents 的 MCP 服务版本，并在设置卡片里体检能力缺口。

description.en: Pushes DSH approval and question cards to IM channels (WeChat first) and answers them from chat, with a session console, per-channel security, and an open push…
description.zh: 把 DSH 的审批卡与提问卡推送到 IM 渠道（先支持微信），可在聊天里直接作答，带会话控制台、逐渠道安全与开放推送服务。

description.en: Adds a speaker button immediately right of the Like button on every finalized assistant reply; click it to hear the reply through the browser speech engine,…
description.zh: 在每条已定稿的助手回复里、紧挨点赞按钮右侧加一个小喇叭：点击用浏览器语音引擎朗读这条回复，鼠标悬停可调倍速与音色；文本会发送到非官方的 Edge TTS 端点。

description.en: Reads assistant replies aloud with Microsoft Edge neural voices and highlights the sentence being spoken, so you can follow along while listening. The…
description.zh: 用微软 Edge 神经音色朗读助手回复，并高亮当前正在朗读的那一句，可以边听边看。高亮样式完全自定义：底色、文字颜色、浓淡三样都能在设置里调。另外每条回复下方有音浪播放键、暂停与上句/下句跳转、语速调节和自动朗读开关。

description.en: Reads animated GIF and WebP as animations: a pasted one keeps playing in the UI while the model gets a labelled sheet of frames sampled across it, and the…
description.zh: 把 gif 和动图 webp 当作动画来读：贴进聊天框的照常播放，模型收到的是横跨整段采样、带帧号与时长的胶片条；工作区里的文件由 read_animation 按需采样。

description.en: Deterministic prompt-injection interception: tool results from file reads, repo searches and web fetches are scanned before they enter model context;…
description.zh: 确定性注入拦截：文件读取、仓库搜索与网络抓取的工具结果在进入模型上下文前被扫描；高危发现隔离包裹或阻断，凭证类文件按路径即隔离。

description.en: Display read_image results in DSH Web and Desktop: complete previews, grouped multi-image galleries, transparency checkerboards, keyboard and touch zoom, and…
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 和桌面版展示 read_image 结果：完整预览、多图画廊、透明棋盘格、键盘与触控缩放，使用会话授权加载。已验证 DSH Desktop 0.11.1 / Harness 0.2.0-rc.2。

description.en: ★ 23 │ Read webpages and feeds with encoding detection, pagination and compact text output.
description.zh: ★ 23 │ 识别编码并读取网页与订阅源，处理分页，输出精简正文。

description.en: Version-token-validated in-process result cache for the DSH read tool: repeated reads of unchanged files skip file I/O and line rendering, with a readcache…
description.zh: 为 DSH read 工具提供版本令牌校验的进程内结果缓存：未变更文件的重复读取跳过文件 I/O 与行渲染，附带 readcache 工具查看统计与清空。

description.en: Realtime Avatar (realtimeavatar.ai) for agents: the developer API key held by the harness credentials store, the public docs as five on-demand skills, rta_*…
description.zh: Realtime Avatar（realtimeavatar.ai）实时数字人工具：开发者 API key 由 harness 凭据存储保管，公开文档打包为五个按需加载的技能，rta_* 工具封装公开 REST API（余额、数字人、动作片段、会话、用量），消耗额度的操作需审批，/rta…

description.en: Distill over-long model reasoning into its useful core, replay the compressed version on every later request, and report each session's cost and savings.…
description.zh: 把过长的模型思考压缩成有用核心，之后每次请求重放压缩版，并给出每个会话的开销与节省报告。默认关闭：必须先选择一个改写后端。derive 无需安装、打包版也能用；in-place 需给 DSH 源码打 14 处补丁并重建（源码构建首选）；message-edit 需装第三方插件，仅实验性，不推荐。

description.en: Configures provider and model reasoning-effort mappings for DeepSeek Harness, with a grouped model picker and composer slider.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 配置 Provider 与模型的推理强度映射，并提供按 Provider 分组的模型选择器和输入框滑块。

description.en: Add missing reasoning-effort declarations to custom pi-ai models through DSH settings, enabling the native effort picker and handling models added later.
description.zh: 通过 DSH 设置为自定义 pi-ai 模型补充缺失的推理强度声明，启用原生强度选择器，并自动处理后续添加的模型。

description.en: Adds a model-aware reasoning effort slider with native and animated modes, light and dark palettes, and shared or per-model colors.
description.zh: 为模型添加推理强度滑块，支持原生与动画模式、明暗配色，以及全局或按模型配色。

description.en: Declares per-model reasoning-effort ladders for third-party providers in the llm-pi-ai settings section, so DSH's stock thinking-intensity selector works on…
description.zh: 在 llm-pi-ai 设置节为第三方模型提供商补齐推理档位（reasoning effort）声明，让 DSH 自带的思考强度选择器对 pi-ai 目录之外的模型真正可用。

description.en: Conversation history recall for DSH: three-layer (literal/fuzzy/semantic) retrieval over every past session's original text, fully local & offline — AI never…
description.zh: 对话历史回忆：字面/模糊/语义三层检索全部历史会话的原始文本，完全本地离线——AI 再也不会忘记你说的话。一条命令安装（自带 `dsh.bundle.patch`），语义推理跑在 worker 线程。

description.en: Recall any user message: rolls the conversation (official session fork) and workspace files (per-message shadow git snapshots) back to before it, with a diff-preview confirmation panel.
description.zh: 消息撤回：在用户消息旁加「撤回」按钮，把对话历史（官方会话 fork）与项目文件（逐消息影子 git 快照）一并回退到该消息发送之前，带差异预览确认面板。

description.en: ★ 126 │ DeepSeek Harness plugin: recall sent-but-unread text messages before the model reads them.
description.zh: ★ 126 │ 在模型读取前撤回已发送但尚未处理的文字消息。

description.en: Summarizes the current DeepSeek Harness session with /recap or after inactivity, with configurable models, Chinese and English output, and expandable summaries…
description.zh: 通过 /recap 或闲置触发回顾当前 DeepSeek Harness 会话，支持配置模型、中英文输出，并在对话内展示可展开的摘要。

description.en: Draggable recent-deliverables panel for DSH Web that merges declared deliverables with recently modified workspace files, with filename search, type filters,…
description.zh: DSH Web 的可拖动最近成品面板，合并已声明交付的文件与工作区最近修改的文件，支持文件名搜索、类型筛选、PDF/HTML/图片/文本内嵌预览，以及用桌面应用打开或在文件管理器中定位。

description.en: An always-last, collapsible Recent tasks workspace group in the DSH sidebar: a sidebar entry and the Mod+Alt+N / Mod+Shift+N shortcut start a chat in a…
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏里常驻末位、可折叠的「最近任务」工作区分组：侧边栏入口与 Mod+Alt+N / Mod+Shift+N 快捷键在专用目录里开新对话，对话因此归入这个分组，而不是「未分组」。该分组是真正的工作区记录，而非插件画出来的仿制品，折叠、改名、搜索与拖拽排序都正常可用；目录、分组名、常驻末尾与自动重建都是实时设置…

description.en: A deterministic calculation engine for DeepSeek Harness, including a preset that guides the LLM to calculate through the engine rather than by text generation.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的确定性计算引擎，附带一个预设：引导 LLM 通过引擎而非文本生成来完成计算。

description.en: ★ 22 │ Search and recommend plugins using a public scoring model and a settings-page ranking.
description.zh: ★ 22 │ 按公开评分模型检索和推荐插件，并在设置页展示排行。

description.en: Roll back to before any of your questions or edit the last one and resubmit, with the workspace files of the discarded turns restored.
description.zh: 回退到任意一条提问之前，或编辑上一条问题重新提交；被丢弃轮次产生的工作区文件会一并还原。

description.en: Resumes turns interrupted by a DSH host restart: hooks agent activation (once a session is live), reads the crash-repair turn/end, and sends a continuation…
description.zh: DSH 重启后自动续跑被中断的回合：在会话激活后读取崩溃修复写入的 turn/end，投出要求先核对真实状态（不假定外部操作成功或失败）的续跑消息；永久性失败（认证、配额、上下文超限）直接跳过，并有跨重启次数预算、自适应退避与最小上下文注入。

description.en: Delete DSH sessions into a restorable recycle bin — subagent sessions follow their parent as one tree, batch archive, restore and purge are supported, and only…
description.zh: 把 DSH 会话删入可恢复的回收站——子会话随其父会话作为一棵树处理，支持批量归档、恢复与彻底删除，只有彻底清除才会真正销毁数据。

description.en: Adds Regenerate and Edit and resend to each message you already sent: Regenerate re-answers the same text in one click without going through the composer; Edit…
description.zh: 给你发出的每条消息加上「重新生成」和「编辑重发」：重新生成一键用同样的文字重新回答，不经过输入框；编辑重发就地撤回这条消息及其之后的内容——从时间线和模型上下文里一起消失，不新建会话也不开新分支——再把文字和图片放回输入框，改完发送就从那一条重写对话。带文件（非图片）的消息两个操作置灰。

description.en: Red-team engagement mode: send one target organization name; a planner session runs five execution roles (recon, asset triage, vulnerability discovery,…
description.zh: 红队作战模式：只发一个靶标单位名称，主会话指挥五个执行角色（信息收集/资产梳理/漏洞发现/漏洞利用/内网渗透），并发可配置；开工前做技能与资源预检；得分按四阶段（信息收集/互联网/边界/内网），上限、权限取高、同服务去重由服务端判定；发现落本机 SQLite 事实库。右侧常驻控制台 9…

description.en: Adds a UI effects page to Settings that switches off DSH Web animations and transitions, loading and progress animations, backdrop blur, smooth scrolling,…
description.zh: 在设置里新增 "前端特效" 页, 按分类关掉 DSH Web 的动画与过渡, 加载与进度动画, 毛玻璃, 平滑滚动, 标题 hover 滚动, 阴影, 渐变与 JS 动效, 降低浏览器渲染负担.

description.en: ★ 2 │ Media library for the dsh web UI: browse configured local directories as a grid or list, open images in a viewer, and play videos in a page-fullscreen player with swipe navigation.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 以网格或列表浏览本地媒体目录，查看图片，或全屏播放和滑动切换视频。

description.en: A working Remotion prototype that turns a DSH plugin repository into a 16:9 promo video and a 3:4 promo image locally; its DSH bundle is scaffolded but has not…
description.zh: 本地用 Remotion 从 DSH 插件仓库生成 16:9 宣传片与 3:4 宣传图的可用原型；DSH bundle 仍是脚手架，尚未在真实 DSH profile 中加载验证。需 Node.js 22+ 与 Chrome/Chromium 渲染。

description.en: Turn codebase smells into an executable, priority-ordered refactoring plan: file-length / deep-nesting / function-length / god-object heuristics plus a staged…
description.zh: 重构入口诊断：把代码库坏味道（超长文件/深嵌套/超长函数/上帝对象）转成带定位、优先级与依赖顺序的重构计划（只读不自动改码）。

description.en: ★ 23 │ References files, sessions, commands, skills, and historical external AI chats from the DSH @ menu.
description.zh: ★ 23 │ 通过 @ 菜单引用文件、会话、命令、技能，以及其他 AI 工具中的历史对话。

description.en: Reference verification for DeepSeek Harness (参考文献真实性检查器): the reference_checker model tool checks a paper's bibliography (.pdf/.bib/.tex/.txt or pasted text)…
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供参考文献真实性检查：reference_checker 工具将论文（PDF/BibTeX/tex/文本/粘贴列表）的每条文献对照 Crossref / OpenAlex / arXiv 核对，逐条判定 found / partial / not_found /…

description.en: Read-only session-log projector (drsc) for DSH: scans ~/.dsh/sessions/**, decodes zstd/tiled-frame logs with a vendored leaf decoder and rewrites per-session…
description.zh: DSH 会话原文只读投影同步器（drsc）：只读扫描 ~/.dsh/sessions/** 会话日志，经内置 leaf 解码器解 zstd/分段帧日志后投影进插件自有 SQLite（node:sqlite，segments/replaces + FTS5），由单条 fenced HTTP 路由提供 surface…

description.en: Reflex arc for DS Bot: runs as a sibling DSH plugin with no change to ds-bot, collects facts in cheap layers, scores them with a local decision model, and…
description.zh: 给 DS Bot 的反射弧：作为兄弟插件运行、不改 ds-bot，用低成本层持续采集事实并在本地决策模型上打分，只有越过阈值时才唤醒 Bot 的推理层。

description.en: Learn traceable experience from test-verified Python repairs in one repository. DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 Web only; learning is off by default. Verification runs repository code, and enabled model sharing sends bounded repair material to the configured provider.
description.zh: 从单仓库中通过测试验证的 Python 修复积累可追溯经验。仅支持 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 Web，学习默认关闭；验证会执行仓库代码，启用模型共享后会向所选服务发送有限修复材料。

description.en: Make F5, Ctrl+F5, and Ctrl+Shift+R reload the DeepSeek Harness page.
description.zh: 让 F5、Ctrl+F5 和 Ctrl+Shift+R 都能刷新 DeepSeek Harness 页面。

description.en: Adds F5 / Ctrl+R page reload to the DeepSeek Harness desktop web UI, which production builds lack by default (the "Reload Page" menu item and bare-F5…
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面 Web UI 补上 F5 / Ctrl+R 页面刷新功能（生产版默认没有刷新菜单项与裸 F5 快捷键）。通过客户端捕获阶段按键监听绑定软刷新（F5、Ctrl+R）与防缓存硬刷新（F5 加修饰键、Ctrl+Shift+R，附加 _dsh_refresh 时间戳）。
在 DSH 桌面版界面左上角「收起侧边栏」按钮旁加两个按钮，macOS、Windows、Linux 三端都可用。刷新只重载界面层，宿主里正在生成的回合不中断；重启会在确认一次后退出整个应用并自动重新打开，会话与工作区都在。重启是 POST，必须带每次启动随机生成的 token（由插件状态接口提供）；插件不联网、不读会话…
description.en: Adds two buttons beside the sidebar toggle at the top-left of the DSH desktop UI, on macOS, Windows and Linux. Reload refreshes only the UI layer while a turn…
Switches DSH's package download source between the npmmirror China mirror and the official npm registry on timeout or failure, with a Web UI to inspect and…
description.zh: 在下载超时或失败时，于 npmmirror 国内镜像与官方 npm 源之间自动切换下载源，并附带 Web UI 可手动查看与切换。

description.en: Hot reload and one-click restart for DSH plugin development. Reload uses DSH's built-in reload instead of a private reimplementation, so it behaves the way the…
description.zh: 面向 DSH 插件开发的热重载与一键重启。重载用 DSH 自带的重载，而不是另造一套，所以行为和宿主一致：只刷新有改动的插件，其余继续运行。重启是安全的那个：跑在客户端之外，所以即使要换掉的正是客户端本身也能重新拉起；有会话或后台任务在跑时直接拒绝；并确认客户端真的重新打开了。轻量：只多一个工具、不带参数、不向模型上下…

description.en: ★ 217 │ Connect remote SSH workspaces with file operations, mirror sync, deployment and port forwarding.
description.zh: ★ 217 │ 连接 SSH 远程工作区，使用文件操作、镜像同步、部署与端口转发。

description.en: Turn another computer into a remote Agent teammate: the worker runs its own DSH and a full Agent loop locally, so dispatched tasks keep running when the link…
description.zh: 把另一台电脑变成你的远程 Agent 同事：副机本地跑自己的 DSH 与完整 Agent 循环，所以链路断开时任务照常继续、模型凭证也永不离开那台机器。主机用 8 个 remote_* 工具派活，只收回 handoff 摘要与产物清单，成品按需拉取——中间产物留在副机。配对码接入，direct 或 relay…

description.en: DSH remote-access authorization page that shows the current process browser-session URL as a clickable link or QR code, behind an optional authority/subnet…
description.zh: DSH 远程授权页：以可点击链接或二维码呈现当前进程的浏览器会话 URL，可选主机/网段白名单与 PIN 门禁。

description.en: Bot-to-bot messaging across machines on top of ds-harness-remote: five tools let a local Bot list the peer Host Bots, pin a target device and send it a…
description.zh: 基于 ds-harness-remote 的跨机器 Bot 传话：五个工具让本地 Bot 列出对端 Bot、固定目标设备并给它发消息，不用切换本地窗口。

description.en: Translates DSH's private remote protocol into a versioned REST API (chat, sessions, files, devices) for trusted clients such as the Android app dsh-companion,…
description.zh: 把 DSH 内核的私有 remote 协议翻译成版本化 REST 接口（聊天、会话、文件、设备），供 Android 客户端 dsh-companion 等受信任客户端使用；桌面端在 DSH 设置里内联渲染七张折叠卡片（根目录 / 远程访问 / 设备 / 识图 / 回收站 / 审计 / App 下载）。

description.en: Right-sidebar SSH terminal for DSH where you and your agent share one PTY: 16 agent tools, configurable transfer limit, session-isolated audit trail, one-click…
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏的 SSH 远程终端：你和 agent 共用一个 PTY，16 个 agent 工具，传输上限可调，终端按会话隔离，配置页支持一键热更新。

description.en: Adds a row at the top of the sidebar that switches the whole Web GUI to another DSH host reached over a loopback port, and shows that host's session state on…
description.zh: 在侧边栏顶部加一行，点击后整页切换成另一台 DSH 主机的 Web GUI（通过回环端口访问），并在该行显示那台主机的会话状态（运行中、有新活动、正等你回答）。

description.en: ★ 6 │ Remote development launcher: install dsh on a remote host and use it in your local browser, with credentials staying on this machine.
description.zh: ★ 6 │ 在远程主机安装 DSH，通过本机浏览器访问，登录凭据保留在本机。

description.en: Model-visible SSH file tools read_remote, write_remote and edit_remote: read a remote UTF-8 file with line-numbered paging, create a new remote file (an…
description.zh: 模型可直接调用的 ssh 远程文件三件套：read_remote 按行号分页读远端 UTF-8 文本，write_remote 只新建文件、目标已存在即拒绝且没有覆写分支，edit_remote 做唯一匹配的字面替换，三者共用取自 ~/.ssh/config 的「别名:路径」一个 file_path 字段。

description.en: Embeds a remote DeepSeek Harness GUI in the local DSH window over an SSH tunnel, lists the remote sessions, and switches between the local instance and any…
description.zh: 通过 SSH 隧道把远端 DSH 的 GUI 嵌进本地 DSH 界面，列出远端会话，并在本地实例与任意远端主机之间切换。

description.en: Native SSH remote development for DSH: remote workspaces, mirrored sessions, terminal and file access, approvals, and a DSH UI. Requires DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2…
description.zh: 把 SSH 主机上的工作区接入 DSH：远程工作区、镜像会话、终端与文件访问、审批和原生 DSH 界面。需 DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2，远端主机为 Linux 或 macOS。

description.en: ★ 36 │ Provide remote access, QR sign-in and connection management over LAN or Tailscale.
description.zh: ★ 36 │ 通过局域网或 Tailscale 提供远程访问、扫码登录与连接管理。

description.en: ★ 69 │ Access sessions, approvals and files from mobile clients through a token gateway, with server switching and offline chat caching.
description.zh: ★ 69 │ 通过令牌网关从移动客户端访问会话、审批和文件，支持服务器切换及聊天离线缓存。

description.en: Bundles the remote-shell skill for secure SSH, SFTP, Telnet, and WinRM remote operations, with an encrypted credential vault whose login and execution scripts…
description.zh: 打包 remote-shell 技能，提供安全的 SSH、SFTP、Telnet、WinRM 远程操作，内置加密凭证库，登录与执行脚本不接受明文密码。

description.en: Remote host tunnel manager: runs dsh web on a remote Linux server (systemd supervision, no root needed) behind an auto-reconnecting SSH tunnel; allocates and…
description.zh: 远程主机隧道管理器：把 dsh web 跑在远程 Linux 服务器上（systemd 守护、免 root），本地经自动重连的 SSH 隧道访问；远程端口自动分配并在服务器登记留档，支持多人共用与 audit 审查。

description.en: Scan a QR code in Settings to open the DeepSeek Harness web UI on your phone inside the active session via a cloudflared quick tunnel.
description.zh: 在设置中扫描二维码，通过 cloudflared 快速隧道在手机上于当前会话中打开 DeepSeek Harness 网页端。

description.en: Remote control for dsh web from a phone browser, from anywhere (no public IP needed): hosted cloud relay works over 4G, or self-host the router; one command installs the desktop bridge and this in-harness Settings panel (cloud / self-hosted / WeChat-bot tabs, account login, bridge start/stop, feedback); the tunnel data plane is end-to-end encrypted (E2EE phone↔desktop, with a QR / one-time-link desktop grant so you never re-type the password), with HTTP/WebSocket pass-through, access-key auth, a live device list and optional traffic quotas; the WeChat bot channel is bound by QR scan and pushes task-finished / error / stopped events to WeChat, where one number in reply approves or denies a pending decision and continues the current task — WeChat messages travel only between Tencent ilink and the local bridge, never through the relay.
description.zh: 手机浏览器远程控制 dsh web，人在哪都能用（免公网 IP）：官方托管中继 4G 即用，也可自建 relay；一条命令安装电脑端 bridge 与设置页「远程控制」面板（云端 / 自建 / 微信机器人三个 tab、账号登录、bridge 启停、反馈）；隧道数据面端到端加密（E2EE：手机↔电脑端正文与 WS 内容加密，中继只见路由元数据；支持扫码/一次性链接桌面授权，免重复输密码）；HTTP/WebSocket 全量透传，访问密钥认证、实时设备列表、可选流量配额；微信机器人通道扫码绑定后，把任务完成 / 出错 / 停下推送到微信，需要拍板时回一个数字即可放行或拒绝，回话可直接继续当前任务——微信消息只经腾讯 ilink 与本机 bridge，不经中继。

description.en: Open folders on remote hosts over SSH as Harness workspaces: file tools (read/write/edit/grep/glob) and shell commands run directly on the remote host over…
description.zh: 通过 SSH 把远程主机目录作为 Harness 工作区打开：read/write/edit/grep/glob 与 shell 命令经 SFTP、ripgrep、ssh2 exec 直接在远程主机执行，不做本地镜像；多主机注册表加密存储，本地沙箱策略依然生效。

description.en: Twelve official Remotion skills synced from the official upstream (programmatic video with React: animation, audio, captions, 3D, maps, charts, render, Studio), plus a bundled-resource health check. A step-by-step first-run guide (4 steps) now opens inside its settings panel.
description.zh: Remotion 官方 12 技能：React 编程式视频（动画/音频/字幕/3D/地图/图表/渲染/Studio），安装即用，附随包资源完整性自检。面板内置 4 步首次使用引导，看一次后不再出现。

description.en: Ships a skill plus six Node scripts for a DSH install that will not come up - walking the boot stages before readiness, the plugin dependency bridges and…
description.zh: 携带一份技能加 6 个 Node 脚本，用来处理装完起不来的 DSH——沿 readiness 之前的引导阶段、profile 下的插件依赖桥与 junction、失效或重复的插件行、以及升级路径逐段排查。脚本默认只诊断，重建脚本只有显式加 --fix 才写盘。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Checks repair-order settlement arithmetic: confirms that project amounts, parts and labor hours, and the settlement total are internally consistent; flags differences only, with no qualitative conclusions.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 核对维修工单中的项目金额、配件、工时和结算总额，仅提示算术差异。

description.en: Edits assistant replies and thinking chains in DSH sessions so the model sees the edited text, live via message projection or on disk.
description.zh: 编辑 DSH 会话中的助手回复与思维链，让模型采信改后的内容：在线经 message projection 立即生效，或落盘改写会话记录。

description.en: Read-only repository fact scanner kernel for DSH analysis plugins: deterministic probe / file index / modules / dependencies / entry points / symbols / graphs…
description.zh: 只读仓库事实扫描内核：为分析型插件提供可复现的仓库探测、文件索引、模块、依赖、入口、符号与 Git 变更等硬事实（CLI + 库接口 + 技能 runbook）。

description.en: Read-only repo bootstrap scanner (repo_setup_scan tool): detects stack/tests/docs/git/db and recommends plugins, MCP servers and hygiene files.
description.zh: 只读仓库体检引导工具（repo_setup_scan）：识别技术栈/测试/文档/git/数据库线索，给出插件、MCP 与卫生文件的安装建议。

description.en: Add your own parameters to the model requests dsh sends: OpenRouter provider routing and fallback models, reasoning, sampling and custom body fields, and…
description.zh: 给 dsh 发出的模型请求加上自己的参数：OpenRouter 供应商路由和备用模型、思考强度、采样参数与自定义请求体字段、请求头，OpenRouter 和其他网关都能用。参数按 dsh 已配置的渠道管理；实时预览显示每个请求会多出什么，请求记录显示实际发出了什么、网关回了什么。

description.en: Runtime requirement drift guard that keeps long-running DSH agents aligned with the user's approved goal, constraints, and decisions.
description.zh: 运行时需求漂移防护，在长任务执行过程中保持 DSH Agent 与用户确认的目标、约束和决策一致。

description.en: Curated research plugin market: adds a Research plugins page to Settings with hand-reviewed plugins for literature search, reference management, writing and…
description.zh: 精选科研插件市场：在设置里加一页「科研插件」，收录逐个读过代码的文献检索、文献管理、写作与科研工作台插件——一键安装、更新、卸载并钉住审读过的版本，面板内重启，只发一个网络请求（拉取自家目录）。

description.en: ★ 213 │ Bind research claims to snapshots and export versioned reports with verification records.
description.zh: ★ 213 │ 将研究结论绑定到快照，导出带核验记录的版本化报告。

description.en: Edit a sent message in place and resend it as a forked chat, keeping the original: change the text, remove, reorder or add images and files, with session image…
description.zh: 在消息位置编辑已发消息并以 fork 出的新聊天重发，原聊天保留：改文字、删图、调整图片顺序、补图片或文件，发送前按会话图片限制校验（第一条消息在同一工作区新开聊天）。另外支持输入 @ 按文件名引用待发送图片、拖动调整输入框附件顺序、复制消息时连图片一起复制，以及对话图片的复制、下载和拖进输入框。

description.en: Restart DSH: configurable restart method (Node native / legacy PowerShell), post-restart continue prompt, optional watchdog auto-relaunch.

description.en: Adds a sidebar Restart button to DeepSeek Harness Desktop on Windows that stops the whole application process tree and reopens the app.

description.en: Results-only conversation toggle for the Web GUI: hides thinking and tool-call process rows, keeps one live status line while the agent works, restores working…

description.en: Resume screening plugin for HR in DeepSeek Harness: ingest up to 100k Word/PDF/Excel resumes into one searchable library with skills / coarse categories /…

description.en: Observes consecutive identical tool failures and optionally pauses before the next model step, preserving original results and successful repeats, with an…

description.en: LAN reverse proxy plugin for DeepSeek Harness - enables mobile/tablet access with full features, fixes settings panel inaccessible via reverse proxy.

description.en: Moves the composer to the top of an active conversation and renders the transcript plus the turn navigator newest-first, so replies appear right under the…

description.en: Adversarial code review — parallel finders inspect a diff through separate lenses (correctness, lifecycle, contract, security), then each finding goes to…
description.zh: 对抗式代码审查：多个 finder 并行地从不同视角（正确性、生命周期、契约、安全）审查改动，随后每条发现都交给独立验证者去推翻它，只要有一票推翻就丢弃。

description.en: Codex-style review of session file changes: per-turn cards (optionally taking over the shell edited cards) whose totals are the turn net diff, a review tab…
description.zh: Codex 风格的会话文件修改审查：每轮变更卡片（可接管 shell 的 edited 卡片），统计口径为本轮净差异；审查 tab 的 diff 不自动换行、真实行号、按行打开、可拖拽分栏；悬停预览显示整文件差异（每处改动前后 3 行上下文）；按轮一键撤回；工具条显示记录占用并可一键清空。记录按会话分片存储，快照用内容…

description.en: ★ 0 │ Review a change set as a relationship graph in the middle column, with every node clickable to the exact source line.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 用关系图审阅代码改动，点击节点即可跳转到相应源码行。

description.en: Runs a parallel code review squad of read-only reviewer subagents (security, correctness, tests, style), each optionally on its own model, and aggregates one…
description.zh: 通过 /review 命令或 code_review 工具并行派出只读评审员子代理小队（安全、正确性、测试、风格，各自可指定不同模型），并汇总为按严重度分组的结构化评审报告。

description.en: ★ 222 │ Rewind a conversation in place to any earlier user message and optionally restore the files the agent changed, without creating a branch.

description.en: ★ 0 │ Close right sidebar tabs with middle-click or double-click. Depends on the host dock tab attributes.

description.zh: 翻译 CPU：Windows x64 专属翻译界面，侧栏独立入口，支持工作台／聊天切换、原文与译文双栏、尽量保留原格式的文档翻译、屏幕框选翻译及最近记录，复用宿主模型、语音输入与预览。使用 CPU OCR，无需 NVIDIA 运行库。不要同时启用 CPU 与 CUDA 两个版本。
